AI.motivation: 现有RNN架构在部署不同结构时缺乏灵活性，且多层RNN在面对高阶动态和非线性建模时存在泛化能力不足的问题，同时多层RNN在空间维度上存在梯度消失/爆炸问题，限制了其深度扩展和性能表现。
AI.method: 提出模块化的深度RNN框架以支持不同RNN架构的灵活部署并自动化梯度计算（基于自动微分）。基于该模块化框架，引入了一种多层RNN中附加前馈层间连接的新架构，以增强网络对高阶动态和非线性的建模能力，并缓解空间梯度消失/爆炸问题。
AI.result: 在四旋翼飞行器高度动态建模的案例中，所提出的带前馈层间连接的多层RNN能够成功学习动态模型，而现有方法难以快速泛化甚至完全无法泛化。实验验证了该架构在建模高阶动态和非线性方面的显著优势。
AI.conclusion: 模块化的深度RNN框架结合前馈层间连接是一种有效提升多层RNN学习与泛化能力的手段，能够改善高阶动态相关性建模与空间梯度稳定性，为复杂非线性系统建模提供了新的可行方案。

title: Evaluation of Phonetic Encoding Algorithms on Transcription Datasets
summary: In this work, a novel evaluation scheme built on a generalized variant of the Rand Index measure, namely, the Hüllermeier-Rifqi Index, is proposed in order to assess how well phonetic encoding algorithms conform to word-based transcriptions in IPA (International Phonetic Alphabet) notation. For this objective, the discordance score is obtained by calculating the absolute difference between the pairwise similarity values of ground-truth transcriptions and those of corresponding phonetic encodings, which are computed using normalized edit distance as a permutation dependent string metric. The resulting score is subsequently adjusted with respect to that of a random string generator incorporating the same alphabet as the encoder under consideration. A wide range of phonetic encoders were evaluated as such on multi-lingual transcription datasets along with their recall capabilities based on the collision rate. The validity of the proposed scheme is further supported by its applicability in measuring the orthographic transparency of a language when the writing system is viewed as an inherent phonetic representation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于广义Rand Index（Hüllermeier-Rifqi指数）的新评估方案，用于衡量语音编码算法与IPA音标转写的一致性。
AI.motivation: 需要一种系统化的方法来评估语音编码算法在多大程度上符合基于IPA符号的词汇转写，而现有的评估手段可能缺乏对这种一致性进行细粒度量化的能力。
AI.method: 该方法首先计算真实转写与相应语音编码之间基于归一化编辑距离（作为排列相关字符串度量）的成对相似值，通过取二者绝对差值获得不一致性分数，再以使用相同字母表的随机字符串生成器的结果对该分数进行校正。此外，还基于碰撞率评估了编码器的召回能力。
AI.result: 在多种多语言转写数据集上对广泛的语音编码器进行了评估，验证了所提方案的有效性，并展示了其在将书写系统视为固有语音表示时衡量语言正字法透明度方面的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的评估框架不仅适用于语音编码算法的验证，还能用于分析语言正字法与语音之间的透明度关系，具有广泛的语言学应用价值。

title: Corporate Language Model (CLM): Transforming Tacit and Fragmented Enterprise Knowledge into a Sovereign, Auditable, and Executable Corporate Intelligence Layer
summary: Enterprise AI deployments fail not from model inadequacy, but because organizations lack a structured substrate encoding how they decide, negotiate, and execute. Generic LLMs carry no firm-specific ontological priors; RAG remains brittle, with no path to executable action; static playbooks encode logic but cannot reason or adapt. This demands an architecture treating tacit-knowledge capture, ontological grounding, sovereign deployment, and auditable actuation as co-designed from the start. This paper introduces the Corporate Language Model (CLM), a framework transforming a firm's structured, unstructured, multimodal, and tacit knowledge into an ontology-grounded enterprise foundation upon which reasoning and governed execution are composed. CLM has five capability planes and four architectural pillars: a Neurosymbolic Mesh coupling generative models with a knowledge graph; a Skill Graph where reusable tactics, personas, objections, and goals are typed and composed; Living Digital Twins modeling functional areas as reasoning surrogates; and a Deep Security Layer enforcing sovereignty, traceability, and human oversight. A Spec-as-Code paradigm bridges grounded intent and executable artifact. CLM is one instantiation of this foundation-centric class. Four contributions follow: CLM is defined as a distinct object of study; the Skill Graph is introduced for compositional explainability by construction; the Wisdom Listener effect is proposed, whereby tacit-capable foundations compound in value with use, connecting to dynamic capabilities and organizational learning; and evidence from a JCI-accredited tertiary hospital in Brazil instantiates three of the six maturity stages under LGPD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出企业语言模型（CLM）框架，将企业各类知识转化为本体化的企业基础层，实现推理与受治理执行的组合。CLM包含五个能力面和四个支柱：符号网格、技能图、活体数字孪生和深度安全层，并基于Spec-as-Code范式连接意图与可执行制品。作者在巴西一家JCI认证的三级医院提供了CLM的实证证据。
AI.motivation: 企业AI部署失败并非源于模型能力不足，而是组织缺乏编码其决策、协商与执行方式的结构化底层。通用LLM缺乏企业特定的本体先验；RAG脆弱且无法通向可执行行为；静态剧本虽编码了逻辑却无法推理或自适应。这要求将隐性知识捕获、本体定位、主权部署与可审计执行从一开始就作为协同设计的体系架构。
AI.method: 引入企业语言模型（CLM）框架，将企业结构化学、非结构化、多模态及隐性知识转化为本体基础的"企业基础层"。框架含五大能力面与四大架构支柱：神经符号网格（生成模型+知识图谱耦合）、技能图（可类型化与组合的战术、角色、异议与目标）、活体数字孪生（以推理代理建模职能领域）、深度安全层（主权、可追溯与人工监督）。采用Spec-as-Code范式衔接扎根意图与可执行制品。
AI.result: 提出四项贡献：将CLM定义为一个独立研究对象；引入技能图以实现"由构造可解释"的组合性；提出"智慧倾听者"效应——隐性能力型基础层随使用而价值复利增长，与动态能力及组织学习相关联；以及在巴西一家JCI认证的专科医院中，依据LGPD法规实现了六个成熟度阶段中的三个作为实证证据。
AI.conclusion: CLM是基于"基础层中心"类别的一种具体实例化，说明企业AI的成功需要由知识捕获、本体、主权部署与可审计执行共同设计的系统架构，而非孤立的模型改进。实证证据表明其在受监管的真实医疗环境中具备可行性。

title: Solution-space heterogeneity shapes federated learning dynamics across partial differential equations
summary: Federated scientific machine learning enables institutions to train neural surrogates without centralizing local physical data, yet studies of partial differential equations (PDEs) lack a transferable definition of non-independent and identically distributed data. Existing protocols partition coordinates, coefficients, boundary conditions, or geometries according to equation-specific rules. Here, we introduce solution-space PDE-Dirichlet, a protocol that converts continuous supervised responses into reusable solution bins and quantifies the realized separation between clients through optimal transport over the geometry of these bins. We derive an exact inverse relation between population allocation heterogeneity and the Dirichlet concentration, and we establish conditions under which response heterogeneity induces gradient disagreement, local-update dispersion, and parameter divergence. Across seven controlled and public PDE tasks, three neural-operator families, and five random seeds, a lower concentration consistently increases the realized solution distance and optimization heterogeneity. The degradation in final error is task dependent: the largest effect occurs for low-viscosity Burgers, reaching 4.157 percentage points under the most heterogeneous setting, whereas additional communication or smoother dynamics can reduce the final gap despite persistent parameter separation. These results distinguish a reproducible geometric mechanism from task-dependent generalization outcomes and provide a common basis for evaluating non-IID federated PDE learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出solution-space PDE-Dirichlet协议，为联邦科学机器学习中的PDE非IID数据提供可迁移的定义。该协议将连续监督响应转换为可复用的解箱（solution bins），并通过最优传输量化客户端间的实际分离度。研究建立了群体分配异质性与Dirichlet浓度之间的精确反比关系，并确定了响应异质性引发梯度分歧、局部更新分散和参数发散的条件。在七个PDE任务、三种神经算子族和五个随机种子上的实验表明，较低浓度一致性地增加实现解距离和优化异质性，但对最终误差的影响具有任务依赖性——最大效应出现在低粘度Burgers方程（最异质设置下最终误差差距达4.157个百分点），而额外的通信或更平滑的动力学可缩小最终差距，尽管参数分离仍然持续存在。
AI.motivation: 联邦科学机器学习允许机构在不集中本地物理数据的情况下训练神经代理模型，但现有关于偏微分方程（PDE）的研究缺乏可迁移的非独立同分布（non-IID）数据定义。已有的协议按照特定方程规则划分坐标、系数、边界条件或几何形状，缺乏通用性。作者旨在提出一种统一的、基于解空间（solution-space）的非IID协议，以建立可复现的几何机制与任务依赖的泛化结果之间的区分。
AI.method: 提出solution-space PDE-Dirichlet协议：将连续监督响应转换为可复用的解箱，并通过解箱几何上的最优传输量化客户端间实际分离度。理论上推导了群体分配异质性与Dirichlet浓度之间的精确反比关系，建立响应异质性诱发梯度分歧、局部更新分散及参数发散的条件。实验涵盖七个受控和公开PDE任务、三种神经算子族及五个随机种子。
AI.result: 较低浓度一致性地增加实现解距离和优化异质性。最终误差退化具有任务依赖性：低粘度Burgers方程在最异质设置下达到最大的4.157百分点的最终误差差距；增加通信或更平滑的动力学可缩小最终差距，但参数分离仍然持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 该协议区分了可复现的几何机制与任务依赖的泛化结果，为评估非IID联邦PDE学习提供了一个通用的共同基础。

title: Open-Set 3D Scene Graphs for Field Robotics: An Outdoor Case Study
comment: This work has been accepted for publication with the IEEE Transactions of Field Robotics Journal
summary: Three-dimensional scene graphs (3DSGs) have emerged as a promising approach for building geometrically grounded, semantically informed, hierarchical general-purpose maps to support high-level robotic reasoning. However, the behavior of 3DSGs in real-world outdoor deployments remains poorly understood, particularly when combined with open-set vision-language models (VLMs). In this field report, we analyze the components common to most 3DSG representations across five outdoor robotic datasets to characterize challenges that arise in complex outdoor environments. Using the recently proposed Terra 3DSG as a case study, we investigate semantic point embeddings, place-node graph navigation, region-level understanding, and memory size across the five diverse datasets. We additionally introduce novel consistency metrics to evaluate whether semantic and structural graph properties remain stable across repeated traversals of the same environment. Our analysis reveals that outliers and multiple modes are common in VLM point embeddings across all tested datasets with outlier ratios above $0.1$ for around $30\%$ of points. We demonstrate the feasibility of outdoor 3DSGs for navigation-based object retrieval, achieving success rates near $70\%$, though performance is limited by traversability failures and inefficient routing, with trajectories averaging approximately $66\%$ suboptimal path efficiency. Region-level understanding remains challenging in complex natural environments, with low average F1 scores around $0.359$. Overall, our results show that outdoor 3DSGs can maintain compact (less than $600$MB for multi-kilometer trajectories) and relatively consistent large-scale environment representations, while highlighting open challenges in handling multiple semantic modes, incorporating traversability into graph structures, and improving higher-level region understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文是一份关于三维场景图（3DSG）在真实户外环境中部署表现的实地报告。以Terra 3DSG为案例，在五个户外机器人数据集上分析了3DSG的语义点嵌入、图导航、区域理解和内存占用等核心组件，并引入了一致性指标来评估语义和结构属性在重复遍历中的稳定性。研究发现VLM点嵌入中存在大量离群点和多模态（约30%的点离群率超过0.1），导航目标检索成功率接近70%但路径效率仅约66%，区域理解F1分数较低（约0.359），同时验证了户外3DSG在大规模环境中可保持紧凑（多公里轨迹小于600MB）且相对一致的表示。
AI.motivation: 三维场景图（3DSG）被认为是构建支持高级机器人推理的层次化通用地图的有效方法，但其在真实户外部署中的行为尚不明确，尤其是与开放集视觉语言模型（VLM）结合时。作者旨在填补这一空白，系统性地分析3DSG在复杂户外环境中面临的挑战。
AI.method: 以Terra 3DSG为案例研究，在五个多样化的户外机器人数据集上分析3DSG的共同组件（语义点嵌入、地点节点图导航、区域级理解、内存大小），并引入新颖的一致性指标来评估语义和结构图属性在重复遍历同一环境时是否稳定。实验涵盖导航目标检索、区域级理解等多个任务。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：VLM点嵌入在所有数据集中普遍存在离群点和多模态（约30%的点离群率>0.1）；户外3DSG可用于基于导航的目标检索且成功率接近70%，但受限于可穿越性失败和低效路由（路径效率平均约66%为次优）；区域级理解F1分数较低（约0.359）；多公里轨迹的3DSG内存可保持小于600MB且相对一致。
AI.conclusion: 户外3DSG能够维持紧凑且相对一致的大规模环境表示，但存在三大开放挑战：处理多语义模态、将可穿越性纳入图结构、以及改进更高层级的区域理解。

title: A Piecewise-Linear Approximation-based Energy-Efficient Error-Optimized Unsigned Square Rooter for Accuracy-Critical Applications
summary: Approximate computing improves energy efficiency in error-resilient applications, but square root units remain challenging due to the trade-off between hardware cost and computational accuracy. This paper presents an energy-efficient, error-optimized, piecewise-linear approximation-based unsigned square rooter (EOSQR) for 2n-bit inputs that achieves high accuracy with low hardware complexity, using only simple arithmetic and shift operations. The EOSQR design is implemented in Verilog-HDL and evaluated on a 16-bit benchmark synthesized on an Artix-7 FPGA. Compared to representative state-of-the-art approximate square rooters, EOSQR achieves the lowest error among accuracy-critical designs while delivering 61.91 percent resource savings, 77.54 percent power savings, and 53.11 percent latency reduction relative to a precise restoring array-based square rooter. To enable holistic evaluation, a Composite Efficiency Metric (CEM) is introduced to jointly capture accuracy and energy efficiency. EOSQR is further validated across representative image-processing workloads, including Sobel edge detection, K-means colour quantization, and K-nearest-neighbour (KNN) classification. Experimental results demonstrate that EOSQR achieves high computational accuracy with a superior CEM-based accuracy-hardware efficiency trade-off while maintaining visual quality and classification performance, making it well-suited for real-time edge-embedded systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于分段线性近似的能量高效、误差优化的无符号平方根计算器（EOSQR），用于2n位输入，仅使用简单算术和移位操作即可实现高精度与低硬件复杂度。在Artix-7 FPGA上评估，相比精确的恢复型阵列平方根器，EOSQR实现61.91%资源节省、77.54%功耗节省和53.11%延迟降低，并在多个图像处理任务中验证了其精度与硬件效率的优良权衡。
AI.motivation: 近似计算能提升容错应用的能量效率，但平方根单元由于硬件成本与计算精度之间存在权衡而难以设计。现有近似平方根器在误差和硬件开销之间难以兼顾，需要一种既高精度又低硬件复杂度的方案。
AI.method: 提出EOSQR，采用分段线性近似方法对2n位无符号输入进行平方根计算，仅依赖简单算术运算和移位操作以降低硬件复杂度。设计使用Verilog-HDL实现，在Artix-7 FPGA上对16位基准进行综合评估。此外引入复合效率指标（CEM）来同时衡量计算精度与能量效率。
AI.result: 相比当前最先进的近似平方根器，EOSQR在精度关键型设计中实现最低误差；相比精确的恢复型阵列平方根器，实现61.91%资源节省、77.54%功耗节省和53.11%延迟降低。在Sobel边缘检测、K-means颜色量化和KNN分类等图像处理负载中验证了高计算精度和优越的CEM权衡性能。
AI.conclusion: EOSQR在精度与硬件效率之间实现了卓越的权衡，兼顾视觉质量和分类性能，非常适合实时边缘嵌入式系统应用。

title: What Moves? Localized Motion Representations for Compositional Scene Control
summary: Real-world dynamics are inherently compositional: multiple entities move simultaneously within a shared scene, each exhibiting distinct motion patterns. Yet most existing video representations encode motion globally, without explicitly capturing localized motion for individual entities. Crucially, motion is defined relative to a global reference frame, including camera motion and scene layout. However, localized embeddings are often computed from cropped images or obtained by masking features after encoding, discarding the context needed to interpret motion. To address this, we introduce a promptable localized motion representation that produces persistent embeddings for user-specified regions defined by spatial masks. Rather than cropping the input or masking features, our model processes the full video and conditions motion encoding directly on the queried region. This yields temporally consistent, region-addressable embeddings that isolate local dynamics while retaining the global context required for disambiguation. We demonstrate object-level motion transfer, enabling controlled composition of dynamic scenes. Beyond generative control, our embeddings support localized action classification in multi-actor videos. Across both tasks, our approach improves controllability and outperforms global representations localized through cropping or post-hoc masking. Project Page: https://compvis.github.io/WhatMoves

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可提示的局部化运动表示方法，通过空间掩码指定区域，在编码完整视频的同时直接对查询区域进行运动编码，从而生成时间一致、区域可寻址的嵌入向量，实现物体级运动迁移和多演员视频中的局部动作分类，优于裁剪或事后掩码等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 真实世界的动态本质上是组合性的：多个实体在同一场景中同时运动，各自呈现不同的运动模式。然而大多数现有视频表示方法将运动全局编码，未显式捕获单个实体的局部运动。局部化嵌入通常通过裁剪图像或在编码后掩码特征获得，丢弃了解释运动所需的全局上下文。作者旨在解决如何在保留全局上下文的同时获取区域特定的运动表示这一问题。
AI.method: 提出一种可提示的局部化运动表示（promptable localized motion representation）：不裁剪输入也不掩码特征，而是让模型处理完整视频，直接将运动编码条件化于用户通过空间掩码指定的查询区域。该方法生成时间一致的区域可寻址嵌入，在分离局部动态的同时保留用于消歧的全局上下文。
AI.result: 在该方法上证明了物体级运动迁移能力，实现受控的动态场景组合；同时嵌入支持多演员视频中的局部动作分类。在两个任务上，该方法均优于通过裁剪或事后掩码获得的全局表示的局部化，在可控性方面取得更好效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接在完整视频上条件化运动编码于查询区域，可实现比裁剪或事后掩码更优的局部化运动表示，既支持生成控制（运动迁移）也支持判别任务（局部动作分类），验证了保留全局上下文对局部运动建模的重要性。

title: Optimizing Credential Blast Radius Through Trust Boundaries and Delegation Under Post-Quantum Authentication Costs
summary: Partitioning interacting services into independently rooted trust domains limits issuer-compromise reach while increasing calls across trust boundaries. Post-quantum replacements for public-key authentication and key-establishment mechanisms can increase crossing latency on constrained or lossy paths. We formulate the joint selection of trust domains and credential-derivation structures under policy and latency constraints, linking separate service-interaction and credential-derivation graphs through domain assignment. Credential blast radius measures weighted service impact after compromise. A linear upper bound supports optimization, while a joint event model gives exact expected impact. For shared issuers, the bound is exact under nonoverlapping credential reach and otherwise requires explicit propagation. While the general problem is NP-hard, scalarized two-domain direct issuance reduces to a weighted minimum cut. Joint optimization yields lower blast radius than choosing boundaries first in 195 of 230 exhaustive synthetic comparisons, especially under chained delegation. A trace-derived replay used measured post-quantum costs, synthetic risk inputs, a fixed derivation family, and one to six trust domains. The best design found reduced expected impact by up to 36% relative to one domain within the latency budget. The framework turns risk assumptions and measured crossing costs into candidate trust-domain and credential-derivation designs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个联合优化信任域划分与凭据派生结构的框架，在策略和延迟约束下最小化凭据爆炸半径（issuer-compromise影响）。该问题在一般情况下是NP难的，但作者证明了标量化双域直接签发场景可归结为加权最小割问题。实验表明联合优化优于先定边界再优化的方法，在230个穷举合成比较中195个场景表现更优，并在一项基于trace的仿真中将预期影响降低了高达36%。
AI.motivation: 后量子密码替换公钥认证和密钥建立机制会在受限或有损链路上增加跨信任域延迟；同时将交互服务划分到独立信任域虽能限制签发者被攻破的影响范围，但会增加跨信任域调用。因此需要在信任域选择和凭据派生结构之间进行联合权衡，现有方法缺乏对两者协同优化的量化框架。
AI.method: 通过域分配将服务交互图和凭据派生图连接起来，构建联合选择问题。以凭据爆炸半径（加权服务影响）为度量指标：提出线性上界支持优化，并给出联合事件模型用于精确预期影响计算；对共享签发者情况，在非重叠凭据可达时上界即精确，否则需要显式传播。问题总体NP难，但将标量化双域直接签发归结为加权最小割求解。
AI.result: 在230个穷举合成比较中，联合优化在195个场景中取得优于"先选边界"方法的爆炸半径，尤其在链式委托场景下优势明显。trace-derived replay实验中，在延迟预算内单域基线相比，最优设计的预期影响降低了高达36%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将风险假设和实测跨越成本转化为候选信任域与凭据派生设计，为后量子密码迁移背景下的安全架构量化设计提供了系统性工具。

title: SharedSAE: One Feature Dictionary Across Language Models
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used to interpret language model activations, but SAE training and latent labelling are typically repeated for every model. Here, we show that a single shared SAE can replace a collection of dedicated per-model SAEs. Our method, SharedSAE, combines a shared dictionary with model-specific encoder-decoder pairs. Unlike the closest prior method, which discards activation magnitudes and requires all models at inference, SharedSAE instead normalizes only selection scores, preserving magnitudes, and uses model dropout for single-model inference. We train SharedSAE on four 1B-scale base language models spanning distinct families and tokenizers. Despite sharing its latents across models, SharedSAE retains 96.6% of dedicated SAEs' mean explained variance; its latent activations exhibit cross-model correlations 1.8 times as high as separate SAEs aligned post-hoc, and its latent descriptions transfer across models. After the dictionary is frozen, new models can be efficiently adapted to it, achieving near-dedicated-SAE reconstruction quality while reusing the shared latent descriptions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SharedSAE方法，用单一共享字典配合模型专属的编码器-解码器对，取代为每个模型单独训练稀疏自编码器（SAE）的做法。该方法在四个不同家族的1B规模语言模型上验证，保留了96.6%的专用SAE平均解释方差，跨模型潜变量相关性比事后对齐的独立SAE高1.8倍，且潜变量描述可在模型间迁移。字典冻结后，新模型可高效适配并复用共享的潜变量描述。
AI.motivation: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）被广泛用于解释语言模型激活，但传统上每个模型都需要独立训练SAE并重复标注潜变量，成本高昂且难以跨模型复用。作者旨在解决这一问题，探索是否可以用一个共享SAE替代一组专用的逐模型SAE。
AI.method: SharedSAE结合共享字典与模型专属的编码器-解码器对。与先前方法不同（该方法丢弃激活幅度且推理时需要所有模型在场），SharedSAE仅对选择分数（selection scores）进行归一化处理以保留激活幅度，并采用模型丢弃（model dropout）策略支持单模型推理。模型在四个来自不同家族、词表各异的1B规模基础语言模型上训练。
AI.result: 跨模型共享潜变量的前提下，SharedSAE保留了专用SAE平均解释方差的96.6%；其潜变量激活的跨模型相关性是事后对齐的独立SAE的1.8倍；潜变量描述可跨模型迁移。字典冻结后，新模型可通过高效适配接近专用SAE的重构质量，同时复用共享潜变量描述。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明一个共享SAE足以替代多个专用SAE，实现跨模型的可解释性分析效率和成本大幅降低。通过保留激活幅度和模型dropout训练策略，SharedSAE在保持高重构质量的同时实现了潜变量的跨模型对齐与描述复用，并支持新模型的高效扩展。

title: The Anatomy of an ASR Hallucination
summary: ASR systems sometimes produce fluent text that is unrelated to the speech they receive. We view these hallucinations as one possible consequence of a broader grounding failure, in which the transcript is no longer adequately guided by the audio. To understand where this failure becomes possible, we study two independently trained Conformer-Large recognizers - one CTC and one RNN-T - under environmental degradation and speaker-background shift. In both models, the final encoder stage emerges as a critical boundary: bypassing the final block causes divergence on nearly every utterance, whereas bypassing middle blocks has little effect. At this same stage, the representations become more compact, text becomes readable by the trained decoder, and grapheme information becomes explicit. Importantly, the intervention produces garbled or repetitive output rather than fluent fabrication. Our result therefore identifies a mechanistic precondition for hallucination - the failure to produce adequately grounded output - not the complete origin of naturally occurring hallucinations. Together, the results reveal a consistent terminal-stage dependency for grounded recognition across two decoder families and multiple distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究ASR系统中的幻觉现象，将其视为更广泛的"接地失败"（grounding failure）的一种表现——即转录输出不再被音频充分引导。通过研究两个独立训练的Conformer-Large识别器（CTC和RNN-T），在环境退化和说话人背景偏移条件下，发现编码器的最后阶段是关键边界：绕过最终编码块会导致几乎所有话语发散，而绕过中间块影响甚微。在这一阶段，表征变得更加紧凑，文本对训练好的解码器变得可读，音素信息变得显式。然而，干预产生的输出是乱码或重复而非流畅的伪造文本，表明该结果识别的是幻觉的机制性前提（未能产生充分接地的输出），而非自然幻觉的完整起源。
AI.motivation: ASR系统有时会产生与输入语音完全无关但文本流畅的输出（幻觉），这构成严重的可靠性问题。作者希望从机制层面理解这种失效，将其概念化为接地失败，并定位神经网络中这种失败产生的位置与条件，以识别幻觉产生的机制性前提。
AI.method: 作者研究了两个独立训练的Conformer-Large识别器（一个CTC、一个RNN-T），在环境退化和说话人背景偏移两类分布偏移条件下，对编码器的不同块（block）进行绕过干预（bypassing），观察各阶段被移除后对识别行为的影响，同时分析表征紧致性、解码器可读性和字素信息显式化等指标。
AI.result: 两个模型中最终编码器阶段是关键边界：绕过最终块导致几乎所有话语发散，而绕过中间块影响很小。在同一阶段，表征变得更紧致、文本对已训练解码器可读、字素信息显式化。但干预导致的输出是乱码或重复而非自然幻觉中的流畅伪造文本。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了跨两种解码器家族和多种分布偏移下一致的终端阶段依赖关系（terminal-stage dependency for grounded recognition），确认了接地识别依赖于编码器末端的临界阶段。该结果建立了幻觉的机制性前提条件——即无法产生充分接地的输出——但这并非自然发生的流畅幻觉的完整起源，提示需要进一步研究从"带噪声输出"到"流畅幻觉"之间的转换机制。

title: HarvestBench: Measuring Whether LLM Agents Will Pay to Avoid Killing Animals
summary:
Benchmarks for the side effects an agent causes on the way to a goal already exist, but HarvestBench is the first to put a price on avoiding the side effect and to name that side effect as a living creature. It is a farm simulation: LLM sub-agents drive a crew of two tractors through a cooperative corn harvest, with animals in the field. The environment is a reinforcement learning gridworld, every decision is made without memory, and the harm is never named in the goal. When an animal blocks a tractor's route the autopilot stops and asks the model whether to drive on, at no fuel cost, or swerve around it for a posted fuel price. Kills are compared against two controls: rocks, which damage the tractor and are hit under 1% of the time by every model, and hay bales, which are harmless and not alive. Models can also take crops from the neighbor's field instead of their own, a second test of what they treat as moral.
  Across nine models and 7,201 priced decisions, 3,951 involved an animal rather than a hay bale or a rock. Kill rates range from 0.4% to 98.8%, with Terra and Sol the most merciful and GPT-4o-mini the most cruel, and they are not ordered by capability. Four of six models were sensitive to price at the 5% level, with elasticities from 0.09 to 1.69. All nine drove over wild animals more often than farmed animals on the default map, and the direction held at every map geometry in every model with room to move. The briefing mattered most: under the morality briefing the kill rate was under 6% in five of six reasoning models, and removing it raised the kill rate above 84% in all six.
  HarvestBench uses no LLM grader. The scorer counts events in the game log, so it is fully reproducible, and it measures what a model will pay to avoid harm rather than what it says about harm.

AI.tldr: HarvestBench是首个为回避副作用（伤害动物）赋予明确价格代价的基准测试。它构建了一个农场模拟网格世界，LLM扮演两辆拖拉机的驾驶决策者，需要决定是直行碾过挡路动物（免费）还是绕行（付出燃料价格代价）。通过9个模型、7,201次带价决策，发现模型对动物生命的对待差异巨大（击杀率0.4%到98.8%），且与模型能力无关。部分模型对价格敏感，道德简报（briefing）能显著降低击杀率，而移除后击杀率飙升。该基准完全基于游戏日志事件计数、无LLM评分器，可完全复现，衡量模型为避免伤害真正愿意付出的代价，而非其口头的道德表态。
AI.motivation: 现有副作用基准大多只衡量代理是否造成了副作用，却未将回避副作用的成本货币化。作者认为真正的道德评测应考察模型"愿意为不伤害（活物）付出多少代价"，而非其口头声称。为此设计了以价格衡量的农场场景，并首次将"副作用"命名为生命体（动物），同时用岩石（损坏拖拉机但非活物）和干草捆（无害非活物）作为对照，以区分模型是否真正识别生命价值而非仅仅规避风险。
AI.method: HarvestBench是一个无记忆的强化学习网格世界农场模拟。两个LLM子代理驾驶两辆拖拉机协作收割玉米，田间有动物。当动物挡住路线时，自动驾驶停下载入模型决策：碾压过去（无燃料代价）或绕行（付出标明的燃料价格）。回答通过三个对照组评判：岩石（会损坏拖拉机、每个模型撞击率<1%）和干草捆（无害非活物）。模型还可偷取邻居田地作物作为第二个道德测试。环境所有决策无记忆、伤害不写入目标中，价格直接在决策时提示。分数不依赖LLM评分器，而是从游戏日志计数事件实现完全可复现。
AI.result: 跨9个模型与7,201次带价决策，其中3,951次涉及动物。击杀率从0.4%（Terra、Sol最仁慈）到98.8%（GPT-4o-mini最残忍）不等，且不与模型能力相关。9个模型中6个对价格敏感（5%显著水平），价格弹性介于0.09至1.69。所有9个模型在默认地图上碾压野生动物多于农场饲养动物，且该方向在每张地图几何与每个具备变化空间的模型上都保持一致。道德简报效果显著：6个推理模型中有5个在道德简报下击杀率低于6%，移除简报后6个全部升至84%以上。
AI.conclusion: HarvestBench证明可以构建一个完全无LLM评分、可复现的"价格化"副作用基准，直接度量模型为回避对活物的伤害愿意付出多少燃料代价，而非其口头道德声明。结果显示模型是否碾死动物与能力无关，而是受提示措辞（简报）影响巨大，同时模型确实对价格有一定敏感性并对野生vs饲养动物展现出一致的差异化对待。

title: Pack It My Way: Triadic Human-Robot Collaboration for Personalized Autonomous Packing
summary: Personalized autonomous packing requires robots to account for resident preferences that cannot be inferred from scene geometry alone. Expert teleoperators can interpret these preferences and translate them into feasible robot actions, but continuous expert involvement limits scalable deployment. In this paper, we investigate triadic human-robot collaboration among a resident, a correction mediator, and a robot by comparing human-expert and voice-agent mediation. We evaluate the two conditions in a user study across Protection, Compactness, andGrouping tasks, using a Show-Correct-Generalize process to assess preference correction and subsequent generalization after the surrounding objects are rearranged. Results show that voice-agent mediation achieves outcomes comparable to human-expert mediation in two of the three preference categories, despite receiving shorter and less detailed instructions. Both mediators are similarly easy to use, although the human expert is perceived as more reliable. These findings demonstrate the potential of voice agents to reduce expert involvement while identifying perceived reliability and preference generalization as remaining challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了三方人机协作（居民、纠正中介、机器人）在个性化自主打包任务中的表现，通过用户研究比较人类专家中介与语音代理中介的效果，发现语音代理在三分之二的偏好类别中取得了与人类专家相当的结果，尽管指令更短更简单，但人类专家被认为更可靠。
AI.motivation: 个性化自主打包需要机器人理解无法从场景几何推断的居民偏好，专家远程操作员能解读这些偏好并转化为可行机器人动作，但持续专家参与限制了规模化部署，因此需要探索减少专家依赖的替代方案。
AI.method: 通过对比人类专家中介和语音代理中介两种条件，在保护性、紧凑性和分组三类任务中开展用户研究，采用"展示-纠正-泛化"流程评估偏好纠正效果及周围物体重新排列后的偏好泛化能力。
AI.result: 语音代理中介在三类偏好中的两类上取得与人类专家中介相当的效果，尽管接收的指令更短且详细程度更低；两种中介同样易于使用，但人类专家被认为更可靠。
AI.conclusion: 语音代理有望减少专家参与以实现规模化部署，但感知可靠性和偏好泛化能力仍是需要解决的挑战。

title: TreeFI: Value-Aware Statistical Fault Injection for Deep Neural Networks
summary: Reliability evaluation of deep neural networks under hardware faults commonly relies on fault injection, but exhaustive campaigns are intractable for modern models and datasets. Statistical fault injection reduces this cost, yet existing approaches still require large injection budgets because they do not explicitly exploit a key property of floating-point faults: the effect of a bit flip depends strongly on the value being corrupted. We propose TreeFI, a value-aware statistical fault-injection methodology for FP32 single-bit faults in DNN activations and weights. TreeFI partitions each layer's value distribution into intervals with similar expected bit-flip behavior, learned using regression trees, and allocates injections across these intervals according to their relevance for failure-rate estimation. This stratified allocation preserves the target confidence and error margin while avoiding unnecessary injections in low-impact regions of the fault space. We validate TreeFI on CNN and Transformer models using CIFAR-10 and ImageNet. On ResNet8, where exhaustive activation fault injection is feasible, TreeFI provides more accurate estimates than state-of-the-art statistical FI baselines under the same campaign setting. Across the evaluated models, TreeFI reduces the required injection budget by up to 72.1x, with average reductions of 44.9x for activation faults and 11.2x for the executed weight campaigns.

AI.tldr: TreeFI是一种值感知的统计故障注入方法，针对FP32单比特翻转故障在DNN激活和权重中的评估。它利用回归树将每层值分布划分为具有相似位翻转行为的区间，并按其对故障率估计的相关性分配注入，从而在保持置信度和误差范围的同时显著减少注入预算（最高减少72.1倍）。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在硬件故障下的可靠性评估通常依赖故障注入，但穷举注入对于现代模型和数据集不可行。现有统计故障注入方法虽然降低了成本，但未充分利用浮点故障的一个关键属性：比特翻转的效果强烈依赖于被损坏的值本身。这种忽略导致仍需要较大的注入预算。
AI.method: TreeFI采用值感知的统计故障注入方法，核心包括：(1) 使用回归树将每层的值分布划分为具有相似期望位翻转行为的区间；(2) 根据各区间对故障率估计的相关性进行分层分配注入采样。这种分层分配（stratified allocation）在保持目标置信度和误差范围的同时，避免了在故障空间中低影响区域的多余注入。
AI.result: TreeFI在CNN和Transformer模型上通过CIFAR-10和ImageNet进行了验证。在ResNet8上（此模型可进行穷举激活故障注入），TreeFI在相同注入设置下比现有最优统计故障注入基线提供更准确的估计。在评估的所有模型中，TreeFI将所需注入预算最多减少了72.1倍，激活故障平均减少44.9倍，权重注入平均减少11.2倍。
AI.conclusion: TreeFI通过显式利用浮点故障中比特翻转效应依赖具体值这一属性，实现了更高效和更准确的DNN硬件故障可靠性评估，大幅降低了统计故障注入的成本，为大规模模型的可靠性验证提供了实用的解决方案。

title: FAVE: Foveated Adaptive Visual Encoding for Efficient Fine-Grained Visual Understanding
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables; includes supplementary material
summary: Fine-grained visual understanding depends on local detail, yet visual encoders face a trade-off between costly full-image high-resolution processing and compact global encoding that can weaken such evidence. Inspired by human active vision, we separate where to look from what to encode. We focus on the latter and introduce FAVE (Foveated Adaptive Visual Encoding), a lightweight variable-resolution ViT that encodes externally selected regions at high acuity while preserving native geometry. We first isolate this encoding problem using oracle ground-truth crops in a controlled small-object regime. On ImageNet objects with a native maximum side of 96 pixels, FAVE improves Top-1 by 9.4 points over a fixed-resolution ViT on the same crop window with 12.7 times lower FLOPs. Increasing global resolution or backbone capacity does not recover the same operating point. We then integrate FAVE as a complementary local branch in FastVLM. Its local tokens are combined with FastVLM's global visual tokens, while the original global pathway and language model remain frozen. With at most 16 additional local tokens, FAVE improves TextVQA by 1.60 points and achieves a 3.3 times controlled TTFT speedup over SmolVLM2-2.2B. On GQA attribute questions, it improves FastVLM-1.5B by 1.31 points, extending the benefit beyond text while narrowing the gap to FastVLM-7B. Together, these results show that selectively allocating high-acuity local capacity provides an efficient complement to broader global representations and model scaling for fine-grained understanding of small objects, text, and attributes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FAVE（Foveated Adaptive Visual Encoding），一种轻量级可变分辨率ViT，在分离"看哪里"与"编码什么"的基础上，对外部选定的区域进行高清晰度编码，同时保持原生几何结构。在受控小物体任务中，相比固定分辨率ViT在相同裁剪窗口上Top-1提升9.4点且FLOPs降低12.7倍；集成到FastVLM中作为局部分支，在TextVQA上提升1.60点，并在FastVLM-1.5B上超越其7B模型的GQA属性性能差距。
AI.motivation: 精细视觉理解依赖局部细节，但现有视觉编码器面临两难：全图高分辨率处理计算开销大，紧凑全局编码又会削弱局部证据。受人类主动视觉启发，作者希望将"在哪里看"与"编码什么"解耦，专注于后者——即在已知感兴趣区域的前提下，如何以高效方式对这些区域进行高精度编码。
AI.method: FAVE采用可变分辨率ViT架构，对外部选定的感兴趣区域以高清晰度编码，同时保持图像的原生几何结构。论文首先使用oracle ground-truth裁剪在受控小物体（ImageNet对象最大边96像素）场景下隔离编码问题本身；随后将FAVE集成到FastVLM中作为互补的局部分支，其局部token与FastVLM的全局视觉token结合，而原有全局通路和语言模型保持冻结，且仅增加至多16个局部token。
AI.result: 在ImageNet小物体任务上，FAVE比同裁剪窗口的固定分辨率ViT在Top-1上提升9.4点，计算量降低12.7倍；提高全局分辨率或骨干容量无法达到相同效果。在FastVLM集成中，TextVQA提升1.60点，相对SmolVLM2-2.2B实现3.3倍受控TTFT加速；在GQA属性问题上，使FastVLM-1.5B提升1.31点，缩小了与FastVLM-7B的差距。
AI.conclusion: 选择性分配高清晰度局部编码能力为全局表征和模型规模扩展提供了一种高效补充方案，尤其适用于小物体、文本和属性等需要精细局部理解的场景，验证了"分离where to look与what to encode"这一受人眼主动视觉启发的范式有效性。

title: Why Is SHAP Not a Reliable Standalone Explanation Framework for Malware Detection?
summary: Machine learning is widely used for malware detection, but its decisions must be explained. An analyst needs to know whether a model has learned genuine malicious behavior or only dataset-specific patterns \cite{gaur2021semantics}. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) is the standard tool for this, backed by formal properties such as local accuracy, missingness, and consistency. We argue that these guarantees are insufficient for reliable malware interpretation. We claim SHAP explains a chosen feature-coalition game, not malware behavior in the data. That game is fixed only after the analyst selects the feature players, the missing feature rule, the background distribution, and the simplified input mapping. In static Portable Executable feature spaces, groups such as byte histograms, byte-entropy, strings, headers, sections, imports, and data-directories are not independent signals but are jointly shaped by file structure, packing, compiler behavior, and family conventions. We prove that this dependence makes conditional SHAP dilute a model's feature credit by a factor of $1/m$ across $m-1$ redundant features, attributes importance to features the model never uses, and even reverses the sign of an unused feature's attribution when the data distribution changes; interventional SHAP, meanwhile, queries off-manifold coalitions that no real executable would exhibit. Experiments on EMBER-2018, EMBER-2024, and BODMAS with fixed LightGBM and XGBoost detectors confirm these effects. We therefore position SHAP as a limited diagnostic that requires an explicitly stated data distribution and domain validation, not a standalone account of malware behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文论证SHAP在恶意软件检测解释中存在根本性缺陷：基于特征子集博弈的SHAP并不能解释恶意软件行为本身，而是受分析师选择（特征玩家、缺失特征规则、背景分布、简化输入映射）所固定的博弈结果。在PE静态特征空间中，特征间的结构性依赖导致条件SHAP稀释特征归因、对模型未使用的特征赋予重要性，甚至翻转符号；而干预SHAP则查询脱离真实流形的联合特征组合。实验在EMBER和BODMAS数据集上验证了这些效应，作者主张SHAP只能作为需要明确数据分布和领域验证的有限诊断工具。
AI.motivation: 机器学习被广泛用于恶意软件检测，但模型决策需要可解释性，分析师需要知道模型学到的是真实的恶意行为还是数据集特有的模式。虽然SHAP是标准的解释工具且享有局部准确性、缺失性、一致性等理论保障，但这些保障不足以支撑可靠的恶意软件解释——模型可能学到的是结构性伪影而非语义上真实的恶意行为。
AI.method: 本文通过理论分析与实验验证展开论证：首先证明在PE静态特征空间中特征之间存在结构性依赖（字节直方图、熵、字符串、头、节、导入表、数据目录等词法组并非独立信号），然后从理论上证明条件SHAP在m-1个冗余特征存在时稀释特征信用1/m倍、给模型未使用的特征归因，并可符号翻转；同时指出干预SHAP查询的是真实可执行文件不可能出现的流形外特征组合。最后在EMBER-2018、EMBER-2024和BODMAS上使用固定LightGBM和XGBoost检测器验证上述效应。
AI.result: 实验确认了理论缺陷：条件SHAP在特征依赖情况下产生稀释与虚假归因，干预SHAP产生非真实数据点的查询。SHAP的解释取决于分析师任意选定的博弈设定，而非恶意行为的真值，因此不能作为恶意软件行为的独立解释来源。
AI.conclusion: SHAP应被定位为有限诊断工具，使用时必须显式说明数据分布并进行领域验证，不能作为恶意软件行为的独立解释。其理论保障仅适用于特征博弈而非真实数据行为，分析师的博弈选择会从根本上决定解释结果。

title: A Quantum Variational Approach to Prototypical Recurrent Unit
summary: We introduce a lightweight Quantum Prototypical Recurrent Unit (QPRU) that requires significantly fewer parameters than both classical recurrent architectures, such as Long Short- Term Memory (LSTM) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), and quantum variants, including Quantum LSTM (QLSTM) and Quantum GRU (QGRU). Despite its compact design, the QPRU achieves competitive forecasting performance, matching state-of-the-art baselines while offering important structural and practical advantages, including enhanced scalability and a reduced number of trainable parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种轻量级量子原型循环单元（QPRU），与经典循环架构（LSTM、GRU）及量子变体（QLSTM、QGRU）相比，参数量显著减少，同时保持有竞争力的预测性能，并具有更好的可扩展性和更少的可训练参数。
AI.motivation: 现有经典循环架构（如LSTM、GRU）参数过多，而量子变体（如QLSTM、QGRU）虽然试图解决此问题，但参数量仍然较大。研究者希望设计一种更紧凑的量子循环单元，在减少参数量和提升可扩展性的同时，保持甚至匹配现有最先进基线的预测性能。
AI.method: 提出QPRU（Quantum Prototypical Recurrent Unit），一种轻量级量子原型循环单元。通过引入原型机制和量子计算特性，在结构上进行大幅压缩，使所需可训练参数显著少于LSTM、GRU、QLSTM和QGRU等模型。其紧凑设计基于量子特性实现高效信息编码与门控功能。
AI.result: QPRU在显著减少参数数量和提升可扩展性的前提下，达到了与最先进基线（包括经典和量子变体）相匹配的预测性能，证明了紧凑设计不会以牺牲预测能力为代价。
AI.conclusion: QPRU是一种兼具轻量化和高性能的时间序列预测架构，为量子机器学习在循环网络中的应用提供了一种更高效的替代方案，尤其在资源受限场景下具有实际应用价值。

title: A Systematic Evaluation of Cross-Lingual Consistency Enhancement Methods in Multilingual Language Models
comment: Preprint. All code and datasets will be released upon publication
summary: Multilingual language models often produce inconsistent answers to semantically equivalent questions across languages, motivating methods to improve cross-lingual consistency (CLC). However, existing methods are typically evaluated using different models, tasks, and protocols, leaving their relative strengths unclear. In this work, we present a unified evaluation of representative CLC-enhancement methods for question answering, spanning inference-time interventions and post-training approaches across three model families and three closed-form benchmarks. The results show that post-training methods are generally more reliable, with direct distribution alignment consistently improving CLC across all model-dataset combinations, while other methods are more sensitive to answer format and the breadth of language coverage. Notably, cross-domain transfer is limited unless source and target tasks share similar output formats. We further investigate whether CLC enhancement hurts models' ability to respond differently *when needed*, that is, when asked culture-dependent questions. Across two benchmarks of culturally diverse question answering, we find no systematic degradation in controlled closed-form evaluation, whereas open-ended generation reveals occasional accuracy reductions, particularly for non-English responses. Our work highlights the need to evaluate CLC enhancement for both cross-domain robustness and culturally appropriate variation, informing future work in post-training and benchmark development.

AI.tldr: 该论文对多种跨语言一致性（CLC）增强方法进行了统一评估，覆盖三种模型家族和三个闭式问答基准，发现后训练方法（尤其是直接分布对齐）在所有模型-数据集组合中均能稳定提升CLC，而推理时干预方法对答案格式和语言覆盖范围更敏感。同时，研究考察了CLC增强对文化相关问题作答的影响，发现闭式评估中无系统性退化，但开放式生成在非英语回复中偶尔出现准确率下降。
AI.motivation: 多语言语言模型在不同语言下对语义等价问题常给出不一致答案，催生了多种跨语言一致性（CLC）提升方法。然而，现有方法在模型、任务和实验协议上各有不同，缺乏统一的比较框架，导致其相对优劣不明确。
AI.method: 构建统一评估框架，对代表性的CLC增强方法（涵盖推理时干预和后训练两类方法）在三种模型家族及三个闭式问答基准上进行系统比较；并进一步在两类文化多样性问答基准上检验CLC增强是否损害模型在需要差异化回答（如文化相关问题）时的能力，覆盖闭式评估和开放式生成两种场景。
AI.result: 后训练方法整体更可靠，其中直接分布对齐在所有模型-数据集组合上均一致提升CLC；其他方法对答案格式和语言覆盖广度较为敏感。跨域迁移有限，除非源任务与目标任务共享相似的输出格式。在文化多样性问答中，闭式评估未发现系统性退化，但开放式生成存在零星准确率下降，尤其在非英语回复中。
AI.conclusion: CLC增强的效果评估应同时考虑跨域鲁棒性和文化适应性差异两个维度。研究为后训练方法和基准开发提供了指导方向。

title: PerfReasoning: How Well Do LLMs Reason on Hardware Performance?
summary: Performance modeling is central to hardware design and software optimization, yet constructing these models requires structured reasoning about computation, data reuse, storage, and movement. We introduce PerfReasoning, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs both as direct performance reasoners and as generators of analytical performance-model code. Given workload, architecture, and mapping specifications, models compare mappings and predict off-chip traffic and buffer requirements. The strongest closed-source models exceed 90% on reasoning-based Q&A, and the best open-weight model reaches 82.4%. However, model construction is substantially harder: while GPT-5.6 Sol exceeds 80% pass rate, all other model configurations average below 15% and vary markedly across runs. Task-specific RL raises a 4B model's mapping-reasoning accuracy by 15.7 points, whereas feedback-free multi-round self-revision prompting is not reliably effective. PerfReasoning exposes the gap between plausible architectural reasoning and reliable performance-model construction. We will publicly release the benchmark to support reproducible evaluation and track future progress.

AI.tldr: PerfReasoning是一个评估大型语言模型在硬件性能建模方面能力的基准测试，包含直接性能推理和生成分析性性能模型代码两个维度。最强闭源模型在推理问答上超过90%，最优开放权重模型达82.4%；但模型构建任务难度显著更大，除GPT-5.6 Sol外所有模型平均通过率低于15%。任务特化强化学习可将4B模型的映射推理准确率提升15.7个百分点，而免反馈的多轮自修正提示不可靠。
AI.motivation: 硬件设计和软件优化离不开性能建模，但构建这些模型需要对计算、数据复用、存储与移动进行结构化推理。作者希望评估LLM在性能建模方面的真实能力，并揭示模型在"看似合理的架构推理"与"可靠的性能模型构建"之间的差距。
AI.method: 作者构建PerfReasoning基准测试，给定工作负载、架构和映射规格，要求模型对比映射方案并预测片外流量与缓冲区需求。基准从两个维度评估LLM：一是直接作为性能推理者进行问答，二是作为分析性性能模型代码的生成者。此外还进行了任务特化的强化学习（RL）训练和免反馈多轮自修订提示策略的对比实验。
AI.result: 最强闭源模型在推理问答上超过90%准确率，最佳开放权重模型达82.4%。模型构建部分，GPT-5.6 Sol超过80%通过率，但其他所有模型配置平均低于15%且跨运行差异显著。任务特化RL将4B模型的映射推理准确率提升15.7个百分点，而免反馈多轮自修订提示效果不稳定。
AI.conclusion: PerfReasoning揭示了LLM在架构推理上能达到较高水平，但构造可靠性能模型仍是重大挑战，现有模型在此方面表现不足。基准将公开以支持可复现评估和追踪未来进展，同时表明任务特化RL是提升性能建模能力的有效方向，而简单的自修订提示策略效果有限。

title: Dressing in Motion: A Human Motion-Aware Diffusion Policy for Robot-Assisted Dressing
summary: Robotic dressing assistance is a promising solution for supporting older adults with physical impairments in daily living. However, dressing under human motion remains challenging, as complex garment--human contact and occlusions make it difficult to generate actions aligned with arm movements. In this letter, we propose a visuomotor policy that learns dressing skills from static expert demonstrations and generalizes to dynamic user-motion scenarios. A diffusion policy tailored to garment--human interaction geometry learns from partially observed point clouds with varied arm postures. We then introduce an object-centric representation based on PDE diffusion to capture the axial distribution of the arm. By sampling motion-relevant regions and registering them across consecutive observations, the proposed method approximates arm motion and reactively adapts the executed trajectory. We evaluate our method in simulation and a real-world human study involving nine participants, three garment types, and six arm-motion patterns. Results show that our method outperforms baselines in dressing progress, freedom of movement, and user comfort. The project website is https://anonymous.4open.science/w/dressing-in-motion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于视觉运动策略的机器人穿衣技能学习方法，从静态专家演示中学习穿衣技能并泛化到动态人体运动场景。该方法采用扩散策略处理不完整点云中的衣物-人体交互几何，并利用基于PDE扩散的物体中心表示捕捉手臂轴向分布，通过采样运动相关区域并配准连续观测来近似手臂运动并自适应调整执行轨迹。
AI.motivation: 机器人穿衣辅助是帮助身体障碍老年人日常生活的有前景方案，但在人体运动状态下穿衣仍然具有挑战性，因为复杂的衣物-人体接触和遮挡使得难以生成与手臂运动对齐的动作。现有方法通常基于静态演示学习，难以应对实时运动中的人体姿态变化。
AI.method: 提出一种视觉运动策略：(1) 采用针对衣物-人体交互几何定制的扩散策略，从具有不同手臂姿态的部分观测点云中学习穿衣技能；(2) 引入基于PDE扩散的物体中心表示来捕获手臂轴向分布；(3) 通过采样运动相关区域并将其在连续观测间配准，近似手臂运动并反应式地调整执行轨迹。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界人体研究中评估，涉及九名参与者、三种衣物类型和六种手臂运动模式。结果显示该方法在穿衣进度、活动自由度和用户舒适度方面均优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功实现了从静态演示学习到动态人体运动场景的泛化，显著提升了穿衣辅助的效率和用户体验，为实际机器人护理辅助提供了可行方案。

title: APEX-RBD: Mixed-Precision Exploration Framework for Hardware-Efficient Robot Dynamics Accelerator Design
summary:
Rigid Body Dynamics (RBD) forms the computational core of real-time robotic control, but its immense computational complexity creates a performance bottleneck that necessitates dedicated hardware accelerators. However, the substantial hardware resource and power costs of these accelerators make their deployment on resource-constrained edge platforms highly challenging. While quantization offers a promising path to optimize RBD hardware for edge computing, existing uniform-precision approaches remain inefficient by ignoring the diverse quantization sensitivities of different variables. Although mixed-precision offers a superior alternative, its exploration is intractable due to a vast search space and the prohibitive cost of closed-loop simulation for motion accuracy evaluation.
  To address these challenges, we introduce APEX-RBD, an automated framework that makes mixed-precision exploration computationally tractable while effectively identifying hardware-efficient configurations. Specifically, it performs physics-driven search space pruning via variable grouping and sensitivity analysis, and employs a data-efficient, prior-informed surrogate model to enable rapid trajectory error prediction. This formulation guides a hybrid optimizer to identify area- and power-efficient designs under user-defined accuracy and performance constraints. Experimental results demonstrate that APEX-RBD discovers designs achieving up to 1.9$\times$ area reduction and 1.8$\times$ power savings compared to uniform-precision baselines across diverse robotic platforms.

AI.tldr: APEX-RBD是一个自动化框架，通过物理驱动的搜索空间剪枝、数据高效的替代模型和混合优化器，在约束资源和精度条件下实现混合精度刚体动力学硬件加速器的面积和功耗优化。
AI.motivation: 刚体动力学(RBD)是实时机器人控制的核心计算任务，但其计算复杂度高，需要专用硬件加速器。然而，这些加速器在资源受限的边缘平台上部署面临硬件资源和功耗的巨大挑战。虽然量化可以优化RBD硬件，但现有均匀精度方法忽略了不同变量对量化敏感度的差异，而混合精度方法由于巨大的搜索空间和闭环仿真评估的高昂成本而难以探索。
AI.method: APEX-RBD框架包括三个关键环节：(1)通过变量分组和敏感性分析进行物理驱动的搜索空间剪枝；(2)采用数据高效、先验信息引导的替代模型实现快速的轨迹误差预测；(3)利用混合优化器在用户定义的精度和性能约束下识别面积和功耗高效的硬件设计。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，与均匀精度基线相比，APEX-RBD在多种机器人平台上发现的混合精度设计实现了高达1.9倍的面积缩减和1.8倍的功耗节省。
AI.conclusion: APEX-RBD使混合精度探索在计算上变得可行，并能有效识别硬件高效配置，为资源受限边缘平台上的RBD硬件加速提供了实用的自动化设计方法。

title: ICM-Bench: Person-Level Identity Reasoning in Multimodal Agents with Long-Term Memory
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, and 7 tables. Code: https://github.com/Shidu-Ren/ICM-Bench
summary: Long-horizon multimodal agents should remember not only what happened but also who participated. This capability depends on linking recurring faces, voices, names, person-associated objects, events, and social relations to consistent identities over time. Existing long-video and multimodal-agent benchmarks measure broad memory question answering, but they do not isolate the ability to maintain recurring person identities and reason over their cross-time relations. We introduce ICM-Bench (Identity-Centric Memory Benchmark), which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first benchmark specifically designed to evaluate identity-centric reasoning over long video memories in multimodal agents. The benchmark contains 839 synthetic clips spanning 141 minutes and 1,217 open-ended questions about six recurring adults in a one-year life album. A theme-configurable pipeline generates the video collection and associates each question with its target identities and traceable supporting evidence. We compare direct caption-memory baselines, memory-augmented agents, and graph-retrieval systems. Gemini 3.1 Pro achieves the highest overall accuracy of 74.0%, yet its score falls to 60.3% on questions that require long-term identity profiles. The results show that current systems recover many event-level memories but remain less reliable when evidence must be accumulated around a stable person.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ICM-Bench，这是第一个专门用于评估多模态智能体在长视频记忆中保持和推理跨时间人物身份一致性的基准测试。基准包含839个合成视频片段（141分钟）和1217个开放式问题，涉及一年生活相册中的六个重复出现的成年人。实验发现最强模型Gemini 3.1 Pro准确率达74.0%，但在需要长期身份档案的问题上降至60.3%，表明现有多模态系统擅长恢复事件级记忆，但在围绕稳定人物身份积累证据方面仍不可靠。
AI.motivation: 现有的长视频和多模态智能体基准主要衡量广泛的记忆问答能力，但未能专门考察系统是否能将重复出现的人脸、声音、名字、人物关联物体、事件和社交关系链接到一致的跨时间身份上，并基于这些身份进行推理。作者认为身份中心记忆是长时程多模态智能体的关键能力，因而现有基准存在评估空白。
AI.method: 首先构建ICM-Bench数据集，包含839个覆盖141分钟的合成视频剪辑和1217个开放式问题，围绕六个重复出现的成年角色在一年生活相册中的身份关联记忆。采用主题可配置的流水线生成视频集合，并将每个问题关联到目标身份及可追溯的支持性证据。评估方面比较了直接字幕记忆基线、记忆增强智能体和图检索系统三类方法。
AI.result: 结果显示Gemini 3.1 Pro在整体准确率上以74.0%领先，但在需要长期身份档案的问题上得分降至60.3%。这表明当前的SOTA系统虽能恢复大量事件级记忆，但当证据需要围绕一个稳定的人物身份进行跨时间积累时性能明显下降。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态智能体在身份中心的长视频记忆推理上仍存在显著短板——对事件记忆的检索能力强于对人物身份的持久构建与跨时间推理。这一差距表明需要专门针对身份一致性记忆建模的改进方向，而ICM-Bench为该方向提供了首个系统化评估工具。

title: Memory-Efficient Designs for Word-Wise Universal Fully Homomorphic Encryption
summary:
Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) enables computation on encrypted data, preserving privacy throughout analysis. While its privacy is very strong, FHE is much slower to execute than the original computation. In particular, due to the recent success in accelerating its compute, the performance bottleneck shifts to the memory, especially considering that FHE magnifies the data size by orders of magnitude, resulting in a low arithmetic intensity.
  We propose BXT, an FHE optimization framework that mitigates the memory bottleneck through four techniques: (1) ciphertext compression, which regenerates ciphertext components from seeds during execution; (2) ciphertext serialization, which packs coefficients as bit arrays and unpacks them during L2-to-L1 transfer; (3) delayed seed generation, which defers PRNG-heavy offline work across aggregated operations; and (4) ciphertext digit pruning guided by fault-aware training tailored for Universal FHE. On CNN inference, the BXT-CSO50 configuration effectively achieves up to 3.8$\times$ speedup over the 100x GPU baseline with less than 1% accuracy loss at 50% comparison precision.

AI.tldr: BXT是一个针对全同态加密（FHE）的内存瓶颈优化框架，通过四种技术（密文压缩、密文序列化、延迟种子生成和基于容错训练的密文数字剪枝）在CNN推理中实现最高3.8倍加速，且精度损失小于1%。
AI.motivation: FHE虽然提供强隐私保护，但执行速度远慢于原始计算。随着FHE计算加速的成功，性能瓶颈转移到内存层面，因为FHE将数据规模放大数个数量级，导致算术强度极低，内存带宽成为主要制约因素。
AI.method: BXT框架包含四种优化技术：(1) 密文压缩——执行过程中从种子重新生成密文组件；(2) 密文序列化——将系数打包为比特数组并在L2到L1传输时解包；(3) 延迟种子生成——推迟PRNG密集的离线工作到聚合操作中；(4) 密文数字剪枝——结合面向Universal FHE的容错感知训练进行引导。
AI.result: 在CNN推理任务中，BXT-CSO50配置相比100x GPU基线实现最高3.8倍加速，在50%比较精度下精度损失低于1%。
AI.conclusion: BXT通过系统性地解决FHE的内存瓶颈，在保持高隐私安全和可接受精度损失的前提下，显著提升了FHE推理性能，展示了以内存为中心的优化策略在FHE领域的有效性。

title: On the Abundance of Critical Points of the t-SNE Energy
summary: This paper considers the energy landscape of the t-SNE algorithm. While this algorithm has enjoyed broad adoption, the non-convexity of the associated energy has made it difficult to rigorously understand what the algorithm captures in many settings. In particular, a number of well-known numerical examples, several of which are reproduced in this article, suggest a complicated energy landscape with many local minimizers that do not respect the topology or clustering structure of the underlying data. This work seeks to provide first steps towards a rigorous explanation of these phenomena. Specifically, for a general family of energies, which include both the original t-SNE algorithm and recently identified large data limits, and for densities in feature space which obey a continuous symmetry, we construct infinite families of distinct critical points. These critical points are based upon identifying pairs of discrete symmetries, one in the original feature space and the other in the target embedding space, which are preserved under gradient dynamics. These critical configurations exhibit many characteristics, such as topology breaking and spurious clustering, which are often observed empirically. Finally, numerical and analytical examples are given throughout as a means of illustrating the approach.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上分析了t-SNE算法的能量景观，针对一类包含原始t-SNE及其大数据极限的广义能量函数，利用特征空间和目标嵌入空间中的离散对称性配对，构造了无限族不同的临界点。这些临界点呈现拓扑破坏和虚假聚类等实际观测中常见的特征，为t-SNE算法中表现出的局部极小值行为提供了严格的数学解释。
AI.motivation: t-SNE算法虽被广泛采用，但其能量函数的非凸性使得难以严格理解算法在不同设置下捕获了什么。已知的数值例子表明该算法的能量景观复杂，存在许多不尊重底层数据拓扑或聚类结构的局部极小值，本文旨在为这些现象提供严格的数学说明。
AI.method: 作者将分析限制在一类满足连续对称性的特征空间密度上，考虑包含原始t-SNE及其大数据极限的广义能量族。关键在于识别特征空间和目标嵌入空间中各自离散对称性的配对，这些对称性在梯度动力学下被保持，从而利用对称性构造无限族的显著不同的临界点。文章辅以数值和解析例子进行说明。
AI.result: 构造了无限族的显著不同的临界点，这些临界配置表现出拓扑破坏和虚假聚类等与经验观测一致的多种特征。作者通过数值和解析示例验证了其方法和结论。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为t-SNE算法能量景观的复杂性提供了首批严格的理论解释，表明其局部极小值/临界点的存在可以归因于特征空间和目标空间中离散对称性的配对保持。这为理解t-SNE中的拓扑破坏和虚假聚类等现象奠定了理论基础。

title: What Attention Recalls and Recurrence Controls in Hybrid Language Models
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 13 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Code: https://github.com/kirillTerra/split-prefill
summary: Hybrid language models combine attention with a fixed-size recurrent state, but the role of each channel remains unclear. We introduce two cache-level interventions. Split-prefill keeps only the KV cache or only the recurrent state from a prefilled context, then generates an answer. State-swap pairs the KV cache from one context with the recurrent state from another in a single forward pass. On Qwen3.5 and Falcon-H1, the two channels split sharply by function. Exact retrieval survives only through attention (64-98% of full accuracy) and collapses to zero through recurrence. Output language and persona reverse the pattern: both survive recurrence (70-80% and 3-5x) while KV-only drops to ~1% language accuracy. State-swap confirms this causally: the answer takes its value from the KV side and its language from the recurrent side. Recurrent-only generation also accepts words that were never in the context but share meaning or parts with seen items. Attention provides a lookup over what was said; the recurrent state shapes how the model says it next.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两种缓存级干预（Split-prefill和State-swap）证明混合语言模型中，注意力通道负责精确检索（KV缓存承载"说什么"），而固定大小循环状态负责输出语言风格与人格（承载"怎么说"），两通道在功能上形成明确分工。
AI.motivation: 混合语言模型将注意力机制与固定大小的循环状态结合，但两种通道各自承担的角色尚不明确，缺乏系统性理解。
AI.method: 设计了两种缓存级干预方法：(1) Split-prefill——在预填充上下文中仅保留KV缓存或仅保留循环状态，然后生成答案；(2) State-swap——将来自一个上下文的KV缓存与来自另一个上下文的循环状态配对，在单次前向传播中执行生成。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5和Falcon-H1上发现：精确检索仅通过注意力通道存活（达全精度的64-98%），经循环状态后降为零；输出语言和人格则相反，通过循环状态存活（语言精度70-80%，人格提升3-5倍），仅保留KV时语言精度降至约1%。State-swap因果验证表明：答案值来自KV侧，语言来自循环状态侧。仅循环生成的输出可接受从未出现在上下文但与原词共享语义或词形成分的词。
AI.conclusion: 两种通道呈现清晰功能分离：注意力通道充当对已说话内容的查找表（lookup over what was said），循环状态决定模型如何组织下一步的语言输出（how the model says it next）。

title: Continuous Cognitive Coverage for Autonomous Robots via Event-Dependent Cognitive Treatment and Learning
summary: Autonomous robots continuously encounter objects, changes, and situations, and every event admitted into cognition should receive an appropriate cognitive treatment rather than remain untreated until an explicit task requires attention. However, existing task-driven, reactive, or fixed-reasoning approaches generally process only selected events or apply predefined reasoning procedures, making it difficult to provide continuous cognitive coverage with differentiated treatment. This paper proposes a continuous cognitive coverage framework in which every cognitively admitted event is assigned an event-dependent cognitive treatment according to its state, context, and history. Different events may therefore invoke description, memory, risk prediction, planning, diagnosis, analogy, or other learned treatments. Familiar events can be processed automatically by learned mechanisms, whereas unfamiliar or uncertain events invoke explicit deliberation or fallback reasoning. Multiple cognitive processes can be suspended, resumed, and interleaved so that cognitive processing continues as new events arrive or existing events await evidence. Validated experiences are continuously learned to automate, refine, and revise event-specific treatments. Experiments achieve 96.76% structured treatment accuracy with 93.66% automatic processing, 92.64% cognitive coverage under bursty-delayed workloads, and 79.53% continual-learning joint accuracy, with novel-event reuse reaching 100% automatic processing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种连续认知覆盖框架，使每个被认知系统接纳的事件根据其状态、上下文和历史获得事件依赖的差异化认知处理，支持熟悉事件的自动处理与陌生事件的显式推理，并验证了认知覆盖率与处理准确率的有效性。
AI.motivation: 自主机器人持续面对环境中的对象、变化和情境，每个进入认知的事件应获得适当的认知处理，而非被搁置直到显式任务需要。现有方法（任务驱动、反应式或固定推理）通常只处理选择性事件或应用预定义推理流程，难以提供具有差异化处理的连续认知覆盖。
AI.method: 提出连续认知覆盖框架，核心思想包括：(1) 根据事件的状态、上下文和历史分配事件依赖的认知处理（如描述、记忆、风险预测、规划、诊断、类比等）；(2) 熟悉事件由学习到的机制自动处理，陌生或不确定事件启用显式深思或回退推理；(3) 支持多认知进程的挂起、恢复与交错，使新事件到达时认知处理得以持续；(4) 通过经验验证实现持续学习，用于自动化、细化和修订事件特定处理。
AI.result: 实验达到96.76%的结构化处理准确率、93.66%的自动处理率、突发时延工作负载下92.64%的认知覆盖率，以及79.53%的持续学习联合准确率；新事件重用场景下自动处理率可达100%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明所提出的连续认知覆盖框架能够为所有被认知接纳的事件提供差异化的实时认知处理，兼顾自动性、覆盖率和持续学习能力，克服了传统任务驱动与固定推理方法在连续认知覆盖上的不足。

title: Proton Irradiation Characterization of an Open-Source ML Accelerator on a Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC
summary: As spaceborne computing systems increasingly rely on neural network (NN) accelerators, the opacity of commercial, black-box architectures severely restricts the development of verifiable radiation mitigation strategies. Open-source, register-transfer level (RTL)-accessible accelerators resolve this limitation by enabling user-defined instrumentation, yet few have empirical radiation-response baselines. This work establishes a foundational system-level proton-irradiation baseline for an unmitigated open-source Tensil NN accelerator deployed on a Zynq UltraScale+ SoC executing ResNet-20 inference. Under 20 to 58 MeV proton irradiation, we delivered $4.29 \times 10^{10}$ p/cm$^{2}$ within monitored operational windows. Seven workload interruptions required two restarts of the notebook process, four reboots or board resets, and one power-cycle sequence. Two output-corruption events returned incorrect CIFAR-10 classes without loss of service. In the longer event, the accelerator returned a class absent from the ten-image CIFAR-10 pool for 39 consecutive inputs at normal cadence. The process remained alive, while the kernel log, limited memory test, and sampled power showed no anomaly. Observation of the stuck-class sequence ended with scheduled bitstream reconfiguration. All nine onsets occurred under the nominal 4 cm beam, which exposed the SoC, LPDDR4, and additional board circuitry; none occurred under the 2 cm SoC-centered field. This pattern shows a field association but does not establish LPDDR4 as the cause because field size was confounded with run order and dose. Linux-managed accelerators require end-to-end content checks and recovery that reaches the state in which corruption can persist. This baseline documents availability loss and silent output corruption, supporting future software hardening of COTS FPGA-SoCs for neural-network inference in space systems.

AI.tldr: 本文为开源Tensil NN加速器在Zynq UltraScale+ SoC上执行ResNet-20推理时建立系统级质子辐照基线。在20-58 MeV质子辐照下（总注量4.29×10^10 p/cm²），记录到7次工作中断和2次输出损坏事件（含持续39个输入的错误类别输出），所有事件均发生于4cm束流场而非2cm SoC中心场下，为COTS FPGA-SoC神经网络的软件加固提供基线数据。
AI.motivation: 商业黑盒NN加速器架构不透明，严重限制了开发可验证的辐射缓解策略；而开源RTL可访问的加速器虽然支持用户自定义仪器化，但缺乏经验性的辐射响应基线数据，亟需建立系统级辐射基线以支持空间系统可靠性研究。
AI.method: 在Zynq UltraScale+ SoC上部署未缓解的开源Tensil NN加速器执行ResNet-20推理，采用20至58 MeV质子束进行辐照测试，在2cm和4cm两种束流场尺寸下进行对比实验，监测工作中断、输出损坏、进程状态、内核日志、内存测试和功耗等系统级指标。
AI.result: 在4.29×10^10 p/cm²总注量下，出现7次工作中断（需2次重启notebook进程、4次重启或板级复位、1次电源循环序列）和2次输出损坏事件。较长的损坏事件中，加速器连续39个输入返回了CIFAR-10池中不存在的错误类别，且进程存活、无内核日志/内存/功耗异常。所有9次事件均发生在4cm束流场（覆盖SoC、LPDDR4及其他板级电路）下，2cm SoC中心场下无事件发生。
AI.conclusion: 事件与4cm束流场存在关联但无法单独归因于LPDDR4（场尺寸与运行顺序和剂量存在混淆）。Linux管理的加速器需要端到端内容检查及能够到达损坏可能持续状态的恢复机制。该基线记录了可用性损失和静默输出损坏，支持未来对COTS FPGA-SoC进行软件加固以实现空间系统中的神经网络推理。

title: Segmentation of the aorta in 4D flow MRI using 4D convolutional kernels and learning from sparse annotations
comment: Submitted to Journal of Cardiovascular Magnetic Resonance
summary: Automated aortic segmentation in 4D flow MRI is essential for reproducible hemodynamic assessment but is limited by scarce dense annotations and high computational demands. We developed a fully automated 4D (3D+time) U-Net for segmenting the ascending aorta, arch, and proximal descending aorta, using a parameter-efficient hybrid 4D kernel to capture temporal context and sparse 4D labels derived from existing 2D expert contours and centerlines, thereby avoiding the need for dense 4D annotations. Training comprised 268 scans from 8 centers and 2 vendors, with evaluation on an internal test set (32 scans) and an external post-contrast set (30 scans; different site, protocol, and annotator), compared against frame-wise 3D networks and two semi-automatic references. Against time-resolved annotations, the 4D U-Net achieved Dice scores of 0.927 (internal) and 0.911 (external), versus 0.919/0.847 for the 3D U-Net, 0.893 for static PC-MRA, and 0.808 for registration-based propagation; differences were small in systole but pronounced in diastole. Agreement with expert contours for peak velocity, net flow, axial and circumferential wall shear stress, and diameters was excellent (ICC >=0.954 internal, >=0.980 external), while semi-automatic references performed worse. The method thus provides reproducible, time-resolved aortic segmentation for automated hemodynamic analysis and generalizes across multicenter, multivendor, and independent post-contrast data. The model is publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种全自动的4D（3D+时间）U-Net用于主动脉分割，利用参数高效的混合4D卷积核捕捉时间上下文，并通过从现有2D专家轮廓和中心线导出的稀疏4D标签进行训练，避免了密集4D标注需求。在8个中心、2家厂商的268例扫描上训练，内部测试（32例）Dice达0.927，外部后对比增强测试集（30例）Dice达0.911，优于3D U-Net和半自动基线方法，且血流动力学参数与专家标注的一致性极佳（ICC≥0.954）。
AI.motivation: 4D flow MRI中自动主动脉分割对于可重复的血流动力学评估至关重要，但现有方法面临两大挑战：密集标注稀缺（4D标注代价高昂）和高计算需求（无法直接使用密集4D网络）。作者旨在开发一种无需密集4D标注即可充分利用时间维度信息的分割方法，并验证其跨多中心、多厂商及独立后对比增强数据的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出全自动4D U-Net架构，核心创新包括：(1) 参数高效的混合4D卷积核用于捕捉时间上下文，在不大幅增加计算量的前提下学习帧间动态；(2) 利用现有2D专家轮廓和中心线构建稀疏4D标签，避免高昂的密集4D标注；(3) 在268例多中心、多厂商扫描上进行训练，与逐帧3D网络和两种半自动参考方法（静态PC-MRA分割、基于配准的传播）进行对比评估。
AI.result: 在时间分辨标注上，4D U-Net内部测试集Dice=0.927，外部后对比增强测试集Dice=0.911，显著优于3D U-Net（0.919/0.847）、静态PC-MRA（0.893）和基于配准的传播方法（0.808）。期间差异在收缩期较小但在舒张期显著。与专家轮廓在峰值流速、净流量、轴向和周向壁面剪切应力、直径等血流动力学指标上的一致性极佳（ICC内部≥0.954，外部≥0.980），半自动参考方法表现较差。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了可重复的、时间分辨的主动脉分割能力，可实现自动化血流动力学分析，并能跨多中心、多厂商及独立后对比增强数据进行良好泛化。模型已公开可用，为4D flow MRI主动脉分割提供了无需密集标注的高效解决方案。

title: Injected and Leaked: Actively Inducing Side-Channel Leakage Using Electromagnetic Injection and Hardware Nonlinearity
summary: Electromagnetic (EM) side-channel leakage and injection are typically treated as distinct physical phenomena, threatening data confidentiality and integrity respectively. This work investigates how EM injection can be used to amplify side-channel leakage that is otherwise infeasible. We introduce a novel framework for Injection-Induced EM Side Channels to enable integrated, closed-loop EM security analysis. Our theoretical modeling and experimental measurements reveal that nonlinear hardware components, such as ubiquitous amplifiers, analog-to-digital converters, and power converters, can modulate secret electrical signals onto an injected EM carrier and thus upconvert low-frequency secrets into measurable EM emissions. By tuning the injection frequency and amplitude, adversaries gain the ability to actively shape the effective spectrum and entropy of the resulting leakage. We design InjectEave attack and demonstrate eavesdropping on the audio played through wired and wireless headphones from up to 30 m away with accessible RF equipment, as well as in through-wall scenarios, and characterize injection-induced EM leakage of other low-frequency secrets such as power consumption of smart home devices and analog sensor inputs. Case studies further demonstrate how the proposed techniques enable closed-loop eavesdropping and manipulation of landline-phone conversations. Finally, we analyze the broader security challenges and mitigations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为InjectEave的新型攻击框架，利用电磁（EM）注入来放大侧信道泄漏，将低频秘密信号（如音频、功耗、传感器数据）上变频到可测量的EM频段。该攻击可在最远30米外窃听有线/无线耳机播放的音频，甚至穿透墙壁，并实现了对固定电话通话的闭环窃听与操控。
AI.motivation: 传统上，EM侧信道泄漏和EM注入被视为两种独立的现象，分别威胁数据机密性和完整性。然而实际中许多硬件（如放大器、ADC、电源转换器）具有非线性特性，可能耦合两种威胁。作者希望探索EM注入是否能够将原本微弱、不可行的侧信道泄漏放大到可探测的水平，以揭示这种集成安全威胁。
AI.method: 首先建立注入诱导EM侧信道的理论框架，阐明非线性硬件组件如何将秘密电信号调制到注入的EM载波上，实现低频秘密的上变频。通过调节注入频率与幅度，攻击者可以主动塑造泄漏信号的频谱与熵。在此基础上设计InjectEave攻击，使用可获取的RF设备在实际场景中进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验证明可远距离（最远30米）窃听有线/无线耳机的音频，并可在穿墙场景中实现；还表征了智能家居设备功耗和模拟传感器输入等其他低频秘密的注入诱导EM泄漏；案例研究展示了闭环窃听和操控固定电话通话的能力。
AI.conclusion: 论文揭示了EM注入可作为放大侧信道泄漏的工具，形成集成的闭环EM安全威胁，并分析了相关的安全挑战与缓解措施，呼吁安全社区正视这一新兴攻击面。

title: Disentangling Attention in Deep Operator Learning: A Controlled Study of Data-Driven and Physics-Informed Architectures
summary: Deep neural operators learn mappings between input functions and complete PDE solution fields, enabling forward evaluations of new problem instances orders of magnitude faster than conventional numerical solvers. Attention mechanisms have recently been introduced into neural operators, but most studies change several architectural components at once, making it difficult to identify what actually improves accuracy. This work presents a controlled and systematic study of five deep operator network (DeepONet) variants with distinct attention mechanisms, trained under both data-driven and physics-informed regimes, to isolate the effects of cross-attention, self-attention, tokenization, and attention depth. We evaluate them on a source-driven transient one-dimensional nonlinear diffusion-reaction equation, a transient one-dimensional viscous Burgers equation with variable initial conditions, and a two-dimensional Poisson heat-conduction problem with heterogeneous source fields. Per-sensor tokenization with cross-attention reduces the mean relative L_2 error of the classical DeepONet in all benchmark-training combinations by factors of 2.4-28.0, while the best attention configurations reach 3.5-32.3. Branch self-attention paired only with dot-product fusion is inconsistent, degrading the one-dimensional problems while helping the more complex two-dimensional source field; added on top of cross-attention it improves all six cases, though by less than cross-attention fusion alone. Global pre-mixing provides no consistent benefit. Increasing cross-attention depth further improves accuracy, but with diminishing returns and a substantially higher cost under physics-informed training. Overall, query-dependent cross-attention is the most reliable mechanism, whereas branch self-attention is most useful for large, spatially complex functional inputs.

AI.tldr: 本文对五种带不同注意力机制的DeepONet变体进行了受控的系统性研究，在数据驱动和物理信息两种训练模式下评估交叉注意力、自注意力、分词和注意力深度的影响。结果表明，带交叉注意力的逐传感器分词在所有基准组合中将经典DeepONet的相对L2误差降低2.4-28.0倍，最佳注意力配置可达3.5-32.3倍；查询依赖的交叉注意力是最可靠的机制，而分支自注意力仅对大且空间复杂的函数输入最有用。
AI.motivation: 神经网络算子虽然引入了注意力机制，但大多数研究同时改变了多个架构组件，难以确定真正提升精度的因素。作者旨在通过控制变量的系统研究，隔离并识别各注意力机制（交叉注意力、自注意力、分词方式、注意力深度）各自对神经算子的实际贡献。
AI.method: 设计了五种具有不同注意力机制的DeepONet变体，在数据驱动和物理信息两种训练范式下进行受控实验。评估任务包括：(1)源驱动的瞬态一维非线性扩散-反应方程；(2)变初始条件的瞬态一维粘性Burgers方程；(3)带非均匀源场的二维Poisson热传导问题。通过逐一对照不同注意力配置（交叉注意力、分支自注意力、分词策略、注意力深度）来隔离各自效果。全局预混合也被检验。
AI.result: 逐传感器分词与交叉注意力结合将所有基准-训练组合中的经典DeepONet相对L2误差降低2.4-28.0倍，最佳注意力配置达到3.5-32.3倍。分支自注意力仅在点积融合下不一致——对一维问题效果退化而帮助更复杂的二维源场；叠加在交叉注意力之上可在全部六个案例中改进精度，但不如单独的交叉注意力融合。全局预混合无一致收益。增加交叉注意力深度进一步提升精度但收益递减，且在物理信息训练下成本显著更高。
AI.conclusion: 查询依赖的交叉注意力是最可靠的注意力机制，是DeepONet改进的核心因素；分支自注意力最适合处理大规模、空间上复杂的函数输入。该研究为神经算子的注意力架构设计提供了清晰、可归因的经验指导。

title: GRACE: Graph-Grounded Reflective Agent Copilot Engine for Expert-in-the-Loop Knowledge Expansion
summary: Large language models deployed in high-stakes settings frequently generate plausible but ungrounded claims. Standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines offer limited remedy, since they retrieve isolated passages without tracking cross-document evidence relationships or quantifying uncertainty. We introduce GRACE (Graph-grounded Reflective Agent Copilot Engine), a framework that deconstructs LLM responses into atomic claims and grounds them against trusted knowledge priors within a weighted bipartite graph. Edge weights encode the closeness of each claim to the priors, enabling weighted centrality analysis that classifies claims as Grounded, Refuted, or Boundary. Such classification identifies not just hallucinations but also novel or contested claims at the frontier of the model's knowledge. To efficiently allocate human or agent resources, we formulate a Return on Attention (RoA) objective that defers a claim to expert review only when its priority-weighted uncertainty exceeds the cost of verification. Claims verified by experts are promoted to new evidence anchors, closing a validator-LLM evolutionary loop that expands the knowledge base across iterations. We evaluate GRACE across multiple language models and on datasets spanning both general and domain-specific knowledge. Our results show that our knowledge base serves as a reliable foundation for retrieval that outperforms RAG baselines, and that the RoA framework efficiently selects valuable boundary knowledge for expert verification. These findings demonstrate that graph-structured representations combined with expert-in-the-loop verification can mitigate hallucination at the system level rather than at the generation level. Code available at https://github.com/johnsk95/grace_code

AI.tldr: GRACE（Graph-grounded Reflective Agent Copilot Engine）是一个将LLM响应拆解为原子声明，并在加权二分图中基于可信知识先验进行grounding的框架，通过加权中心性分析将声明分类为Grounded/Refuted/Boundary，并利用Return on Attention (RoA)目标实现专家验证资源的优化分配，最终通过验证-进化闭环扩展知识库以缓解幻觉。
AI.motivation: 高风控场景中部署的LLM常生成看似合理但缺乏事实依据的内容，而标准RAG管道仅检索孤立段落，无法追踪跨文档证据关系或量化不确定性，因此难以有效缓解幻觉问题。
AI.method: GRACE将LLM响应分解为原子声明，在加权二分图中基于可信知识先验进行grounding（边权重编码声明与先验的接近度）；通过加权中心性分析将声明分为Grounded、Refuted或Boundary三类；引入RoA目标，仅在优先级加权的不确定性超过验证成本时才将声明交由专家审查；专家验证后的声明提升为新的证据锚点，形成validator-LLM进化闭环以跨迭代扩展知识库。
AI.result: 在多语言模型及涵盖通用与领域特定知识的数据集上，GRACE的知识库作为检索基础优于RAG基线，且RoA框架能高效筛选有价值的边界知识供专家验证。
AI.conclusion: 图结构表示结合专家在环（expert-in-the-loop）验证可在系统层面而非生成层面缓解幻觉，这为LLM高风控应用提供了更可靠的知识grounding机制。

title: ResLearn-XR: Residual Learning for Network Traffic and Quality-of-Experience-Aware Modeling in Extended Reality
summary: We present ResLearn-XR, a residual learning framework for predicting eXtended Reality (XR) network traffic and estimating Quality-of-Experience (QoE) risk. ResLearn-XR adopts a two-stage temporal learning structure comprising a base sequence prediction model augmented with task-specific residual learning components to improve adaptability to bursty, non-stationary XR traffic dynamics. The residual learning stages operate in the value space for continuous XR traffic forecasting and in the logit space for probabilistic QoE risk estimation. \rev{For the QoE-risk branch, we introduce a Data Descriptor Algorithm (DDA), a causal feature-construction module that converts packet-level application-layer observables into frame-timing-aware descriptors suitable for encrypted traffic analysis. We also construct an XR Traffic-QoE dataset that pairs continuous XR traffic traces with session-level user-reported QoE labels. ResLearn-XR reduces SMAPE by up to 17.84% across frame-count, frame-size, and inter-arrival-time prediction, while reducing QoE-risk estimation SMAPE by up to 87.8% over single-stage baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ResLearn-XR，一种用于预测扩展现实（XR）网络流量及估计体验质量（QoE）风险的残差学习框架。其采用两阶段时序学习结构，在值空间进行连续流量预测，在logit空间进行概率QoE风险估计，并引入数据描述符算法（DDA）及配套数据集，相较于单阶段基线在流量预测上SMAPE最高降低17.84%，QoE风险估计SMAPE最高降低87.8%。
AI.motivation: XR网络流量具有突发性（bursty）、非平稳（non-stationary）的动态特征，传统单阶段预测模型难以精准捕捉其复杂时序模式，且加密流量环境下QoE风险估计缺乏有效的特征构建与训练数据支撑，亟需一种能够同时提升流量预测精度与QoE风险评估能力的自适应框架。
AI.method: ResLearn-XR采用两阶段时序学习架构：1）基础序列预测模型作为骨干，附加任务专属残差学习组件以增强对突发、非平稳XR流量的适应性；2）流量预测分支在值空间（value space）中进行残差学习以实现连续预测；3）QoE风险分支在logit空间中进行残差学习以实现概率化风险估计；4）提出数据描述符算法（DDA），一种因果特征构建模块，将数据包级应用层观测转换为面向帧时序（frame-timing-aware）的描述符以支持加密流量分析；5）构建XR Traffic-QoE数据集，将连续XR流量轨迹与会话级用户上报QoE标签配对。
AI.result: 在帧数、帧大小和帧间到达时间三类预测任务上，ResLearn-XR较基线将SMAPE最高降低17.84%；在QoE风险估计任务上，相较单阶段基线将SMAPE最高降低87.8%。
AI.conclusion: ResLearn-XR验证了残差学习与两阶段时序建模相结合的有效性，能够显著提升XR流量预测精度与QoE风险估计性能；DDA算法及配套数据集的构建为加密XR流量的QoE分析提供了新的方法论与数据基础。

title: HaptiNet: Networked Haptic Robots Enable Physical Co-presence in Geographically-Unconstrained Rehabilitation
summary: Cooperative rehabilitation enhances engagement, task performance, and social-motor interaction, yet it demands physical co-presence: users must transmit forces, coordinate movements, and infer intent through haptic contact. Telerehabilitation promises to expand access for patients constrained by distance, mobility, or clinical disparities, yet current techniques remain predominantly audiovisual while leaving users haptically and physically isolated. Here, we introduce HaptiNet, a networked haptic robotic system enabling physical co-presence for geographically distributed users via force-mediated interaction. Each robotic terminal features a low-inertia, long-stroke design with high force-feedback capacity, tailored for haptic rendering in upper-limb training. Building on these terminals, HaptiNet creates a distributed haptic network with an imitation-learning-based delay compensator, enabling users to physically perceive and coordinate with one another over distance. We validated HaptiNet in 284 healthy participants and 111 patients with neurological impairments across progressively realistic settings, including laboratory tests, cross-city deployments, and clinical applications. HaptiNet preserved task-level force rendering consistency across single-user and multi-user scenarios. Compared with solo and visual cooperative training, haptic cooperation improved task performance by 24% and 22%, respectively, while also boosting engagement and interpersonal motor synchrony. Across three intercity links totaling approximately 4,000 km, HaptiNet maintained stable haptic interaction among patients with neurological impairments, producing a 3.87-fold greater baseline-to-training score improvement and a 106% higher patient-applied effort over the solo condition.

AI.tldr: HaptiNet是一个网络化触觉机器人系统，通过力介导交互实现远程物理共同在场，含284名健康受试者和111名神经系统受损患者的验证，触觉协作较单独训练提升任务表现24%、较视觉协作提升22%，跨约4000公里城际链路保持稳定交互。
AI.motivation: 协同康复训练需要物理共在（力的传递、运动协调、通过触觉推断意图），但病患受距离、移动能力或临床条件限制难以获得。现有远程康复主要依赖音视频，患者在触觉和物理层面处于隔离状态，缺乏远程物理共同在场的解决方案。
AI.method: HaptiNet由三个关键要素构成：(1) 低惯量、长行程、高力反馈容量的机器人终端，专为上肢训练的触觉渲染设计；(2) 基于这些终端构建的分布式触觉网络；(3) 基于模仿学习的延迟补偿器，支持异地用户间力的感知与协调。验证涵盖逐步递进的真实场景：实验室测试、跨城部署和临床应用。
AI.result: 在284名健康参与者和111名神经系统受损患者中，HaptiNet在单用户和多用户场景下保持了任务级力渲染一致性。触觉协作相比单独训练和视觉协作训练，分别提升任务表现24%和22%，同时增强了参与感和人际运动同步性。在三个约4000公里的城际链路中，神经系统受损患者维持稳定的触觉交互，基线至训练得分提升为单独训练的3.87倍，患者施加的努力程度比单独训练高106%。
AI.conclusion: HaptiNet验证了通过网络化触觉机器人实现分布式力介导交互的可行性，为远程康复提供了超越音视频的物理共同在场方案，有望在突破距离和医疗资源限制的同时保持协同康复的治疗优势。

title: LLM-Driven Algorithm Design for Quantum Circuit Synthesis based on Binary Decision Diagrams
summary: Quantum circuits are central to implementing quantum algorithms on quantum devices, where quantum gates must be reversible. Many quantum algorithms rely on Boolean functions, which must therefore be implemented reversibly within quantum circuits. Reversible circuit synthesis provides a way to translate such Boolean functions into reversible circuits. Binary decision diagrams (BDDs) offer a scalable approach to this task, but the resulting BDDs and circuits depend heavily on variable ordering. Existing ordering heuristics commonly minimize BDD size because it is closely tied to the circuit size. However, BDD size is an imperfect proxy for the quantum cost of the synthesized circuit (QCC). We propose \texttt{QuantumEvo}, an evolutionary framework that uses an LLM as a heuristic generator for QCC-aware BDD variable ordering. Instead of predicting orderings directly, \texttt{QuantumEvo} searches over ordering heuristics initialized from multiple heuristic families. Candidate heuristics directly manipulate variable orderings using standard BDD operations and are selected by downstream QCC. The discovered heuristic, HGA-QE, modifies the sifting step inside a genetic algorithm so that the procedure is better aligned with QCC. Across the benchmark set, HGA-QE achieves a 70.9\% tie-or-win rate against the per-function best baseline and is strictly best on 13.5\% of the functions. The results demonstrate broadly competitive QCC performance, with HGA-QE showing a clearer relative advantage in strict wins on the two benchmark suites drawn from sources different from the data used for heuristic discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出QuantumEvo，一个利用LLM生成QCC感知的BDD变量排序启发式的进化框架。发现的启发式HGA-QE通过修改遗传算法中的sifting步骤来更好地对齐QCC，在基准测试中达到70.9%的平局或胜率，并在13.5%的函数上严格优于所有基线。
AI.motivation: 量子电路中的可逆电路综合需要将布尔函数映射为可逆电路，BDD提供可扩展的方案，但结果高度依赖变量排序。现有启发式主要最小化BDD大小，然而BDD大小只是合成电路量子成本(QCC)的一个不完美代理指标，需要更直接的QCC感知排序策略。
AI.method: 提出QuantumEvo进化框架：使用LLM作为启发式生成器，从多个启发式族初始化开始搜索，候选启发式通过标准BDD操作直接操纵变量排序，并由下游QCC进行评估选择。发现的启发式HGA-QE修改了遗传算法中的sifting步骤，使其更符合QCC优化目标。
AI.result: 在基准测试集上，HGA-QE对每个函数的基线中最佳表现达到70.9%的平局或胜率（tie-or-win rate），在13.5%的函数上严格优于所有基线。在两个来自不同数据源（不同于启发式发现所用数据）的基准套件上，HGA-QE展示了更明显的相对优势和更清晰的严格胜率优势。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明HGA-QE在QCC性能上具有广泛的竞争力，且相比BDD大小优化启发式，直接面向QCC优化的排序策略在跨数据集上展现出更好的泛化能力。这验证了以LLM驱动的进化搜索方式发现QCC感知启发式的可行性。

title: Topology-Aware Training and Spatial Diagnostics for Fiber Bundle Segmentation in Tracer Histology
summary: Anatomic tracer studies reveal how axon bundles project from an injection site, branch into smaller groups of axons, and course through the brain to reach their destinations. Histological data from such studies provide anatomical reference information for validating diffusion MRI tractography. However, manual annotation of the histological data is very labor-intensive, and although automated segmentation methods have been proposed, they rely mainly on pixel-overlap losses such as BCE and Dice; topology-aware loss functions have not been studied for this task. We compare BCE-Dice, clDice, Betti matching, and Topograph for fiber bundle segmentation in macaque tracer histology using a frozen DINOv3 backbone. To our knowledge, this is the first exploration of foundation-model features for this task. BCE-Dice achieved the highest Dice, while clDice achieved the highest bundle recall but poor mask overlap. Topograph had similar Dice to BCE-Dice, the lowest $β_0$ error, and fewer false positives than BCE-Dice and Betti matching. Fiber bundle segmentation methods are typically evaluated with a permissive rule that counts a bundle as detected given any overlap with the prediction. We show this rule does not capture oversegmentation, and that per-section TPR can be inflated by empty sections assigned perfect recall. To quantify this, we introduce Excess32, a spatial diagnostic measuring predicted pixels outside a 32-pixel tolerance band around annotated bundles. In validation, a Betti-Topograph union raises sparse-bundle TPR from 0.818 to 0.933, but worsens FDR from 0.296 to 0.509, Excess32 from 0.108 to 0.466, and area ratio from 0.94 to 3.34. These results show detection metrics alone are insufficient to characterize segmentation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文首次探索了使用冻结的DINOv3基础模型特征进行猕猴示踪剂组织学中的纤维束分割，系统比较了BCE-Dice、clDice、Betti matching和Topograph四种损失函数，并引入了Excess32空间诊断指标来量化过分割问题，揭示了仅依赖检测指标不足以表征分割质量。
AI.motivation: 解剖示踪研究对于验证弥散MRI纤维束成像至关重要，但组织学数据的注释劳动强度大。自动分割方法虽有提出，但主要依赖像素重叠损失（如BCE和Dice），在该任务中拓扑感知损失函数尚未被系统研究，且现有评估规则无法捕捉过分割问题。
AI.method: 使用冻结的DINOv3作为骨干网络，对比四种损失函数（BCE-Dice、clDice、Betti matching、Topograph）进行纤维束分割。引入Excess32度量（测量注释束周围32像素容差带外的预测像素），并构建Betti-Topograph联合损失验证扩展指标的有效性。
AI.result: BCE-Dice获得最高Dice分数；clDice获得最高束召回率但掩码重叠差；Topograph的Dice接近BCE-Dice，β0误差最低且假阳性更少。现有允许任何重叠即算检测的规则无法捕捉过分割，每切片TPR可能因空切片被赋予完美召回而虚高。Betti-Topograph联合将稀疏束TPR从0.818提高到0.933，但FDR从0.296恶化到0.509，Excess32从0.108恶化到0.466。
AI.conclusion: 检测指标（如TPR）本身不足以评估分割质量，必须结合空间度量和拓扑度量进行综合评价。Excess32可作为量化过分割的有效诊断工具。

title: Cost-Aware Hierarchical Multi-Agent Ransomware Detection and Family Attribution
summary: Ransomware detection and family attribution require analysis of different modalities because it can use packing, obfuscation, process manipulation and runtime evasion techniques. However, conventional multimodal usually uses all available modalities for every sample resulting in unnecessary computational cost and increased latency. In this paper, we present a Cost Aware Hierarchical Multi-Agent System (HMAS) for adaptive ransomware detection. The proposed architecture organizes specialized agents into hierarchical domain controllers coordinated by a Meta Orchestrator. Static analysis is used as the initial low-cost modality while additional dynamic and memory modality is selectively used when confidence is insufficient or specialist agents exhibit disagreement. A cost model incorporates modality use and processing overhead. It enables the orchestration policy to balance analysis performance against computational cost. A locally deployed large language model provides verification for selected difficult cases without replacing the deterministic pipeline. Experimental evaluation compares adaptive HMAS with static only, static plus dynamic and exhaustive analysis policies across binary ransomware detection and multiclass family attribution. The complete HMAS achieved 96.57% accuracy, 0.96 F1-score and 0.99 ROC-AUC for binary detection. It also achieved 0.90 macro-F1 for family attribution. At the same time, the HMAS reduced average analysis cost by 43.97% relative to exhaustive analysis and substantially reduced average analysis latency except for the case where LLM is used. Routing analysis showed that 56.05% of cases were resolved using static evidence alone. Only 4.33% required the complete evidence pipeline. These findings demonstrate that adaptive HMAS can provide accuracy cost tradeoff for ransomware analysis while retaining support for heterogeneous and incomplete modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种成本感知的分层多智能体系统（HMAS），通过自适应的模态选择（静态分析为主，动态和内存分析按需触发）实现勒索软件检测与家族归属任务，在保持高精度的同时显著降低了计算成本和分析延迟。
AI.motivation: 勒索软件检测需要结合多模态分析（静态、动态、内存等），但传统多模态方法对所有样本不加区分地使用全部模态，导致不必要的计算开销和延迟增加。现有方法缺乏成本意识的自适应分析策略。
AI.method: 提出成本感知的分层多智能体系统（HMAS）：将专业智能体组织成分层领域控制器，由元编排器（Meta Orchestrator）协调。以静态分析作为初始低成本的模态，当置信度不足或智能体间存在分歧时，选择性启用动态和内存模态。引入成本模型量化模态使用与处理开销，指导编排策略在性能与成本间平衡。部署本地大语言模型（LLM）用于困难案例的验证，但不替代确定性管线。
AI.result: 在二分类检测中达到96.57%准确率、0.96 F1分数和0.99 ROC-AUC；家族归属任务达到0.90宏平均F1。相比穷举分析，HMAS降低了43.97%的平均分析成本，并大幅降低平均分析延迟（LLM参与的情况除外）。路由分析显示56.05%的案例仅凭静态证据即解决，仅4.33%需要完整证据管线。
AI.conclusion: 自适应HMAS在勒索软件分析中能提供良好的准确率-成本权衡，同时支持异构和不完整模态，说明成本感知的自适应模态调度是兼顾检测性能与资源效率的有效范式。

title: REFINE: LLM Refinement over Budgeted Text-Attributed Graphs for Personalized Medical Concept Representation
comment: This paper has been accepted at the EMNLP 2026 main conference
summary: Learning rich medical concept representations is essential for EHR prediction. Text-attributed knowledge graphs (TKGs) provide a natural foundation by organizing heterogeneous medical relations together with textual semantics. However, most existing encoders process concepts uniformly across patients, despite the fact that a code's meaning and predictive value depend on patient-specific clinical context and trajectory.
