AI.tldr: 本文发现细粒度MoE的router重归一化隐式地将专家输出增益校准到训练时的top-k值。通过将激活专家数(k1)与归一化参考专家数(k2)解耦，引入零参数、零训练的整数超参，可在大幅降低推理计算的同时保持极小的性能损失（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B上仅掉0.35分，Qwen3.5-397B-A17B上仅掉0.55分），并揭示了专家身份比专家权重更重要等压缩洞察。
AI.motivation: 细粒度MoE模型在推理时减少活跃专家数（降低k）会同时带来两类变化：路由选择的专家集合以及专家分支的强度（因重归一化所致）。现有研究未将二者分离，导致无法清晰理解性能下降的来源，也缺乏一个简单的机制来保留归一化参考质量，从而在降低推理成本的同时维持模型性能。
AI.method: 提出将激活top k1个专家与按top k2个专家的概率质量做归一化两个操作解耦，引入单一整数超参k2（无参数、无训练、无可测量计算开销）。通过设定k2≥k1（如k2=16），在推理时减少活跃专家数时保留了原有的归一化参考质量，从而分离"专家选择效应"与"专家强度效应"。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.6-35B-A3B上，将8→4个专家时，标准重归一化导致MMLU下降4.65分，而设置k2=16时仅下降0.35分，同时路由专家计算量减半。该结果在11倍更大的Qwen3.5-397B-A17B上复现（10→5个专家仅损失0.55分）。完全移除重归一化会导致灾难性性能下降，表明保留合适的参考概率质量至关重要。此外发现困惑度与下游准确率偏好不同的k2，且专家身份比专家权重对性能的影响更大。
AI.conclusion: MoE推理压缩时，只需调整归一化参考集（k2）即可有效补偿降k带来的性能损失，说明现有的重归一化机制中"参考概率质量"是保证模型行为一致性的关键。同时警示不应仅依赖困惑度来选择MoE压缩设置，且专家身份选择的重要性远超专家权重，均衡与领域专用的路由方式留给专家剪枝的空间有限。

title: Tracing Audio Grounding and Answer Selection in Audio LLMs
summary: Audio Large Language Models (Audio LLMs) have advanced in audio understanding, yet they can still predict the answer by reasoning from textual cues or linguistic priors rather than the provided audio. A common remedy is to train models on data whose answers cannot be inferred from text alone. This approach can improve performance, but what changes within the model remains unclear. In this paper, we ask what must happen inside the model for the audio to actually determine the answer. Our findings are threefold. (1) Replacing the audio with silence or unrelated audio causes substantially larger performance degradation in the trained model than in the pretrained model. (2) Acoustic information most strongly shapes the model's representations of the answer choices in early-to-middle layers, while training mainly increases the influence of audio information on the final prediction in middle-to-late layers. (3) The weights learned during training have their largest impact in specific layer bands. Together, these results provide a mechanistic account of how training strengthens the use of acoustic evidence in Audio LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了音频大语言模型通过训练增强对声学证据依赖的内在机制，发现训练后的模型在静音或无关音频替换时性能显著下降，声学信息主要在中前层影响答案选择的表征，而训练主要通过中后层增强音频信息对最终预测的影响，且训练所学权重集中于特定层带。
AI.motivation: 音频LLM虽然取得了进展，但可能仅依靠文本线索或语言先验来推测答案，而非真正依赖输入音频。现有方法通过训练无法仅从文本推断答案的数据来缓解该问题，但模型内部发生了什么变化仍不明确。本文旨在探究：模型内部需要发生什么变化，才能让音频真正决定答案。
AI.method: 作者从三个角度进行了机制分析：(1) 将音频替换为静音或无关音频，比较预训练模型与经过反文本捷径训练后模型的性能退化程度；(2) 分析声学信息对答案选择表征的影响在各层的分布；(3) 分析训练过程中所学权重在不同层带上对最终预测的影响力分布。
AI.result: 研究发现三点：(1) 训练后的模型在音频被替换为静音或无关音频时，性能退化显著大于预训练模型；(2) 声学信息对答案选择表征的塑造主要集中在早期到中层，而训练主要在中后层增强音频信息对最终预测的贡献；(3) 训练学到的权重在特定层带上影响最大。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果提供了对音频LLM训练如何增强声学证据使用的机制性解释，揭示了音频信息在不同层级的处理路径以及训练效应在特定层带的集中体现。

title: $τ^τ$-Bench: An Environment for End-To-End, Realistic Agent Construction
summary: LLM agents are rapidly becoming production software, deployed to handle customer service, adjudicate disputes, and operate internal systems. Notably, the work of building them is increasingly handed to coding agents, yet existing benchmarks say little about whether an AI system can deliver one under the conditions of a real client engagement. We introduce $τ^τ$-bench (pronounced hyper-tau-bench), a benchmark that makes agent construction the task. A developer agent is given the records a business actually keeps, a client who holds requirements, a production API that operations must run through, a codebase to inherit, and limits on serving cost and models: the same starting point a real engagement provides. From these it must deliver a complete customer-service agent, scored by deploying that agent against held-out simulated users. Across 53 tasks spanning four domains, the strongest configuration, Claude Opus 5 under Claude Code, passes just 23.9% of evaluation simulations. Meanwhile, an expert-authored reference ceiling scores 82.2%. The failures mirror ones human agent developers see: models issue shallow queries in place of deep comprehension of the records, communicate almost nothing to the client, and experiment too little with agent architecture and serving spend, shipping the first design that runs. We aim for $τ^τ$-bench to turn the work of cooperative agent building into a measurable target for coding agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出τ^τ-bench基准，将构建LLM智能体本身作为评测任务。开发者智能体需要在真实业务记录、客户需求、生产API、遗留代码库及成本/模型限制等真实约束条件下，交付一个完整的客户服务智能体，并通过部署该智能体对抗模拟用户来评分。53个任务中，最强配置（Claude Opus 5 + Claude Code）仅通过23.9%的模拟，专家参考上限达82.2%。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体正快速成为生产软件，且构建这些智能体的工作越来越多地交给编码智能体完成。然而现有基准无法评测AI系统在真实客户合作条件下能否交付一个智能体产品，存在评测空白。
AI.method: τ^τ-bench将智能体构建本身设为任务：开发者智能体被提供真实业务记录、持有需求的客户、生产API、待继承的代码库以及服务成本和模型限制，需交付完整客户服务智能体。评分方式是将交付的智能体部署后对抗保留的模拟用户进行评测。共覆盖4个领域53个任务。
AI.result: 最强配置（Claude Opus 5 + Claude Code）在评测模拟中仅通过23.9%，而专家撰写的参考上限可达82.2%。分析发现失败模式与人类开发者一致：模型发问肤浅而非深入理解记录、与客户沟通极少、对智能体架构和服务支出实验不足，往往直接部署首个能运行的方案。
AI.conclusion: τ^τ-bench旨在将合作式智能体构建工作转化为编码智能体可衡量的评测目标，填补了真实条件下智能体交付能力评测的空白。

title: RoboSPA: Can VLA Models Go Beyond Simple Scenes and Short-Horizon Tasks?
comment: Accepted at the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising progress in language-conditioned robotic manipulation. However, existing datasets and benchmarks mainly evaluate task completion under predefined settings, offering limited insight into model reasoning under increasing spatial and procedural complexity. We introduce \textbf{RoboSPA} (\textbf{Robo}t \textbf{S}patial-\textbf{P}rocedural \textbf{A}ssessment), a large-scale robotic manipulation dataset and benchmark for diagnosing embodied reasoning in VLA models. \texttt{RoboSPA} focuses on two core dimensions, Fine-Grained Spatial Reasoning and Long-Horizon Procedural Planning, covering 10 task categories and 56 base tasks. Each task is instantiated across five difficulty levels, yielding 280 variants with increasing spatial ambiguity and procedural complexity. We collect 527K trajectories across multiple embodiments and diverse scenes. Beyond binary success rate, \texttt{RoboSPA} introduces diagnostic metrics for more detailed evaluation. Experiments on representative VLA models show that current systems still struggle with complex spatial relations, precise low-level execution, and memory-intensive planning. These results establish \texttt{RoboSPA} as a challenging diagnostic benchmark for developing more capable, reliable, and generalizable embodied agents. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/fanzhenxuan/RoboSPA.

AI.tldr: RoboSPA是一个大规模机器人操作数据集与基准，专门用于诊断VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型在细粒度空间推理和长时序程序规划方面的能力，包含10个任务类别、56个基础任务和280个难度递增的变体，共527K条轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA数据集和基准主要在预定设置下评估任务完成情况，无法深入揭示模型在空间复杂度和程序复杂度递增时的推理能力，缺乏对细粒度空间推理与长时序程序规划的针对性诊断。
AI.method: 构建RoboSPA数据集与基准，聚焦细粒度空间推理和长时序程序规划两个核心维度，覆盖10个任务类别和56个基础任务，每个任务设置5个难度等级（共280个变体），收集527K条多具身多场景轨迹，并引入超越二元成功率的诊断性评估指标。
AI.result: 对代表性VLA模型的实验表明，当前系统在复杂空间关系理解、精确低级动作执行以及依赖记忆的规划方面仍存在明显不足。
AI.conclusion: RoboSPA被确立为一个具有挑战性的诊断基准，有助于推动更强大、更可靠、更具泛化能力的具身智能体的开发，数据与代码已公开。

title: HiSfM: Disambiguating Structure-from-Motion via Scaffold-Anchored Hierarchical Reconstruction
summary: Structure-from-Motion (SfM) is a fundamental tool for sparse 3D reconstruction with broad impact in robotics and vision, supporting mapping, localization, and large-scale scene modeling. However, conventional pipelines often fail under hard visual ambiguity caused by repeated or symmetric structures, and incur heavy computational cost due to redundant cameras and constraints. We present HiSfM, a hierarchical coarse-to-fine SfM framework that improves robustness and efficiency through scaffold construction. HiSfM first forms strong local communities using geometrical induced heuristics, then connects communities with a compact yet strong skeleton by packing edge-disjoint spanning trees (EDST) while verifying skeletal edges with a two-view disambiguator. We reconstruct a stable scaffold on this verified skeleton, serving as an anchor to capture the essence of the scene, and subsequently absorb remaining images via efficient registration and triangulation for further refinements. Experiments on ambiguity-focused benchmarks and general datasets show that HiSfM prevents ambiguity-induced failures while substantially reducing runtime compared to previous methods, and improves completeness over aggressive sparsification methods. Code is available at https://github.com/3dv-casia/HiSfM.

AI.tldr: HiSfM是一种层次化粗到精的运动恢复结构(SfM)框架，通过构建脚手架(scaffold)来提升在重复/对称结构等视觉模糊场景下的鲁棒性和计算效率。它通过几何启发式形成局部社区，利用边不相交生成树(EDST)连接社区形成紧致骨架，并用两视图消歧器验证骨架边，从而构建稳定脚手架作为锚点，逐步吸收剩余图像完成重建。
AI.motivation: 传统的SfM流程在重复或对称结构造成的严重视觉歧义下容易失败，且由于冗余相机和约束导致高昂的计算成本，制约了其在机器人和视觉领域的应用。
AI.method: 提出HiSfM框架：(1)利用几何诱导启发式构建强局部社区；(2)通过打包边不相交生成树(EDST)连接社区，形成紧致强骨架，并使用两视图消歧器验证骨架边；(3)在验证后的骨架上重建稳定脚手架作为场景本质的锚点；(4)通过高效配准和三角化吸收剩余图像并进一步细化。
AI.result: 在面向歧义的标准数据集和通用数据集上的实验表明，HiSfM能够防止歧义导致的失败，显著减少运行时间，并相较于激进的稀疏化方法提高了重建完整性。
AI.conclusion: HiSfM通过层次化脚手架构建策略，同时兼顾了SfM在视觉歧义场景下的鲁棒性与大规模场景下的效率，代码已开源。

title: Machine Unlearning as Private Retroactive Algorithms
summary:
Machine unlearning typically aims to emulate retraining from scratch: upon a deletion request, the unlearning algorithm should produce an outcome that would have been obtained had the deleted point never been included. Recent work has shown that this emulation requirement carries no meaningful privacy semantics against an adversary who observes a sequence of releases. Machine unlearning is thus not a privacy question per se, but rather a data maintenance question, which is precisely the subject of retroactive algorithms. These are algorithms supporting modifications of past operations, guaranteeing that all subsequent answers reflect the revised history as if it had always been in force.
  We put forward a definition of private retroactive algorithms, combining the retroactivity requirement with differential privacy under continual observation. We present constructions achieving both privacy and retroactivity at no asymptotic cost over privacy alone for linear statistics, clustering, and histograms, alongside impossibility results.

AI.tldr: 本文将机器遗忘（machine unlearning）重新定位为数据维护问题而非隐私问题，提出"私有回溯算法"（private retroactive algorithms）的正式定义，将回溯性要求与持续观测下的差分隐私相结合，并为线性统计、聚类、直方图等任务给出在不增加隐私成本的前提下同时实现隐私与回溯性的构造方案，同时提供不可能性结果。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明，机器遗忘试图模拟"从头重训"的语义在面对观察序列发布的攻击者时缺乏有意义的隐私保证。因此需要重新审视遗忘的实质——它本质上是一个数据维护问题（即回溯性算法），而非纯粹的隐私问题。然而，在动态发布场景中，数据维护与隐私（持续观测下的差分隐私）如何协同工作尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 作者正式定义了私有回溯算法，将经典的回溯算法框架与持续观测下的差分隐私条件相结合。针对线性统计、聚类（clustering）和直方图（histograms）等任务，设计了同时满足隐私与回溯性的构造方案，并证明了其渐近成本与仅满足隐私要求的方案相同；同时，作者还给出了在某些条件下无法同时实现两者（或需要额外代价）的不可能性证明。
AI.result: 对于线性统计、聚类和直方图三大类任务，所提出的构造能够同时实现回溯性与持续观测下的差分隐私，且渐近成本不高于单独追求隐私的成本；此外，文章给出了相应的不可能性结果，界定了可实现的边界。
AI.conclusion: 该工作澄清了机器遗忘的语义实质（数据维护而非隐私），并通过提出私有回溯算法这一统一框架，证明了在多种常见统计任务上隐私与回溯性可以零额外渐近成本地兼得，同时以不可能性结果刻画了理论限度，为动态数据发布场景下兼顾隐私与历史一致性的算法设计提供了新的理论基石。

title: Optimizer Memory Schedules for Outscaling the Overtraining Axis
summary: We investigate how optimizers scale across the overtraining axis and show that relative optimizer performance and optimal hyperparameters change substantially with training horizon. In particular, we study how matrix-preconditioned methods (Muon and SOAP) and a momentum-scheduled method (ADANA) scale relative to AdamW. We compare these four optimizers across models from 51M to 253M parameters and overtraining (OT) factors from 1x to 256x, sweeping the base learning rate at every setting. The preferred learning rate schedule can reverse across the overtraining axis, the best weight decay coefficient scales approximately as sqrt(OT), and longer horizons generally favor longer fixed memory. ADANA's scaling advantage over AdamW persists after tuning AdamW's fixed memory separately at each horizon. Log-time weight decay and momentum cooldown provide substantial gains for ADANA that compound as training increases. With this treatment, ADANA outscales AdamW with an exponent advantage close to that predicted by DANA theory on power-law random features. Muon and SOAP instead provide roughly constant token-efficiency advantages over AdamW across most of the measured range, although SOAP may gain further at the highest overtraining factors. ADANA begins behind both matrix-preconditioned optimizers but closes the gaps as training increases, surpassing Muon and becoming competitive with SOAP at our highest OT factors. These results establish training horizon as an essential axis for optimizer evaluation and design.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了优化器在过训练轴上的扩展行为，发现相对优化器性能和最优超参数会随训练时长发生显著变化。作者比较了AdamW、矩阵预条件方法（Muon和SOAP）以及动量调度方法（ADANA），在51M到253M参数模型、1x到256x过训练因子下进行实验。结果表明：最佳学习率调度可能会反转，最优权重衰减系数近似按sqrt(OT)缩放，更长训练时程偏好更长的固定记忆。ADANA在优化后持续优于AdamW且优势随训练增长而扩大，而Muon和SOAP相对AdamW提供大致恒定的token效率优势。ADANA起初落后但随训练增长超越Muon并与SOAP竞争。研究确立训练时程是优化器评估与设计的关键维度。
AI.motivation: 现有优化器对比通常只在单一训练时程下进行，忽略了训练持久度（overtraining）对优化器相对表现和最优超参数的影响。作者旨在系统理解优化器性能如何随训练时程变化，并揭示过训练轴作为优化器评估关键维度的重要性。
AI.method: 作者对四种优化器（AdamW、Muon、SOAP、ADANA）在51M至253M参数规模的模型上，跨越1x至256x的过训练因子进行全面对比。在每个设置下对基础学习率进行网格搜索，并对AdamW和ADANA的固定记忆长度分别调优。实验还引入对数时间权重衰减和动量冷却等训练策略，评估其在不同训练时程下的增益。
AI.result: （1）最优学习率调度可在过训练轴上反转，最佳权重衰减系数近似随sqrt(OT)缩放，更长训练时程偏好更长固定记忆；（2）ADANA相对AdamW的扩展优势在其固定记忆单独调优后依然存在，且对数时间权重衰减与动量冷却提供了随训练时间累积的大幅增益，使ADANA的指数优势逼近DANA理论预测；（3）Muon和SOAP相对AdamW提供大致恒定的token效率优势，SOAP可能在最高过训练因子下获得更大优势；（4）ADANA起初落后于矩阵预条件方法，但随训练时间增长超越Muon并与SOAP接近。
AI.conclusion: 训练时程（overtraining）是优化器评估与设计中不可忽视的关键维度，最优超参数（学习率调度、权重衰减、记忆长度）均随训练时长系统性变化。ADANA的扩展指数优势使其在长时程训练中最具竞争力，而Muon和SOAP的优势保持恒定。这提示未来的优化器评估应纳入多训练时程框架，而非单一收敛设定。

title: CAGE: Coherence-Aware Graph Encoding for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Traditional Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems score each passage independently against the query, assembling context sets that may be individually relevant yet collectively incoherent. We introduce Coherence-Aware Graph Encoding (CAGE), a reranking framework that models "between-chunk coherence" across four dimensions: Intra-Domain Relevance, Noise Resistance, Informational Bonding, and Factual Consistency. Our pipeline transforms retrieved passages into directed heterogeneous entity graphs, amplifies factual anchors via min-out-degree reweighting, encodes structural patterns through a Relational Graph Convolutional Network, and fuses inter-chunk coherence with query relevance for final ranking. Evaluated across four multi-hop benchmarks, CAGE matches or outperforms strong baselines including monoT5 in Recall@5 on bridge-dominated datasets and consistently improves downstream Exact Match, demonstrating that structurally coherent context yields more precise answers even when retrieval recall is comparable or lower.

AI.tldr: CAGE是一个面向RAG系统的重排序框架，通过建模跨块连贯性（四个维度：域内相关性、抗噪性、信息绑定、事实一致性）来替代传统独立打分机制，利用有向异构实体图、最小出度重加权和关系图卷积网络融合查询相关性与块间连贯性，在四个多跳基准上匹配或超越monoT5等强基线。
AI.motivation: 传统RAG系统对每个passage独立打分，构建出的上下文集合虽然在个体层面相关，但整体可能缺乏连贯性，导致生成质量受损。作者认为需要显式建模"块间连贯性"而非仅依赖独立相关性评分。
AI.method: CAGE框架：(1) 将检索到的passages转化为有向异构实体图；(2) 通过最小出度重加权增强事实锚点；(3) 使用关系图卷积网络（RGCN）编码结构模式；(4) 融合跨块连贯性与查询相关性进行最终排序。连贯性建模涵盖Intra-Domain Relevance、Noise Resistance、Informational Bonding和Factual Consistency四个维度。
AI.result: 在四个多跳基准上评估，CAGE在桥接型数据集的Recall@5上匹配或超越包括monoT5在内的强基线，并持续提升下游精确匹配（EM）得分，即使检索召回率相当或更低时也能产生更精确的答案。
AI.conclusion: 结构连贯的上下文能带来更精确的答案生成，即便检索召回率相当或更低。这证明了将块间连贯性纳入重排序对于提升RAG系统是多跳推理中有效且必要的方向。

title: Leveraging Imperfect Restoration for Data Availability Attack
comment: Accepted to ECCV 2024. Equal contribution by Yi Huang, Jeremy Styborski, Mingzhi Lyu - cite in any order
summary: The abundance of online data is at risk of unauthorized usage in training deep learning models. To counter this, various Data Availability Attacks (DAAs) have been devised to make data unlearnable for such models by subtly perturbing the training data. However, existing attacks often excel against either Supervised Learning (SL) or Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) scenarios. Among these, a model-free approach that generates a Convolution-based Unlearnable Dataset (CUDA) stands out as the most robust DAA across both SSL and SL. Nonetheless, CUDA's effectiveness against SSL is underwhelming and it faces a severe trade-off between image quality and its poisoning effect. In this paper, we conduct a theoretical analysis of CUDA, uncovering the sub-optimal gradients it introduces and elucidating the strategy it employs to induce class-wise bias for data poisoning. Building on this, we propose a novel poisoning method named Imperfect Restoration Poisoning (IRP), aiming to preserve high image quality while achieving strong poisoning effects. Through extensive comparisons of IRP with eight baselines across SL and SSL, coupled with evaluations alongside five representative defense methods, we showcase the superiority of IRP. Code: https://github.com/lyumingzhi/IRP

AI.tldr: 本文针对数据可用性攻击（DAA）提出了一种名为"不完美恢复投毒"（IRP）的新方法。作者首先对现有的最强DAA方法CUDA（基于卷积的不可学习数据集）进行了理论分析，揭示了其引入的次优梯度以及诱导类别偏置的数据投毒策略。基于此分析，IRP旨在同时实现高图像质量和强投毒效果，通过在监督学习（SL）和自监督学习（SSL）场景下与八种基线方法及五种防御方法进行对比实验，证明了IRP的优越性。
AI.motivation: 在线数据的丰富性使其面临被未经授权用于训练深度学习模型的风险。现有数据可用性攻击（DAA）通常只在监督学习（SL）或自监督学习（SSL）单一场景下表现良好，而CUDA作为最鲁棒的方法，在SSL下效果不佳，且面临图像质量与投毒效果之间的严重权衡。因此需要一种既能保持高质量图像又能实现强投毒效果的方法。
AI.method: 本文首先对CUDA进行理论分析，揭示其引入的次优梯度和类偏置投毒策略。在此基础上提出IRP（Imperfect Restoration Poisoning）方法，通过"不完美恢复"的方式在保持高图像质量的同时实现强效投毒。
AI.result: IRP在监督学习和自监督学习两种场景下均优于八种基线DAA方法，并在面对五种代表性防御方法时仍能保持有效性，展现出优越性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: IRP作为一种新颖的数据投毒方法，成功解决了图像质量与投毒效果之间的权衡问题，在SL和SSL场景下均展现出优于现有基线方法的性能，为数据可用性攻击提供了更有效的解决方案。

title: FIRE-LIVWO: Robust LiDAR-Inertial-Visual-Wheel Odometry via Failure-Immune mmWave Radar Enhancement
comment: Accepted by IROS 2026.The project website is "https://kj-falloutlast.github.io/FIRE-LIVWO"
summary: Achieving robust SLAM in large-scale underground coal mines with complex structures and severe degeneracies remains highly challenging. Dense smoke and dust cause substantial loss of visual information and degrade LiDAR point-cloud features, while long, self-similar corridors induce geometric degeneration, leading to pronounced odometry drift. To address these issues, we propose FIRE-LIVWO: Failure-Immune mmWave Radar-Enhanced LiDAR-Inertial-Visual-Wheel Odometry, a tightly coupled multi-modal odometry framework based on an iterated error-state Kalman filter (IESKF). The framework fuses 4D mmWave radar, LiDAR, and visual features within a unified VoxelMap and jointly constructs LiDAR-radar point-to-plane residuals and sparse visual photometric residuals. In smoke-filled environments, we exploit the strong penetration of 4D mmWave radar and introduce pointwise Doppler velocity constraints to preserve state observability. In geometrically degenerate corridors, we tightly couple wheel odometry using non-holonomic constraints (NHC) and online lever-arm compensation to reduce drift. Our central contribution is a degeneration detection and adaptive fusion model switching strategy grounded in geometric and visual observability analysis, which quantifies observability online and dynamically adjusts modality weights. Real-world experiments in underground coal mines demonstrate that FIRE-LIVWO accurately identifies failure boundaries, enabling reliable modality switching under extreme conditions. Compared with baselines, it achieves superior accuracy and robustness (average localization error of 5.677m). We open source our code on Github to benefit the robotics community.

AI.tldr: 提出FIRE-LIVWO，一种基于IESKF的紧耦合多模态里程计框架，融合4D毫米波雷达、LiDAR、视觉和轮式里程计，通过在线可观测性分析实现退化检测与自适应模态切换，在煤矿大尺度退化环境下取得5.677m的平均定位误差。
AI.motivation: 地下煤矿环境中，烟雾和粉尘导致视觉信息大量丢失并退化LiDAR点云特征，而长直自相似走廊引发几何退化，导致里程计漂移严重，现有方法难以在大尺度复杂退化环境下实现鲁棒SLAM。
AI.method: 提出FIRE-LIVWO框架：1）基于迭代误差状态卡尔曼滤波（IESKF）紧密融合4D毫米波雷达、LiDAR和视觉特征于统一的VoxelMap中，构建LiDAR-雷达点到面残差和稀疏视觉光度残差；2）在烟雾环境中利用4D毫米波雷达强穿透性，引入逐点多普勒速度约束保持状态可观测性；3）在几何退化走廊中，通过非完整约束（NHC）和在线杆臂补偿紧密耦合轮式里程计以减少漂移；4）核心贡献是基于几何与视觉可观测性分析的退化检测与自适应融合模型切换策略，在线量化可观测性并动态调整模态权重。
AI.result: 在真实地下煤矿实验中，FIRE-LIVWO能准确识别退化边界，在极端条件下实现可靠的模态切换；相比基线方法具有更优的精度和鲁棒性，平均定位误差为5.677m。
AI.conclusion: 通过可观测性引导的自适应模态融合策略，FIRE-LIVWO有效解决了煤矿井下烟雾干扰与几何退化导致的里程计漂移问题，并在真实环境中验证了其准确性与鲁棒性，代码已开源。

title: Bridging Modalities and Tasks: A Unified Hierarchical ViT for SAR-to-Optical Translation and Semantic Segmentation
summary: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images have all-weather, day-and-night observation capabilities. However, compared with optical images, their speckle noise and non-intuitive scattering mechanism limit the interpretability of the images. Generative models for SAR-to-optical (S2O) conversion can improve visual interpretability, but existing methods often ignore the constraints on semantic structure, which are necessary for downstream tasks, for the sake of visual effects. We propose a unified collaborative dual-task learning framework, termed BMT (Bridging Modalities and Tasks), that jointly optimizes S2O image translation and semantic segmentation through a shared hierarchical Vision Transformer. The framework integrates: (1) a LocalViTBlock that fuses global self-attention with spatial depthwise convolution through a learnable gating mechanism; (2) an enhanced output module combining multi-scale refinement processing, color correction and anti-aliasing, which calibrates channel-level color statistics through feature fusion; (3) a ControlNet-style conditional injection mechanism that encodes SAR wavelet features and segmentation labels into a multi-scale feature pyramid and injects them at each encoder layer through zero-initialized convolution; (4) a bounded Kendall uncertainty weighting scheme that prevents either task from dominating the shared representation. We evaluate the framework under both paired and unpaired translation settings, on the public WHU-OPT-SAR paired dataset and a self-constructed unpaired ship dataset built from HRSID and DIOR, respectively. The experimental results show that the proposed method achieves competitive S2O translation quality and semantic segmentation performance. The dataset and source code have been publicly released at https://github.com/Lewisyuaner/BMT-S2O-main.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的协作式双任务学习框架BMT，通过共享分层Vision Transformer联合优化SAR到光学图像翻译与语义分割，在配对和非配对设置下均获得有竞争力的翻译质量和分割性能。
AI.motivation: SAR图像虽具有全天候、昼夜观测能力，但散斑噪声和非直观散射机制限制了其可解释性。现有的SAR到光学(S2O)转换生成模型通常为了视觉效果的提升而忽视语义结构约束，而这对于下游任务至关重要。
AI.method: 提出BMT框架，核心包括：(1) LocalViTBlock融合全局自注意力与空间深度卷积，通过可学习门控机制实现；(2) 增强输出模块，结合多尺度细化、颜色校正和抗混叠，通过特征融合校准通道级颜色统计；(3) ControlNet风格的条件注入机制，将SAR小波特征和分割标签编码为多尺度特征金字塔，通过零初始化卷积注入各编码器层；(4) 有界Kendall不确定性加权方案，防止单任务主导共享表示。在配对和非配对翻译设置下进行评估。
AI.result: 在公开的WHU-OPT-SAR配对数据集和基于HRSID与DIOR自建的非配对船舶数据集上，实验结果表明BMT在S2O翻译质量和语义分割性能上均达到有竞争力的水平。数据集和源代码已公开发布。
AI.conclusion: BMT通过双任务协作学习有效解决了S2O翻译中语义结构约束缺失的问题，验证了共享分层ViT框架在翻译与分割联合优化上的可行性，并为SAR图像可解释性提升提供了一种鲁棒的解决方案。

title: The History Is the Detector: Executing CVE Patch History, End-to-End
summary:
Public vulnerability databases collect rich information about known software flaws, including their weakness types, affected components, and related patches. Fixing commits provide the exact code changes that removed these flaws. While these records capture why the original code was unsafe, they are documented mainly for human inspection rather than automated reuse. Consequently, the same unsafe conditions may still exist elsewhere in code without a known advisory, leaving much of this detection knowledge unused.
  We present BUGSTONE-E2E, a framework that transforms vulnerability history into executable detection rules and validates their findings. First, BUGSTONE-E2E mines reusable rules from verified fixing commits, capturing scan anchors, fix semantics, and CVE provenance and organizing them by CWE and language. Second, detection follows a funnel-shaped pipeline: early stages process a large pool of candidates using lightweight analysis, while later stages apply increasingly capable and expensive models to a shrinking set of targets. Specifically, BUGSTONE-E2E first enumerates call sites matching rule anchors using Tree-sitter, then removes benign sites using lightweight heuristics without LLM calls. Next, LLM-based agents inspect the remaining candidates guided by the rule. Following this inspection, the system re-triages surviving candidates and builds runtime verifications, then generates scope-checked patches validated via two-sided differential tests. Using 19,325 high-severity CVEs from 2022 to 2026, BUGSTONE-E2E identifies 2,710 fixing commits and constructs 1,033 detection rules across 56 CWE families, packaged into 172 skills. When applied across 14 programs, it produced runtime evidence for 644 findings. These results demonstrate that CVE history can be turned into an executable workflow, transforming past vulnerabilities into reproducible detection and repair.

AI.tldr: BUGSTONE-E2E是一个将CVE漏洞历史转化为可执行检测规则并验证其发现结果的框架。它从修复提交中挖掘检测规则，采用漏斗式流水线（从轻量级语法分析到LLM智能体再到运行时验证）来检测和修复代码中的漏洞模式，在14个程序上产生了644个带运行时证据的发现。
AI.motivation: 公共漏洞数据库记录了已知软件缺陷的详细信息（弱点类型、受影响组件、相关补丁），但这些记录主要是为人类审查而非自动化复用设计的。因此，相同的危险条件可能仍然存在于代码其他地方而没有被已知公告覆盖，导致大量检测知识未被充分利用。
AI.method: BUGSTONE-E2E包含两个核心阶段：(1) 规则挖掘：从验证过的修复提交中提取可复用规则，捕获扫描锚点、修复语义和CVE溯源，按CWE和语言组织；(2) 漏斗式检测流水线：首先使用Tree-sitter枚举匹配规则锚点的调用点，然后用轻量级启发式方法去除良性站点（无需LLM），接着LLM智能体根据规则检查剩余候选，最后对存活候选重新排序并构建运行时验证，生成经范围检查的补丁并通过双向差分测试验证。
AI.result: 利用2022至2026年间19,325个高危CVE，BUGSTONE-E2E识别出2,710个修复提交，构建了覆盖56个CWE家族的1,033条检测规则，打包成172个技能。将这些规则应用于14个程序后，产生了644个带运行时证据的发现结果。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明了CVE历史可以被转化为可执行的工作流，使过去的漏洞能够转化为可复现的检测和修复流程，实现漏洞检测知识的自动化复用。

title: Representation Redundancy and Structural Complexity in Finite-Field Inversion
summary: The representation chosen for a mathematical operation can affect both its algebraic form and its empirical learning difficulty. We study this phenomenon for inversion over \(\mathbb F_{2^n}\), with field elements expressed in varying ordered \(\mathbb F_2\)-bases. We prove that two ordered bases induce the same coordinate inversion map if and only if they belong to the same Galois orbit. Since every orbit has size \(n\), the correspondence between ordered bases and distinct inversion maps is exactly \(n\)-to-one. We then analyze three Boolean formulations of inversion. The reference formulation has algebraic degree \(n-1\) and joint ANF leap \(1\), the mixed representation formulation has degree \(2(n-1)\) and joint ANF leap \(2\), and the complete raw formulation has degree at most \(3(n-1)\) and joint ANF leap at least \(n\). Exhaustive computations agree with the theoretical results and bounds in the cases considered. Controlled experiments with multilayer perceptrons show the same ordering in learning difficulty, while Galois orbit redundancy provides only a limited generalization benefit under the tested conditions. These results show that exact redundancy among representations can coexist with changes in Boolean structure and learning behavior when the representation is exposed as part of the input.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限域 \(\mathbb F_{2^n}\) 上求逆运算在不同有序 \(\mathbb F_2\)-基表示下的数学结构差异。证明两个有序基诱导相同坐标求逆映射当且仅当它们属于同一 Galois 轨道，轨道大小为 n，因此基与求逆映射的对应为 n 对一。分析了三种布尔表述的代数度与 joint ANF leap 差异，并通过多层感知机实验验证了学习难度的排序与理论一致。
AI.motivation: 数学运算的表示方式会影响其代数形式和经验层面的学习难度。理解有限域求逆在不同基表示下的结构差异，既有助于密码学中 S-box 设计的理论分析，也有助于理解神经网络能否从不同数据表示中学习相同底层运算的规律。
AI.method: 通过代数证明刻画有序基与坐标求逆映射之间的 Galois 轨道对应关系；计算三种布尔表述（参考表述、混合表示表述、完全原始表述）的代数度与 joint ANF leap；通过穷举验证理论结果，并使用多层感知机进行受控制的对比实验。
AI.result: 参考表述代数度为 \(n-1\)、joint ANF leap 为 1；混合表示表述度为 \(2(n-1)\)、leap 为 2；完全原始表述度最高为 \(3(n-1)\)、leap 至少为 n。穷举与理论一致，MLP 实验显示学习难度排序与理论相同，Galois 轨道冗余仅提供有限泛化收益。
AI.conclusion: 精确冗余的表示之间可以共存，但当表示本身作为输入暴露时，它们可能产生不同的布尔结构和学习行为。这揭示了"表示冗余"与"学习等价性"并非同一概念。

title: ConsensusBench: Benchmark of Consensus Nodes for LLM Reasoning via Outcome Reward Densifying
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become one of the primary paradigms for reasoning enhancement of large language models (LLMs). In particular, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and related algorithms have demonstrated strong performance with outcome-level rewards. However, these methods depend solely on the final answer, without feedback regarding which intermediate steps contribute to success or failure. As task complexity and reasoning trajectory length increase, such sparse final-answer rewards become increasingly insufficient. To address this limitation, we introduce ConsensusBench, a novel dataset designed to provide rule-based process-level signals. We posit that a correct final answer relies on a small set of intermediate conclusions throughout the reasoning process, which can be seen as a verifiable sub-outcome. We identify these sub-outcomes by filtering correct trajectories from N rollouts and clustering semantically equivalent intermediate statements. We call these clustered statements as Consensus Nodes. By integrating a rule-based process reward derived from these nodes into GRPO-style algorithms, we develop a new reinforcement learning signal named ConsensusPR. It directly reduces the reward sparsity of outcome reward across long reasoning trajectories. To facilitate systematic process-level evaluation, we introduce three metrics to our benchmark: Final Answer Accuracy (Acc), Node Coverage Rate (NCR), and Tokens per Node (TPN). Experiments across AIME 2024, AIME 2025, GSM8K, MATH-500, and our ConsensusBench demonstrate that the proposed method consistently surpasses GRPO-style approaches, highlighting the practical value of consensus nodes in guiding reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ConsensusBench数据集和ConsensusPR方法，通过从多次rollout的正确轨迹中聚类语义等价的中级结论（Consensus Nodes）来生成规则式过程级奖励信号，以缓解GRPO等算法在长推理轨迹中仅依赖稀疏的最终答案奖励的问题，实验表明其在多个基准上优于GRPO系列方法。
AI.motivation: GRPO等基于结果级奖励的强化学习方法仅依赖最终答案，无法提供中间步骤对成败贡献的反馈。随着任务复杂度和推理轨迹长度的增加，这种稀疏的最终答案奖励信号变得不足，需要过程级的反馈机制来更好地引导大语言模型的推理。
AI.method: 1) 构建ConsensusBench数据集，从N次rollout中筛选正确的推理轨迹，聚类语义等价的中级语句并将其定义为Consensus Nodes；2) 基于这些节点推导规则式过程奖励；3) 将过程奖励（称为ConsensusPR）集成到GRPO风格算法中作为新的强化学习信号；4) 提出三个评估指标：Final Answer Accuracy (Acc)、Node Coverage Rate (NCR)和Tokens per Node (TPN)。
AI.result: 在AIME 2024、AIME 2025、GSM8K、MATH-500和ConsensusBench上的实验表明，所提方法在性能上一致优于GRPO风格的方法，验证了共识节点在引导推理过程中的实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 通过识别和利用推理过程中的共识节点作为过程级奖励信号，可以有效缓解结果级奖励在长推理轨迹中的稀疏性问题，提升大语言模型在复杂推理任务上的强化学习性能。

title: SiLR: Structure-Preserving Admission and Process Reward for LLM Tool Agents
comment: 13 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Appendix includes full proofs, attack-family constructions, and the extended process-reward study
summary: A runtime gate for an LLM tool agent is usually cast as a filter. In a ReAct loop a rejected proposal is followed by another at the same state, so the gate is a search operator over the proposal stream whose admission criterion shapes which trajectories are reachable. We study post-violation recovery admission, where progress must be admitted while the system is still in violation, and identify the scalar projection trap: an aggregate-score gate accepts a locally improving proposal and commits the trajectory to a plateau. SiLR instead shadow-executes each proposal and admits it under a product order over the branch-level violation state (overloaded-branch support and per-branch severity). We prove that no scalar surrogate is sound for this order, so the failure is representational, not a matter of threshold tuning. On mined Gym-ANM scenarios, SiLR recovers 21/21 multi-action episodes against 0/21 for terminal and 9/21 for the best scalar gate, significant across the full 24-scenario benchmark. The terminal-versus-structured dichotomy holds across three model families and in CityLearn. Because admission rests on deterministic simulation, the LLM lies outside the trust boundary: a magnitude-redistribution attack that defeats both scalar and support-only baselines is contained only by the full per-branch predicate. With two constraint families active, every tested scalar projection admits physically unsafe actions; support-only admits the largest fraction (63.2% of 42,410; product order 0). In the hardest dual-family traces, scalar gates recover only through that unsafe class. Reused as a GRPO process reward, it outperforms its count projection in every mined scenario and is the only tested reward whose ungated policy exceeds the untrained base (0.844 vs. 0.778). Scalar projection loses the violation geometry at both design points; only the full product order is structurally sufficient.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM工具agent的运行时门控问题，指出基于标量投影的准入评分存在"标量投影陷阱"，并提出SiLR方法——通过对候选动作进行影子执行，并在分支级违规状态（分支支持度与各分支严重度）上的乘积序来准入动作。作者证明没有任何标量代理对该序是健全的，因此失败是表征层面的而非阈值调优层面。实验证明SiLR在Gym-ANM、CityLearn等多场景及多模型族中显著优于终端门控和最优标量门控，且在面对幅度重分配攻击时表现出鲁棒性。作为GRPO过程奖励复用时，SiLR也优于计数投影。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM工具agent的运行时门控通常被建模为过滤器，即在ReAct循环中拒绝某提案后在同一状态继续生成新提案。作者认为该门控本质上是对提案流进行搜索的算子，其准入标准决定了哪些轨迹可达。然而，此类门控（尤其是聚合标量评分）存在"标量投影陷阱"——即使接受局部改进提案，也可能使轨迹陷入平台期。此外，安全性度量在标量聚合中丢失了违规几何结构（分支级结构），导致表征不足。
AI.method: SiLR采用影子执行机制：对每个候选提案进行模拟执行，然后在分支级违规状态上依据乘积序（同时考虑超载分支支持度和各分支违规严重度）决定是否准入。作者形式化证明了对于该乘积序不存在健全的标量代理函数，因此使用标量聚合在本质上是表征缺陷。门控依赖于确定性模拟，因此LLM处于信任边界之外。该门控还被复用为GRPO的过程奖励。
AI.result: 在Gym-ANM挖掘场景中，SiLR在21/21个多动作情节中成功恢复，而终端门控为0/21，最优标量门控为9/21；在全部24个场景基准上结果显著。终端-结构化二分法在三个模型族和CityLearn中均成立。面对幅度重分配攻击，仅完整的分支级谓词能含容该攻击，标量和仅支持度基线均被击败。双约束族条件下，所有测试的标量投影都准入物理不安全动作，支持度仅投影准入比例最高（42,410中63.2%），而乘积序为0。在GRPO过程奖励复用中，SiLR在每个挖掘场景均优于其计数投影，其无门控策略是唯一超过未训练基线的（0.844 vs 0.778）。
AI.conclusion: 标量投影在两种设计点（运行时门控准入与过程奖励）上均丢失了违规几何信息，只有完整乘积序在结构上是充分的。这意味着对于LLM工具agent的合规门控，需要保持分支级违规状态的完整结构，使用部分乘积序而非压缩的标量评分，才能实现健全的恢复性准入与安全性保证。

title: Adaptation Needs in Robotic Systems: Assessing Behavior Trees and Their Enhancement
summary:
Robotic systems increasingly operate in dynamic, uncertain, and open-ended environments, where design-time assumptions may no longer hold, and adaptation becomes necessary to maintain effective and safe operation. Behavior Trees (BTs) are widely used in robotic control architectures due to their modularity, readability, and reactivity. This raises a central question: are BTs sufficient to meet the adaptation needs of modern robotic systems?
  This paper investigates this question through a literature-driven study complemented by empirical validation. First, we derive a classification of robotic adaptation needs from the literature, organizing them into six categories: Knowledge, Perception, Actuation, System, Mission, and Environment. Then, we analyze the capabilities and limitations of classical BTs with respect to these needs. Then, we characterize BT-based approaches for adaptation from the existing literature and organize them into four primary families, i.e., generation, extension, evolution, and refinement, including approaches that combine multiple families.
  Our analysis shows that the modularity, flexibility, and reactivity of classical BTs are insufficient for adaptation needs involving runtime restructuring, reasoning under uncertainty, mission reinterpretation, learning, or integration with external knowledge and planning mechanisms. Enhanced BT approaches address several of these limitations, but to different extents and often with limitations of their own. Our findings relate adaptation needs to both the capabilities and limitations of classical and enhanced BTs, providing guidance on when classical BTs are sufficient, when enhanced mechanisms are needed, and which challenges remain or emerge for adaptive robotic control architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过文献驱动与实证验证相结合的方法，系统研究行为树（BTs）是否满足现代机器人系统在动态、不确定、开放环境中对自适应性的需求。作者将机器人自适应需求划分为六类（知识、感知、执行、系统、任务、环境），并分析了经典行为树的局限性，进而将现有基于行为树的自适应方法归纳为四大家族（生成、扩展、演化、精炼）。研究表明经典行为树在运行时重构、不确定性推理、任务重新解释、学习及外部知识集成等方面能力不足，增强型行为树虽能部分解决但仍各有局限，最终为研究者选择行为树或增强机制提供了指导性框架。
AI.motivation: 机器人在动态、不确定和开放式环境中运行时，设计阶段的假设可能不再成立，系统需要具备自适应能力。行为树因其模块性、可读性和反应性被广泛使用，但行为树是否足以满足现代机器人系统的自适应需求仍是一个悬而未决的核心问题。该论文旨在回答这一关键问题。
AI.method: 采用文献驱动研究并结合实证验证。首先从现有文献中提取机器人自适应需求的分类框架，归纳为六大类别；随后分析经典行为树在应对这些需求时的能力与局限；再对已有文献中基于行为树的自适应方法进行特征化分析，将其组织为生成、扩展、演化、精炼四大主要家族（含多家族组合的方法），并最终将自适应需求与行为树能力建立映射关系。
AI.result: 经典行为树的模块性、灵活性和反应性不足以应对涉及运行时重构、不确定性推理、任务重新解释、学习以及与外部知识和规划机制集成的自适应需求。增强型行为树方法能解决其中部分局限，但解决程度各异且各有自身缺陷。研究将自适应需求与经典及增强行为树的能力和局限相关联，给出了何时使用经典行为树、何时需要增强机制以及仍存在或新出现的挑战的指导。
AI.conclusion: 论文得出结论：经典行为树在面对现代机器人复杂的自适应需求时存在结构性不足，增强型方法虽提供了改进方向但尚未完全解决所有挑战。研究者需要根据具体自适应需求类型选择合适的技术路径，该分类框架为其提供了系统性决策依据，同时指出了未来自适应机器人控制架构仍需克服的关键问题。

title: Where to Look Matters: Learning Influential Views for VLM-based 3D Visual Grounding
summary: Recent zero-shot 3D visual grounding methods leverage vision-language models (VLMs) to localize objects in 3D scenes from natural language queries. However, these methods typically rely on heuristic rules to select which camera views are provided to the VLM, often prioritizing object visibility rather than grounding relevance. We present IVSGround, a framework that learns Influential View Selection for VLM-based 3D visual grounding. Instead of using fixed heuristics, a lightweight view selector is trained to identify views that provide discriminative evidence for grounding. To obtain supervision signals, we generate training signals using feedback from a reasoning VLM through a two-stage rejection sampling process. During inference, the learned selector predicts query-conditioned influential views for each candidate object, which are then evaluated by a frozen reasoning VLM through comparative grounding. Experiments on ScanRefer and NR3D show that IVSGround consistently improves grounding accuracy over existing zero-shot pipelines, demonstrating that selecting where to look is crucial for effective 3D visual grounding. Project page: https://ivsground.github.io/

AI.tldr: IVSGround是一个零样本3D视觉定位框架，通过学习"有影响力的视图选择"（Influential View Selection），而非传统启发式规则，来为VLM提供更具判别力的相机视角。借助推理VLM的两阶段拒绝采样生成训练信号，并在推理时通过比较式定位选择查询相关的关键视图，在ScanRefer和NR3D数据集上显著提升定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本3D视觉定位方法依赖启发式规则选择VLM输入视图，往往优先考虑物体可见性而非定位相关性，导致所选视图不能提供足够的判别性证据，限制了定位性能。
AI.method: 提出IVSGround框架：(1) 训练一个轻量视图选择器替代固定启发式规则，识别能提供判别性证据的视图；(2) 通过两阶段拒绝采样过程，利用推理VLM的反馈生成监督信号；(3) 推理时，学习到的选择器根据查询条件为每个候选对象预测有影响力的视图，再由冻结的推理VLM通过比较式定位进行评估。
AI.result: 在ScanRefer和NR3D数据集上，IVSGround相较现有零样本定位管线持续提升定位准确率，验证了视图选择对3D视觉定位效果的关键性。
AI.conclusion: 选择"看向哪里"对于3D视觉定位至关重要，通过学习而非启发式的方式来选择视图，可以更有效地利用VLM的推理能力实现更精准的零样本3D视觉定位。

title: When LLM Decompilers Recompile More and Preserve Less
summary:
Decompilation recovers high-level source from compiled machine code and serves as a foundation for security tasks such as vulnerability detection and malware analysis. Traditional decompilers like Ghidra and Hex-Rays expose whatever they cannot resolve as visible placeholders and often emit pseudocode that will not compile or execute; LLM-based decompilers produce clean, idiomatic C and are now judged almost entirely by recompilability and re-executability: whether the output builds and passes its shipped input/output tests. We show that these metrics can reward the wrong path: a function may recompile and pass every shipped test yet diverge on other legitimate inputs, and a disclosed vulnerability may disappear from the recompiled code with no visible trace of the crash. Neither failure is caught by existing suites.
  To address this gap, we propose Decompile-Diverge, a behavioral comparison oracle not relying on fixed or hand-crafted tests: for each function it synthesizes a driver, grows a fuzzing corpus from the reference, and reruns the decompiled code on the same inputs to detect changes in the function's behavior. Across eight systems in nine configurations on established LLM decompilation corpora, candidates that pass every shipped test still diverge from the original on our input corpus: 4.9% overall, and as many as 13% for a single system. On 300 real GitHub library functions and 287 CVE-grounded functions, recompilability and behavioral agreement can come apart: the strongest refinement LLM lifts Ghidra's build rate from 75% to 90%, while its Matched rate falls from 74% to 62%; on disclosed vulnerabilities, up to one tenth exhibit Crash Absence in its output. Source-level analysis traces this divergence to introduced fields, types, callees, and guards that replace the visible unknowns traditional tools leave behind.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Decompile-Diverge，一种不依赖固定测试用例的行为对比验证框架，通过合成驱动程序、扩展模糊测试语料库来检测反编译代码与原始代码的行为分歧。研究发现现有LLM反编译器的重现编译/可执行性指标可能奖励错误方向：通过所有测试的候选函数仍会对其他合法输入产生行为差异，且漏洞可能在重编译代码中消失而不可见。
AI.motivation: 现有反编译评估过度依赖重现编译和可重执行性指标，但这些指标可能误导：一个函数可能重新编译并通过所有测试，却在其他合法输入上表现出不同行为；已披露的漏洞可能在反编译代码中消失且无可见崩溃痕迹，两类问题现有评估套件均无法捕获。
AI.method: 提出Decompile-Diverge行为对比oracle，针对每个函数合成驱动程序，从参考实现增长模糊测试语料库，并在相同输入上重新运行反编译代码以检测行为变化。在8个系统、9种配置上对已有LLM反编译基准进行评估，并在300个真实GitHub库函数和287个CVE函数上验证。
AI.result: 在所有通过shipped测试的候选中，平均4.9%在输入语料上与原始实现产生分歧，单个系统最高达13%。最强精炼LLM将Ghidra的构建率从75%提升到90%，但其行为匹配率从74%降至62%；在已披露漏洞中，最高十分之一的输出表现出"崩溃缺失"现象。
AI.conclusion: 重现编译/可执行性与行为一致性可能不一致甚至反向相关。行为分歧源于反编译中引入的字段、类型、被调用函数和守卫替换了传统工具留下的可见未知占位符，使得错误以隐蔽方式嵌入，建议反编译评估应纳入行为对比层面。

title: GNN-Guided Graph Coarsening and Adaptive QUBO Penalties for the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows on a Quantum Annealer
summary:
Graph coarsening reduces the large Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) formulations arising when vehicle-routing problems are solved by quantum annealing. Nearby customers with compatible time windows are merged into super-nodes, the reduced problem is solved, and the solution is expanded to the original graph. For the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem with Time Windows (CVRPTW), existing coarsening heuristics require family-specific tuning and remain unreliable on random instances. We address these limitations on the Solomon benchmark using simulated annealing and a D-Wave Advantage2 processor.
  We first introduce adaptive penalty calibration. Uniform penalty scaling has little effect, whereas controlling the internal coefficient range substantially improves raw samples. Removing non-binding constraints, normalising binding ones, and scaling the remaining penalties reduces mean raw constraint violations from 33.0 to 0.06 at the same solver budget (p=3.7e-11, n=56). A variable-count-preserving control attributes this gain to conditioning rather than problem size.
  Second, we replace the hand-tuned merge score with a graph neural network (GNN) using one configuration across all families. At N=10, it achieves 100% feasibility across all Solomon families, including R-type (100% vs. 80% for the tuned heuristic). Across N=10,...,100, feasibility is 83% vs. 69%, with the GNN better or tied on 85/90 instance-size pairs. At N=80,100, the difference is significant (p=0.002; 25/25 pairs), while the QUBO remains approximately 5-6 times smaller.
  Finally, hardware experiments reproduce the conditioning effect at fixed logical variable count: feasible samples increase from 0.02% to 39% across 13 instances. Classical repair with local search remains a reference bound for end-to-end solution cost.

AI.tldr: 本文针对量子退火求解带时间窗的容量约束车辆路径问题（CVRPTW）中的图粗化方法进行改进。作者提出自适应惩罚校准方法，将平均原始约束违反数从33.0降至0.06；并用图神经网络（GNN）替代手工调参的合并评分，在Solomon基准上跨所有实例族实现更高的可行性（83% vs 69%）；硬件实验（D-Wave Advantage2）验证了条件化效应，可行样本率从0.02%提升至39%。
AI.motivation: 现有的图粗化启发式方法在处理CVRPTW时需要针对具体实例族进行手工调参，且对随机实例不可靠。作者旨在解决这一局限，使粗化方法在不同实例族间无需重新调参即可可靠工作，并在量子退火硬件上验证改进效果。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 自适应惩罚校准：移除非约束性约束、归一化约束性约束并缩放剩余惩罚，通过控制QUBO内部系数范围而非统一惩罚缩放来改善条件数；(2) 用图神经网络（GNN）替换手工调参的合并评分函数，采用单一配置跨所有Solomon实例族；(3) 在D-Wave Advantage2上进行硬件实验，在固定逻辑变量数下验证条件化效应。
AI.result: 自适应惩罚校准将平均原始约束违反数从33.0降至0.06（p=3.7e-11, n=56）。GNN在N=10时所有Solomon族达到100%可行性（R型从80%提至100%）；跨N=10到100，可行性为83% vs 69%，在85/90个实例-规模组合上更好或持平；N=80和100时差异显著（p=0.002, 25/25组合），且QUBO规模小约5-6倍。硬件实验中，固定逻辑变量数下可行样本率从0.02%提升到39%。
AI.conclusion: 问题的条件化（而非规模缩减）是提高量子退火求解可行性的关键因素。自适应惩罚校准和基于GNN的粗化策略可以替代手工调参，在不同实例族间获得一致的性能提升。经典修复加局部搜索仍是端到端求解成本的参考基准。

title: Choosing the Right Language Mode at Inference Time for Multilingual Reliability
summary:
Multilingual large language models often struggle to reason in low- to mid-resource languages. Prior work has shown that translation can improve multilingual reasoning by helping models access stronger English-centric representations. This raises a central question: How much translation is needed for multilingual large language models to reason reliably, and when does more translation instead trigger interference and overconfidence?
  Using LLaMA and Qwen models, we run extensive experiments varying text scope and language mode (target-only, English-only, bilingual) to evaluate both accuracy and reliability.
  Our results reveal a clear trade-off: English context often improve understanding and recover errors caused by non-English comprehension, yet adding redundant bilingual context intensifies interference. We address this trade-off with Reliability-Aware Adaptive Inference (RAAI), a training-free test-time framework that (i) performs Expected Calibration Error (ECE)-aware routing and prompt fusion, and (ii) uses a mid-layer Risk Index (RI) to gate sequential reasoning, allocating compute only when it is likely to help and suppressing harmful bilingual redundancy. Across two model families, RAAI enhances accuracy by 25-37.7% on low-resource languages and lowers calibration error by approximately 3-6%, with the most pronounced benefits in the lowest-resource language tiers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多语言大语言模型在低/中资源语言推理中"需要多少翻译"的问题，提出了一个无需训练的训练时框架RAAI（Reliability-Aware Adaptive Inference），通过ECE感知的路由与提示融合以及基于中间层风险指数的门控顺序推理，在翻译带来的理解增强与冗余双语上下文带来的干扰之间取得平衡，显著提升了低资源语言的准确性和校准可靠性。
AI.motivation: 多语言大语言模型在低到中资源语言的推理上常常表现不佳，先前研究表明翻译可通过访问更强的英文中心表示来改善多语言推理，但关键问题在于：翻译量多少才合适？翻译过多是否会触发干扰和过度自信？这需要在翻译的益处与冗余上下文的代价之间找到最优平衡点。
AI.method: 使用LLaMA和Qwen模型进行大规模实验，系统地变化文本作用域和语言模式（仅目标语言、仅英文、双语），评估准确性与可靠性。在此基础上提出RAAI框架，包含两个关键组件：(i)基于期望校准误差（ECE）感知的路由和提示融合，以及(ii)利用中间层风险指数（RI）门控顺序推理，仅在可能有益时分配计算资源，同时抑制有害的双语冗余。
AI.result: 研究发现存在清晰的权衡：英文上下文通常能改善理解并修复非英语理解错误，但添加冗余的双语上下文会加剧干扰。RAAI在两个模型家族上将低资源语言的准确率提升了25-37.7%，校准误差降低了约3-6%，在最低资源语言层级中效果最为显著。
AI.conclusion: 翻译在增强多语言推理方面并非越多越好，而需要进行感知可靠性的自适应推理决策。RAAI作为一个无需训练的测试时框架，有效地在翻译理解增强与双语冗余干扰之间取得了平衡，为低资源语言场景下的多语言LLM推理提供了一种实用且高效的解决方案。

title: A Cost-Aware Agentic Architecture for NL-to-SQL over Nested Enterprise Schemas, with a New Benchmark
summary: Natural-language-to-SQL systems have ad- vanced rapidly on academic benchmarks, yet production enterprise schemas exhibit graph- like, semi-structured, deeply nested structure that current benchmarks do not measure. We make two complementary contributions. First, we introduce the DevRev NL2SQL bench- mark: 900 execution-verified queries with nested-type and link-graph structure, accom- panied by the Semantic Depth Score (SDS), a schema-agnostic rubric for analytical reasoning depth. Second, we present a cost-aware single- generation agentic architecture whose schema- selection, metadata-retrieval, and error-repair components are designed for the requirements this regime imposes. On the DevRev NL2SQL benchmark the system attains 91.7% answer correctness, a margin of 54.6 percentage points over the next-best baseline; on the Spider 2.0 Snowflake public dataset, it is competitive with leading systems at a single-generation operating point.

AI.tldr: 本文针对自然语言转SQL系统在生产级企业架构中的不足，提出了DevRev NL2SQL基准（含900个执行验证查询、嵌套类型与链路图结构，以及语义深度评分SDS），并提出了一种成本感知的单次生成智能体架构，在基准上达到91.7%的答案正确率，超次优基线54.6个百分点，同时兼容Spider 2.0公开数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有NL2SQL系统在学术基准上表现优异，但生产级企业schema往往具有图状、半结构化、深度嵌套的特征，现有基准无法对此类复杂度进行有效评估，导致系统在真实场景中的能力被高估。
AI.method: 本文包含两项互补贡献：(1) 构建DevRev NL2SQL基准，包含900个执行验证查询，涵盖嵌套类型和链路图结构，并提出schema无关的语义深度评分(SDS)来衡量分析推理深度；(2) 提出一个成本感知的单次生成智能体架构，其schema选择、元数据检索和错误修复组件均针对该复杂schema场景的需求设计。
AI.result: 在DevRev NL2SQL基准上达到91.7%的答案正确率，比最接近的基线高出54.6个百分点；在Spider 2.0 Snowflake公开数据集上与领先系统可比，且仅使用单次生成运行点。
AI.conclusion: 通过针对企业级复杂schema设计的专用基准与架构，验证了在单次生成（低推理成本）设置下也能达到生产级NL2SQL性能，弥补了学术基准与真实企业需求之间的鸿沟。

title: Development of a Humanoid Robot Prototype for Multimodal Human-Robot Interaction
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures. Published in the 2025 RIVF International Conference on Computing and Communication Technologies (RIVF 2025)
summary: Human-robot interaction (HRI) enables intuitive and intelligent collaboration between humans and robots in real-world environments. This paper introduces a humanoid robot prototype designed as a flexible testbed for developing and integrating artificial intelligence (AI) modules in HRI tasks. The system features a 12 degree-of-freedom (DOFs) dual-arm mechanism and a 2 DOFs head with an expressive LCD screen to express facial emotions. All hardware components are controlled by a custom-designed controller board with real-time AI processing supported by an onboard Jetson module. The system incorporates three AI modules: (1) gesture recognition using MediaPipe Pose and an LSTM classifier, (2) object detection with YOLO and 3D localization, and (3) voice-command processing through speech recognition and large language model(LLM)-based semantic parsing. The platform is validated through experiments on positioning accuracy, with results showing average manipulation errors of approximately 1.83 cm. To demonstrate its versatility, experimental results show over 90% task accuracy, with gesture recognition reaching 96%, speech recognition reaching 92%. The results confirm the effectiveness of the proposed system as a reproducible and accessible humanoid platform for research and prototyping in HRI.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个面向人机交互（HRI）研究的人形机器人原型平台，包含12自由度双臂系统、2自由度头部（带LCD表情屏），集成手势识别、物体检测与3D定位、语音命令处理三大AI模块。实验显示定位误差约1.83厘米，手势识别准确率达96%，语音识别达92%，任务准确率超过90%。
AI.motivation: 人机交互需要灵活可复现的测试平台来开发和集成AI模块，但现有的人形机器人平台往往缺乏灵活性和可及性，难以满足HRI研究中多种AI功能模块的快速集成和验证需求。
AI.method: 构建了一个12自由度双臂+2自由度头部的人形机器人原型，头部配备LCD屏表达面部情感。采用定制控制器板配合Jetson模块实现实时AI处理，集成三个AI模块：（1）基于MediaPipe Pose和LSTM分类器的手势识别，（2）基于YOLO的物体检测与3D定位，（3）语音识别与LLM语义解析的语音命令处理。
AI.result: 定位精度实验中平均操作误差约1.83厘米；手势识别准确率达96%，语音识别达92%，整体任务准确率超过90%，验证了平台在多模态HRI任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该人形机器人系统作为一个可复现、可访问的研究平台，有效支持HRI中AI模块的开发与集成，实验结果表明其具备良好的精度、准确性和多功能性。

title: SeamFlow: Structure-Aware Flow Matching on Edge Probabilities for Artist-Like UV Unwrapping
summary: 3D surface cutting and UV unwrapping are fundamental problems in computer graphics. Traditional geometric optimization methods mainly focus on reducing parameterization distortion, but they often overlook visual semantic coherence in seam layouts. Recent autoregressive generative methods improve semantic coherence, yet limited perception of mesh topology often causes inaccurate local cuts. To address these limitations, we introduce SeamFlow, a novel generative framework for 3D surface cutting. We reformulate the discrete mesh-cutting problem as continuous flow matching in a high-dimensional edge-probability space. Through continuous relaxation, SeamFlow learns a deterministic mapping from a Gaussian prior to a target seam-probability distribution. An evolution network couples local topological tokens with global shape priors and guides smooth probability flow through Ordinary Differential Equation solving. Compared with existing autoregressive generative frameworks, SeamFlow improves topology awareness through edge tokenization while eliminating both 3D spatial projection errors and artificial sequential-order bias. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SeamFlow achieves exceptional semantic coherence and remarkably low parameterization distortion. The project page is https://meshy-dev.github.io/seamflow.

AI.tldr: SeamFlow 是一个用于三维曲面切割与UV展开的全新生成式框架，将离散网格切割问题重构为高维边概率空间中的连续流匹配，通过边缘token化耦合局部拓扑与全局形状先验，利用常微分方程求解引导平滑概率流，在保持语义连贯性的同时实现极低的参数化畸变。
AI.motivation: 传统的几何优化方法虽能降低参数化畸变，但忽视了接缝布局的视觉语义连贯性；而近年来的自回归生成方法虽提升了语义连贯性，却受限于对网格拓扑的感知不足，常导致局部切割不准确。现有方法的局限性促使研究者需要一种既能保持语义连贯又能充分考虑网格拓扑的新方案。
AI.method: SeamFlow采用生成式框架，关键创新包括：(1) 将离散网格切割问题连续松弛为高维边概率空间中的连续流匹配；(2) 学习从高斯先验到目标接缝概率分布的确定性映射；(3) 演化网络将局部拓扑token与全局形状先验耦合，通过常微分方程求解引导平滑概率流；(4) 通过边缘token化提升拓扑感知能力，消除3D空间投影误差和人为顺序偏差。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SeamFlow在语义连贯性上表现优异，同时实现了极低的参数化畸变，优于现有的自回归生成式框架。
AI.conclusion: SeamFlow通过连续流匹配与边缘token化的有机结合，有效解决了传统几何优化与自回归生成方法在曲面切割中的各自局限，为兼顾语义连贯性与参数化低畸变的3D网格切割提供了一条新的技术路径。

title: Propagation Model for SSC attacks: Why SBOM (tools) don't tell the whole truth
summary: Ensuring security of software supply chains (SSC) is indispensable in today's world of modern software practices. SBOM (tools) have been introduced as relevant building blocks to ensure the transparency of SSCs. However they have serious limitations in practices as their vulnerability detection and interpretation capacity is not sufficient to explain exploitability effects that can propagte through the whole chain. To address this gap, we propose a propagation-centred approach to SSC security and introduce a four-stage propagation model. We empirically evaluate four open-source SBOM tools against each stage using three projects and Log4j vulnerability as our test case. Our results show that current SBOM tools systematically support only Stage 1 (Structural Exposure) and Stage 2 (Vulnerability Class Presence) while Stage 3 (Code Reachability) and Stage 4 (Taint Path Analysis) require capabilities absent from the SBOM ecosystem. We argue that putting propagation effects at the centre of SSC security research is essential to prevent cyber risk evolving into systemic risks. Our research findings contribute to a future research and design of modern SSC security tools.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以传播为中心的软件供应链（SSC）安全方法，引入四阶段传播模型，并实证评估了四个开源SBOM工具。结果显示现有SBOM工具仅系统性支持前两个阶段（结构暴露和漏洞类别存在），而第三阶段（代码可达性）和第四阶段（污点路径分析）所需能力在SBOM生态中缺失。
AI.motivation: 现有SBOM工具虽被视为保障软件供应链透明度的关键构件，但在漏洞检测和解释能力上存在严重局限，无法充分解释可沿供应链传播的利用效果，难以防止网络风险演变为系统性风险。
AI.method: 提出四阶段传播模型（结构暴露→漏洞类别存在→代码可达性→污点路径分析），并以Log4j漏洞为测试案例，对三个项目中的四个开源SBOM工具进行各阶段的实证评估。
AI.result: 当前SBOM工具仅系统性支持阶段1和阶段2；阶段3和阶段4所需能力在SBOM生态系统中完全缺失。
AI.conclusion: 应将传播效应置于SSC安全研究的中心位置，研究结果对未来SSC安全工具的研究与设计具有贡献意义。

title: Too Rare to Learn: Prescribed Cyclone Tracks Degrade a Bay of Bengal Ocean Emulator
comment: 11 pages, 7 figures. In review at the NeurIPS 2026 Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning workshop
summary: Neural ocean emulators are being proposed for regional forecasting in cyclone-exposed coastal seas, and a natural design choice is to hand the network the cyclone as a prescribed input. We test that choice in the Bay of Bengal and find it harmful. We withhold 15 whole cyclones spanning 65 to 150 kt from GLORYS12 reanalysis and compare two U-Nets that are identical except for four prescribed cyclone-track channels. Across three seeds the ocean-only model beats persistence in every run and the storm-conditioned model loses to it in every run, with the two skill ranges disjoint (p = 3.1e-5, paired across storms). The cause is exposure frequency rather than signal content: the channels are non-zero on only 7.9% of training days, so they are out of distribution the moment they activate. The extra error falls inside the prescribed storm footprint, and replacing the real cyclone map with a no-storm map at inference improves held-out storm forecasts by 7.5 to 16.4% in every seed. The conditioned network has learned a response to a rare signal that is confidently wrong.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在孟加拉湾区域海洋预报中，是否应将气旋作为显式输入馈送给神经海洋仿真器。结果表明，这一看似自然的"气旋条件化"设计反而有害：条件化U-Net在所有种子和所有风暴上的表现均不如无条件的海洋-only模型，后者甚至在每个运行中都优于持续性预报基线。原因在于气旋通道在训练集中仅7.9%的天数为非零，暴露频率过低导致通道激活时处于分布外状态，网络对罕见信号产生了"自信的错误"响应。
AI.motivation: 神经海洋仿真器被提出用于台风暴露沿海地区的区域预报，一个自然而然的设计选择是将气旋作为规定输入直接馈送给网络。作者希望通过在孟加拉湾的系统性测试来验证这一设计选择是否真正有效，挑战"信息越多越好"的直觉。
AI.method: 从GLORYS12再分析中扣留15个完整气旋（强度范围65至150节），比较两个仅在4个规定气旋轨迹通道上有所不同的U-Net架构。使用三个随机种子进行实验，将海洋-only模型与气旋条件化模型进行对比，以持续性预报为基线，并对不同风暴进行配对统计检验。
AI.result: 海洋-only模型在每个运行中都优于持续性预报，而气旋条件化模型在每次运行中都输给持续性预报，两者技能范围完全不重叠（p=3.1e-5）。额外误差落在规定风暴足迹内。用无风暴图替代真实气旋图进行推理时，留出风暴预报在所有种子中提升7.5%至16.4%。
AI.conclusion: 气旋条件化网络的失败根因是暴露频率而非信号内容：气旋通道仅7.9%的训练日为激活态，激活即处于分布外，导致条件化网络学到的是一种对罕见信号的"自信但错误"的响应。这提示在设计此类仿真器时，直接将罕见极端事件作为规定输入可能适得其反，需要更谨慎的处理方式。

title: Controlling and Assessing Appropriate Persona Use in LLM-based Dialogue Generation
summary: In persona-based dialogue generation (PDG), LLMs often overuse persona attributes by incorporating them regardless of dialogue context, resulting in unnatural responses. Despite its practical significance, the underlying causes remain unexplored, with no method to mitigate this problem or metric to assess the appropriateness of persona use. To address these issues, we first conduct a comprehensive analysis of LLM-based PDG, revealing that LLMs exhibit a systematic bias to incorporate all given persona attributes, and that existing metrics fail to capture contextual appropriateness. Building on these findings, we propose Self-CONtrastive Persona Overuse Suppression (SCONPOS) to mitigate overuse by directly intervening in LLMs' internal representations at the prompt encoding stage, without requiring any response generation. We further propose the Persona Appropriateness Score (PAS), a novel metric that penalizes both overuse and underuse. Experimental results demonstrate that SCONPOS systematically reduces overuse, and PAS captures the contextual appropriateness of persona use.

AI.tldr: 本文针对基于人格的对话生成（PDG）中大语言模型过度使用人格属性的问题，提出了SCONPOS（自对比人格过度使用抑制）方法，通过在提示编码阶段直接干预LLM的内部表征来减少过度使用，同时提出了新评估指标PAS（人格适切性评分），用以衡量人格使用的上下文适切性。
AI.motivation: 研究表明LLM在人格化对话生成中无论上下文如何都会过度使用所有人格属性，导致响应不自然。然而该问题的根本原因未被探索，也没有缓解方法和合适的评估指标来衡量人格使用的上下文适切性。
AI.method: 首先对基于LLM的人格化对话生成进行综合分析，揭示LLM存在系统性偏向将所有给定人格属性都融入回答的问题。在此基础上提出SCONPOS方法，通过直接干预LLM在提示编码阶段的内部表征来抑制人格过度使用，无需生成任何响应。同时提出PAS指标，用于惩罚人格的过度使用和不足使用。
AI.result: 实验结果表明SCONPOS能系统性减少人格过度使用，PAS能够有效捕捉人格使用的上下文适切性。
AI.conclusion: SCONPOS在无需额外生成的情况下通过内部表征干预有效缓解了PDG中的人格过度使用问题，PAS为评估该问题提供了可靠的自动化度量工具。

title: Continual Graph Memory for Adaptive Recommendation under Intent Drift
summary: This paper studies adaptive recommendation under intent drift, where feedback from each recommendation outcome can reveal whether the relational evidence used for ranking is useful, missing, or misleading. While Knowledge Graphs (KGs) provide essential semantic structure to handle these shifts, traditional KG-enhanced systems treat the graph as a static retrieval substrate, making it brittle to evolving intents, noisy metadata, and recurring failure patterns. This paper proposes CGM-Rec, a continual graph memory framework for adaptive recommendation. CGM-Rec treats the graph state as a writable memory and maintains two complementary components. Therein, a Semantic Graph Memory is updated conservatively through quality-gated typed operations for storing stable and high-confidence relational knowledge. Meanwhile, an Episodic Lesson Memory acts as a fast reactive memory that learns recent outcomes, failure cases, and corrective hints. During testing, model parameters remain frozen and adaptation occurs only through memory writes. We evaluate CGM-Rec under a frozen-parameter, one-pass reranking protocol, where encoders and prompts remain fixed during testing and adaptation occurs only through memory writes. Experiments across multiple recommendation settings show that CGM-Rec improves over evaluated neural and LLM-based baselines on most metrics. Particularly, under sampled-candidate reranking, CGM-Rec improves HR@1 by up to 29.58% over the strongest LLM baseline on Bundle, and outperforms K-RagRec on metadata-rich ML-100K with HR@5 of 0.5941 versus 0.4746.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CGM-Rec，一种用于自适应推荐的持续图记忆框架，将知识图谱视为可写记忆，通过语义图记忆（质量门控的稳定知识存储）和情景课程记忆（快速反应的学习失败案例与纠错提示）两种互补组件，在测试时冻结模型参数、仅通过记忆写入实现自适应推荐，在多项推荐基准上超越神经和基于LLM的基线方法。
AI.motivation: 传统KG增强推荐系统将知识图谱视为静态检索底物，在面对意图漂移（intent drift）、噪声元数据和重复失败模式时表现脆弱。反馈信号可能揭示推荐所用关系证据是有用的、缺失的或误导性的，现有方法缺乏在测试阶段动态适应这种漂移的能力。因此需要一种能够持续学习和修正的推荐框架，使图状态成为可更新的记忆而非固定资源。
AI.method: CGM-Rec将图状态视为可写记忆，由两个互补组件构成：（1）语义图记忆（Semantic Graph Memory）——通过质量门控的类型化操作保守更新，用于存储稳定且高置信度的关系知识；（2）情景课程记忆（Episodic Lesson Memory）——作为快速反应记忆，学习近期结果、失败案例和纠错提示。在测试阶段模型参数完全冻结，编码器和提示词保持不变，自适应仅通过记忆写入机制实现。
AI.result: 在多个推荐设置下，CGM-Rec在大多数指标上优于评估的神经和基于LLM的基线。在采样候选重排序（sampled-candidate reranking）协议下，CGM-Rec在Bundle数据集上相比最强LLM基线将HR@1提升了最多29.58%；在元数据丰富的ML-100K数据集上以HR@5=0.5941超过K-RagRec的0.4746。
AI.conclusion: CGM-Rec通过将知识图谱从静态检索底物转化为可写的持续记忆系统，配合质量门控的稳定知识长期存储与快速情景教训短时记忆，在冻结参数的条件下仅通过记忆写入即实现了显著优于现有神经和LLM基线的自适应推荐性能，验证了持续图记忆范式在意图漂移场景下的有效性。

title: Towards Neuro-Symbolic Procedural Reasoning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Manipulation
comment: Accepted as an oral presentation at the X-Reason Workshop, ECCV 2026. Non-archival extended abstract. 6 pages, 2 figures, 1 table
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can execute short manipulation skills, but remain brittle in long-horizon procedures requiring persistent task state, dependency-aware reasoning, conditional decisions, and reliable grounding. We investigate a neuro-symbolic framework that combines learned VLA control with explicit task graphs and multimodal procedural memory. Task graphs encode action dependencies, valid transitions, and branch conditions, while memory maintains the active step, completed actions, textual context, and task-relevant visual evidence. Together, these structures guide object selection, destination grounding, subgoal dispatch, and verification of expected state transitions. Human demonstrations provide additional spatial and temporal guidance through gaze or saliency cues. To isolate their effect on policy learning, our initial study bypasses cross-view gaze transfer and directly annotates pseudo-gaze in robot-view teleoperation videos. The resulting guidance is used during VLA fine-tuning and inference. We study two long-horizon manipulation domains, workspace clearing and surgical-instrument handling, which require ordered execution, visually grounded decisions, and conditional branching. We evaluate correct-object and destination selection, subtask completion, task progress, step-order consistency, complete-task success, and procedural or execution mistakes. This work positions structured symbolic reasoning and demonstration-derived visual guidance as complementary mechanisms for reliable long-horizon VLA manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种神经符号框架，将学习的VLA（视觉-语言-动作）控制与显式任务图和多模态程序性记忆结合，以解决VLA模型在长时程操作任务中的脆弱性问题。任务图编码动作依赖与分支条件，记忆维护任务状态，人在回演示中的伪注视信号为VLA微调与推理提供空间/时间指导。研究在两个长时程操作领域验证了方法的可靠性。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在执行短期操作技能方面表现出色，但在涉及持久任务状态、依赖感知推理、条件决策和可靠接地（grounding）的长时程操作流程中仍然脆弱，亟需结构化的机制来增强其可靠性与任务完成能力。
AI.method: 提出神经符号框架：1）任务图明确编码动作依赖、合法状态转换和分支条件；2）多模态程序性记忆维护当前活动步骤、已完成动作、文本上下文及与任务相关的视觉证据；3）结构共同指导目标物体选择、目的地接地、子目标调度和预期状态转换验证；4）在机器人视角远程操作视频中直接标注伪注视（pseudo-gaze），规避跨视角注视迁移问题，用于VLA微调与推理的引导。
AI.result: 在两类长时程操作领域（工作台清理和外科器械处理）中评估了多项指标，包括正确物体/目的地选择、子任务完成、任务进度、步骤顺序一致性、完整任务成功以及程序性或执行错误。结果显示结构化符号推理与演示派生的视觉引导具有互补作用。
AI.conclusion: 结构化符号推理和演示派生的视觉引导是增强长时程VLA操作可靠性的互补机制，为长时程操作中VLA的多模态学习提供了新的设计方向。

title: LUMIN: Lightweight Universal Manufacturing Inspection Network for Anomaly Detection
summary: Industrial anomaly detection faces two engineering bottlenecks: memory bank construction latency and inference efficiency. Traditional sampling algorithms (Farthest Point Sampling, K-Means, etc.) rely on numerous backbone forward passes and iterative distance computations, with construction times ranging from minutes to hours; heavy computation components such as multi-scale feature extraction struggle to meet the millisecond-level real-time requirements of production lines. This paper focuses on sampling efficiency and inference optimization for industrial deployment with two core contributions: (1) PSP (Plugin Sampler Pipeline)---a four-stage adaptive memory bank sampling pipeline based on 18-dimensional pixel metadata and five complementary visual plugins. PSP completes all sampling with zero backbone forward passes; coarse filtering is sub-second numerical sorting, and metadata extraction is a one-time offline cost. PSP supports progressive deployment and incremental updates. (2) Two engineering optimization strategies---parallel memory bank similarity computation (reducing inference memory and latency by over 95\%) and stratified pixel sampling for large-scale evaluation (reducing computation time by 20$\times$ while keeping metrics stable). As a vehicle for validation, we introduce LUMIN (Lightweight Universal Manufacturing Inspection Network) with extreme segmentation-head compression, systematically exploring the accuracy-efficiency frontier against strong baselines. Experiments on five benchmarks demonstrate that PSP matches state-of-the-art sampling accuracy at near-random construction cost (341$\times$ faster than FPS), while inference optimizations reduce evaluation time by 20$\times$ with negligible accuracy loss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向工业部署的异常检测优化方案：PSP（Plug-in Sampler Pipeline）四阶段自适应内存库采样流水线，零主干网络前向传播完成采样（比FPS快341倍），以及两项工程优化策略（并行内存相似度计算将推理内存和延迟降低超95%，分层像素采样将评估时间减少20倍且指标几乎无损）。以LUMIN网络作为验证载体，在五个基准上证明PSP在接近随机采样的构建成本下达到SOTA采样精度。
AI.motivation: 工业异常检测面临两大工程瓶颈：内存库构建延迟过高（传统采样算法如FPS、K-Means依赖大量主干前向传播和迭代距离计算，构建时间从数分钟到数小时不等）以及推理效率不足（多尺度特征提取等重计算组件难以满足生产线毫秒级实时需求）。
AI.method: 本文的方法包含两个核心贡献：(1) PSP——一种四阶段自适应内存库采样流水线，基于18维像素元数据和5种互补视觉插件，无需任何主干前向传播即可完成采样；粗筛为亚秒级数值排序，元数据提取为一次性离线成本，支持渐进式部署和增量更新。(2) 两项工程优化策略：并行内存库相似度计算（推理内存和延迟降低超95%）和分层像素采样用于大规模评估（计算时间减少20倍而指标保持稳定）。以LUMIN（轻量级通用制造检测网络）作为验证载体，探索精度-效率前沿。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上的实验表明：PSP在接近随机采样的构建成本下达到与SOTA相当的采样精度，构建速度比FPS快341倍；推理优化使评估时间减少20倍，精度损失可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: PSP采样流水线和推理优化策略有效解决了工业异常检测中的内存库构建延迟和推理效率两大瓶颈，在保持采样精度和检测指标的同时，大幅提升了部署可行性，使异常检测能够满足生产线实时要求。

title: SMILE: Bridging Continuous Optimization and Discrete Symbolic Recovery
summary: Symbolic regression (SR) discovers closed-form mathematical expressions from data, offering interpretability beyond black-box models. Existing methods suffer from slow convergence in combinatorial search spaces and lack mechanisms to exploit compositional structure in the data. We introduce SMILE (Sine, Multiplication, Identity, Logarithm, Exponential), a hybrid framework that unifies continuous gradient-based optimization with discrete symbolic recovery through three stages: structural analysis of the data to identify the compositional hierarchy of the target expression, continuous optimization to learn parameters of a network that encodes the target expression using interpretable activations, and symbolic recovery through structured pruning, coefficient optimization, and rounding. This final stage distills the learned network into a compact expression with exact symbolic constants. We evaluate SMILE on SRBench across ground-truth and black-box datasets, with ablation studies validating each component. SMILE achieves the highest symbolic solution rate at the largest noise levels, demonstrating strong robustness where competing methods degrade substantially. It consistently lies on the Pareto front of accuracy versus complexity, recovering significantly simpler expressions in a fraction of the time required by the competing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SMILE，一个混合框架，通过结构分析、连续优化和符号恢复三个阶段统一了梯度优化与离散符号搜索，在SRBench上实现了最高噪声水平下最高的符号解率，并位于准确率-复杂度帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有符号回归方法在组合搜索空间中收敛缓慢，且缺乏利用数据中组合结构的机制，导致难以高效发现封闭式数学表达式。
AI.method: SMILE包含三个阶段：(1) 结构分析：识别目标表达式的组合层次；(2) 连续优化：使用可解释激活函数学习编码目标表达式的网络参数；(3) 符号恢复：通过结构化剪枝、系数优化和取整，将学习到的网络蒸馏为具有精确符号常量的紧凑表达式。
AI.result: 在SRBench的地面真值和黑盒数据集上，SMILE在最大噪声水平下取得了最高的符号解率，显著优于退化的竞争方法；同时一致地位于准确率与复杂度权衡的帕累托前沿，恢复的表达式更简洁且耗时仅为竞争方法的零头。
AI.conclusion: SMILE通过将连续梯度优化与离散符号恢复相结合，有效提升了符号回归的鲁棒性、效率和可解释性，尤其在噪声环境下表现出显著的竞争力。

title: How Do Language Models Represent and Use Phonological Information for Allomorph Selection?
summary: Language models are trained on tokenized text that obscures the sound structure of words, yet they reliably produce morphemes whose form is phonologically conditioned. It remains unclear whether they rely on item-specific memorization or rule-like generalization and, if the latter, how that generalization is implemented. We therefore ask whether this phonological condition is represented within language models and how it is causally used for allomorph selection. For the English indefinite article a/an, we show that the phonological condition is encoded along a single linear direction in trigger-token embeddings, that this direction causally drives article selection in token-level wug tests, and that, at the article-prediction position, the model forecasts the upcoming trigger token and uses the forecasted trigger's phonological feature to choose the article. We then ask whether this rule-like generalization extends beyond English article selection, both to allomorph selection in other languages and to explicit phonological judgment. Together, these results provide a mechanistic account of phonologically conditioned allomorph selection in language models, and dissociate this generation-time ability from explicit metalinguistic judgments.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了语言模型如何表示并因果地使用语音条件来进行语素变体选择（如英语不定冠词a/an）。研究发现语音条件编码在触发词嵌入的一条线性方向上，该方向因果驱动冠词选择，且模型在冠词预测位置会先预测即将到来的触发词，再使用其语音特征来选择冠词。该规则化泛化可扩展到其他语言的语素变体选择，但与显性的元语言语音判断能力相分离。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在由分词（tokenization）处理的文本上训练，这会掩盖词的声音结构，但模型仍能可靠地产生受语音条件制约的语素。目前尚不清楚这种能力是基于逐项记忆还是规则化泛化，以及若为后者，该泛化是如何在模型中实现的。作者旨在探究语音条件是否真正被表示在语言模型中，以及它如何被因果性地用于语素变体选择。
AI.method: 作者以英语不定冠词a/an为研究对象，采用机制可解释性（mechanistic interpretability）方法：（1）检测语音条件是否编码在触发词嵌入中的单一线性方向；（2）通过因果干预（causal intervention）测试该方向是否驱动冠词选择；（3）在冠词预测位置分析模型是否预先预测即将到来的触发词并利用其语音特征；（4）将分析扩展到其他语言的语素变体选择以及显性语音判断任务，检验泛化范围和能力分离。
AI.result: （1）英语a/an的语音条件被编码在触发词嵌入的单一线性方向上，且该方向因果性地驱动冠词选择；（2）在token级wug测试中，模型在冠词预测位置对即将到来的触发词进行预测，并利用预测出的触发词的语音特征来选择冠词；（3）这种规则化泛化也适用于其他语言的语素变体选择；（4）但这种生成时的能力与模型对语音显性元语言判断的能力是分离的。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为语言模型中语音条件制约的语素变体选择提供了完整的机制性解释，表明模型内部存在规则化的语音泛化，而非仅依赖逐项记忆。同时揭示生成层面的语音敏感性与显性语音判断是认知上独立的能力，这对理解语言模型的语言学知识表征方式具有重要意义。

title: Harness-agnostic detection and immunization of reward hacking in self-evolving language models
summary: Self-evolving language models improve by proposing candidate updates and keeping whatever raises a visible score. When that score is an imperfect proxy for the capability one actually wants, sustained selection widens the gap between the two. This is reward hacking. We introduce HackProbe, a monitor that attaches to an arbitrary self-evolving loop through two black-box hooks, with no access to weights or activations. It keeps a secret, distribution-fixed comparison core, whose frozen distribution makes its capability proxy comparable across generations, alongside a rotated fresh layer that hardens the bank against co-adaptation. Four tests built on that proxy cover the level gap, a scale-aligned divergence with online change-point detection, capability stagnation, and a conditional confidently-wrong rate; a Sidak correction turns them into a calibrated family-wise p-value. Diagnosis alone recovers nothing, so a risk-aware immunization layer reselects an honest candidate from the proposal pool using the core together with a purely structural gaming footprint, disclosing at most log2 Pi bits per generation to the host. We prove a detectability bound that converts a target error rate into an explicit probe-size budget, and we delimit what probe rotation does and does not buy. On a controlled prompt-level host with four injected hacking channels and ground-truth labels, HackProbe reaches 0.763 AUROC against 0.663 for the strongest baseline and cuts the false-positive rate from 0.706 to 0.434. Its bandwidth-limited reselection is the only immunization level that returns more true capability under hacking, 5.2 points on average, than it forfeits on clean runs, 4.7; per-channel effects are mostly not individually significant.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HackProbe，一个通过两个黑盒钩子附着于任意自进化循环的监控器，用于检测并缓解奖励黑客（reward hacking）问题。它利用固定分布的"秘密"对照核心与旋转新鲜层检测四类能力代理失真信号，通过 Sidak 校正输出校准的家族 p 值，并结合结构性的游戏足迹实现风险感知免疫重选。实验显示其 AUROC 达 0.763，优于最强基线（0.663），且是唯一在黑客环境下净收益为正的免疫方案。
AI.motivation: 自进化语言模型通过不断采纳能提升可见分数的候选更新来改进自身，但当可见分数只是目标能力的非完美代理时，持续选择会扩大代理分数与真实能力之间的差距，即奖励黑客（reward hacking）。现有方法无法在不接触权重或激活的情况下对此进行有效监测与防御。
AI.method: HackProbe 通过两个黑盒钩子接入自进化循环。其核心是用固定分布保持可比性的"秘密"对照核心，外加旋转新鲜层防止共同适应。基于该代理构建四项测试：层级差距、尺度对齐散度（结合在线变点检测）、能力停滞、以及条件性高置信错误率；经 Sidak 校正得到校准的族级 p 值。检测后由风险感知免疫层从候选池中重选诚实候选，利用核心和结构性的游戏足迹，每次仅向主机披露至多 log2 Pi 比特信息。
AI.result: 在受控的提示级宿主上，注入四种黑客通道并带真实标注，HackProbe 达到 0.763 AUROC，优于最强基线 0.663，并将假阳性率从 0.706 降至 0.434。其带宽受限重选是唯一在黑客条件下真正能力收益（平均 +5.2 点）超过干净运行损耗（4.7 点）的免疫级别；各通道效应大多未达到个体显著。
AI.conclusion: HackProbe 提供了一种无需权重或激活访问的、可证明的奖励黑客检测与免疫框架，并通过可检测性界限给出探针规模预算的显式转换。研究还界定了旋转策略的实际收益边界，表明其在整体上优于基线，但单通道效果需要进一步验证。

title: What Matters, When? Diagnosing and Improving Conditional Visual Grounding in Visuomotor Imitation Policies
comment: Accepted as an extended abstract at the DexHAND Workshop, ECCV 2026. Non-archival, non-proceedings. 4 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables
summary: Visuomotor imitation policies can achieve high performance under in-distribution visual conditions yet fail when visually similar objects or receptacles are introduced. We study this behavior as a problem of conditional visual grounding: the visual target required for successful control changes with the manipulation phase and, in more complex tasks, with the observed task state. Using Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT), we systematically introduce distractor objects and receptacles with controlled color and shape similarity and localize failures to picking and placement. We find that distractor sensitivity is specific to both the type of visual similarity and the manipulation stage. Guided by this diagnosis, we evaluate distractor augmentation, phase-dependent attention regularization, and appearance-based visual prompting as complementary interventions for improving target selection while preserving spatial information required for control. These interventions substantially improve robustness in simulation and on a physical UR3e. We further examine the same failure pattern in a pretrained vision-language-action policy on a state-conditioned instrument-handling task, where the observed state of a medical instrument determines the correct destination. Together, the results show that visual distractors can cause incorrect object or destination selection even when the underlying manipulation skill remains intact, and that explicitly improving target selection can substantially recover performance across distinct visuomotor policy-learning regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了视触模仿策略在视觉干扰物（相似物体或容器）下失效的问题，将其定位为条件化视觉接地问题——视觉目标随操作阶段和任务状态变化而变化。通过系统性引入可控颜色和形状相似度的干扰物，定位失败发生在抓取和放置阶段，并提出三种互补干预方法（干扰物增强、相位依赖注意力正则化、外观视觉提示）显著提升仿真和真实UR3e机器人上的鲁棒性，并在预训练视觉-语言-动作策略上验证了相同的失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有的视触模仿策略在分布内视觉条件下表现良好，但在引入视觉上相似的干扰物或容器时会失败。作者希望研究这一失败模式的根本原因——是否为条件化视觉接地问题，即正确选择视觉目标需要依赖于操作阶段和任务状态的上下文信息。理解这一机制有助于开发针对性的解决方案，而非笼统地改进整体策略。
AI.method: 基于Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT)策略，设计受控实验：系统引入具有可控颜色和形状相似度的干扰物体和容器，分别定位抓取和放置阶段的失败。基于诊断结果提出三种互补干预：(1) 干扰物增强（distractor augmentation）；(2) 相位依赖注意力正则化（phase-dependent attention regularization）；(3) 外观视觉提示（appearance-based visual prompting），以改善目标选择同时保留控制所需的空间信息。在仿真和真实UR3e上验证，并在预训练视觉-语言-动作策略的状态条件化的仪器操作任务上检验相同失败模式。
AI.result: 研究发现干扰物敏感性既依赖于视觉相似类型又依赖于操作阶段。三种干预方法在仿真和物理UR3e上显著提升了鲁棒性。进一步验证显示，预训练的视觉-语言-动作策略在状态条件化的医疗器械操作任务中也表现出相同的失败模式——即视觉干扰物导致错误的目标或目的地选择，即使底层操作技能本身完好。
AI.conclusion: 视觉干扰物可导致不正确的物体或目的地选择，即使底层操作技能保持不变。明确提升目标选择能力可以显著恢复不同视触策略学习范式下的性能，这提示改善条件视觉接地能力是提升策略鲁棒性的关键方向，而非仅依赖整体数据增强或模型扩容。

title: CoMLP: Cooperatively-Gated MLPs for Fine-Grained Cross-Modal Information Fusion in Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Multi-modal medical images and clinical reports provide complementary anatomical, functional, and semantic information for medical image segmentation. Effectively exploiting these heterogeneous sources requires fine-grained cross-modal information fusion that preserves subtle spatial details while capturing semantic dependencies across modalities. Existing fusion approaches frequently rely on cross-attention, whose computational burden increases rapidly with spatial resolution, making dense cross-modal interaction difficult on high-resolution feature maps, particularly for volumetric medical images. In this work, we propose CoMLP, a cooperatively-gated MLP module for fine-grained cross-modal information fusion in medical image segmentation. CoMLP models cross-modal dependencies through cooperative cross-gating, built upon complementary regional and dilated MLP interactions, to capture local and global cross-modal dependencies. We further develop a multi-source fusion architecture in which CoMLP performs both inter-image fusion across imaging modalities and vision-language fusion between visual features and textual reports, enabling heterogeneous information to be integrated without relying on dense cross-attention. Extensive experiments on five medical segmentation benchmarks, covering 2D/3D images, clinical reports, multiple imaging modalities, and diverse anatomical regions, demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art multi-modal and language-guided segmentation methods. Ablation studies further show that fine-grained interaction at high spatial resolutions and complementary local-global fusion are critical to the performance gains. These results demonstrate the potential of MLP-based interaction as an effective alternative for fine-grained cross-modal information fusion in medical image segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出CoMLP，一种基于协作门控的MLP模块，用于医学图像分割中的细粒度跨模态信息融合。通过区域和膨胀MLP交互实现互补的局部-全局跨模态依赖建模，支持影像-影像与视觉-语言融合，在五个2D/3D医学分割基准上超越现有最优方法。
AI.motivation: 多模态医学图像与临床报告提供了互补的解剖、功能和语义信息，但现有基于cross-attention的融合方法计算复杂度随空间分辨率急剧增长，难以在高分辨率特征图上实现密集跨模态交互，尤其对于体数据。
AI.method: 提出CoMLP（cooperatively-gated MLP），通过协作交叉门控建模跨模态依赖，基于互补的区域MLP交互和膨胀MLP交互分别捕获局部与全局跨模态依赖；进一步构建多源融合架构，使CoMLP同时执行影像模态间的inter-image融合以及视觉特征与文本报告间的视觉-语言融合，避免依赖密集的cross-attention。
AI.result: 在覆盖2D/3D图像、临床报告、多种成像模态及多样解剖区域的五个医学分割基准上的大量实验表明，CoMLP相较于最新的多模态与语言引导分割方法取得一致性能提升。消融研究显示高空间分辨率下的细粒度交互以及互补的局部-全局融合是性能提升的关键。
AI.conclusion: 证明了基于MLP的交互可以作为医学图像分割中细粒度跨模态信息融合的有效替代方案，在无需密集cross-attention的情况下实现高效且高性能的跨模态融合。

title: Federated Attack Campaign Detection via Contrastive Encoding of Threat Indicators in Gradient Updates
comment: Accepted to ECML-PKDD 2026, 4th Workshop on Advancements in Federated Learning - Towards Trustworthy Federated Learning
summary: Detecting orchestrated cyberattack campaigns that span multiple organizations traditionally requires sharing sensitive telemetry and threat intelligence across institutional boundaries and country borders, a barrier that Federated Learning removes by training shared threat detectors directly on local data. We propose FedIoC, a modular framework in which clients fold locally available structured threat indicators into their gradient updates; we instantiate the client-side encoder with a supervised contrastive loss over IoC-matched flows. Within each training batch, flows that match any known indicator pattern form the positive set; the contrastive objective pulls their learned embeddings together and pushes non-IoC embeddings away, so that campaign-relevant structure is, by design, expressed in the gradient direction. Clients sharing indicators for the same attack campaign then produce aligned gradient components, which the server clusters by the cosine similarity of their updates to recover global campaign patterns without any direct IoC transmission. We evaluate FedIoC on two public threat-detection benchmarks distributed across FL clients that each observe only a fragment of every active campaign and hold disjoint indicator sets derived from their local telemetry. In this regime the FL server recovers cross-organizational campaign cohorts directly from gradient geometry. We contribute FedIoC as a modular framework for this setting, and use it to pinpoint the non-IID gradient structure as the main driver of recovery and to define the open problem of designing encoders that improve on it.

AI.tldr: FedIoC是一个模块化联邦学习框架，利用监督对比损失对本地IoC匹配流进行编码，客户端仅通过梯度更新共享威胁指标信息，服务器通过梯度余弦相似度聚类恢复跨组织的协同攻击活动，无需直接传输敏感IoC数据。
AI.motivation: 检测跨组织的协同网络攻击活动通常需要跨机构和国家边界共享敏感遥测和威胁情报，这构成重大隐私障碍。联邦学习虽然可以在本地数据上训练共享威胁检测器来消除这一障碍，但如何在不直接共享IoC（攻陷指标）的情况下恢复跨组织的攻击活动模式仍是一个关键挑战。
AI.method: 提出FedIoC模块化框架：(1) 客户端将本地结构化威胁指标折叠进梯度更新中；(2) 客户端侧编码器使用监督对比损失，将匹配IoC的流视为正样本集合，通过对比目标拉近其嵌入表示并推开非IoC嵌入；(3) 共享同一攻击活动指标的客户端产生对齐的梯度分量；(4) 服务器根据更新向量的余弦相似度对客户端梯度进行聚类，从而恢复全局攻击活动模式，全程无需直接传输IoC。
AI.result: 在两个公开威胁检测基准上进行评估，数据集分布在FL客户端上，每个客户端仅观察到每个活跃攻击活动的一部分片段，并持有从本地遥测推导出的不相交指标集。在这种设定下，FL服务器能直接从梯度几何中恢复跨组织的攻击活动组群。
AI.conclusion: 作者将FedIoC作为该设定下的模块化框架贡献出来，用其指认非IID梯度结构是活动恢复的主要驱动力，并将设计能改进这一点的编码器定义为开放问题。

title: Interpretability for Turing Machines
comment: 75 pages, 31 figures, 3 tables. Interactive companion: https://tminterp.timaeus.co. Code and data: doi:10.5281/zenodo.22205895
summary: We show that susceptibilities, an interpretability technique developed for neural networks, can identify the presence of algorithmic structure in Turing machines by probing the local loss landscape of a learning problem for noisy Turing machines introduced by Murfet and Troiani (arXiv:2504.08075). We prove that symmetries and path separation in the algorithm implemented by a Turing machine induce permutation symmetries and low-rank blocks in its susceptibility matrix.
