We study this empirically on a set of deterministic finite automata (DFAs) and demonstrate that algorithmic features can be recovered by principal component analysis and clustering methods in susceptibility space.

AI.tldr: 本文证明神经网络可解释性技术"敏感性矩阵"（susceptibilities）能够通过探测噪声图灵机学习问题的局部损失景观来识别算法结构，并从理论上证明算法的对称性和路径分离会诱导敏感性矩阵中的置换对称性和低秩分块，最后在DFA上通过主成分分析和聚类方法实证恢复了算法特征。
AI.motivation: 如何理解和解释神经网络内部学习的算法结构是一个核心问题。作者希望利用敏感性分析这一可解释性技术，判断神经网络是否真正学习到了图灵机所体现的算法结构，从而为可解释性和机制可解释性提供理论基础与实证依据。
AI.method: 作者在Murfet和Troiani提出的噪声图灵机学习问题框架下，对神经网络进行敏感性分析。理论上证明了图灵机算法中的对称性会在敏感性矩阵中产生置换对称性，路径分离会产生低秩分块结构；实证方面在确定性有限自动机（DFA）集合上计算敏感性矩阵，并运用主成分分析（PCA）和聚类方法在敏感性空间中进行算法特征恢复。
AI.result: 理论结果表明敏感性矩阵能够反映图灵机的算法结构（对称性和路径分离）；实证结果表明在DFA上通过PCA和聚类分析可以从敏感性矩阵中恢复算法的特征。
AI.conclusion: 敏感性矩阵是一种能够揭示神经网络内部隐含算法结构的有效可解释性工具，为理解神经网络如何实现算法提供了理论保证和可操作的实证分析框架。

title: Refuse without Refusal: A Structural Analysis of Safety-Tuning Responses for Reducing False Refusals in Language Models
comment: EMNLP 2026 Main Conference (38 pages); Code available at https://github.com/mz-kim/RwR
summary: Striking a balance between helpfulness and safety remains a fundamental challenge in aligning large language models. To achieve this balance, models should refuse harmful queries (e.g., "How do I shoot someone?") while remaining responsive to benign inputs, even those superficially resembling harmful queries (e.g., "Where can I shoot a good photo?"). However, models often struggle to distinguish genuinely harmful queries from benign queries that contain superficially risky language, resulting in false refusals. In this paper, we address the issue by decomposing a response in the safety-tuning dataset into two distinct components: (i) a boilerplate refusal statement and (ii) a rationale explaining the refusal. Our experiments and analyses show that refusal statements impede accurate discrimination between harmful and benign queries by inducing reliance on superficial cues. In contrast, training solely on rationales reduces false refusals while maintaining a comparable level of safety performance. Rationale-Only benefits also appear in our ICL configuration and remain compatible with the evaluated inference-time mitigation methods. The results emphasize the necessity of precisely curated, fine-grained safety supervision datasets and outline directions for constructing aligned agents that better reconcile helpfulness with safety.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将安全微调数据集中的回应分解为"例行拒绝语句"和"拒绝理由"两个组成部分，发现仅使用理由进行训练（Rationale-Only）能显著减少模型对良性但表面含风险措辞查询的误拒，同时保持相当的安全性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型的对齐需要在"有用性"与"安全性"之间取得平衡。模型常常难以区分真正有害的查询与仅表面含有风险措辞的良性查询，导致过度拒答（false refusals）。作者希望解决这一区分难题，降低误拒率同时不牺牲安全性。
AI.method: 将安全微调数据集中的每条回应分解为两个部分：(i) 例行拒绝声明（boilerplate refusal statement）和 (ii) 解释拒绝理由的rationale。通过实验对比训练在完整回应、仅拒绝声明、仅rationale上的效果差异；并在ICL（上下文学习）配置以及推理时缓解方法中验证仅使用rationale的收益。
AI.result: 实验表明拒绝声明会诱导模型依赖表面线索，妨碍对有害与良性查询的准确区分；而仅使用rationale训练可以在显著降低误拒率的同时保持相当的安全性能。该优势在ICL配置中同样成立，且与已评测的推理时缓解方法兼容。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了精确策划、细粒度安全监督数据集的重要性，并为构建更好平衡有用性与安全性的对齐智能体提供了方向。

title: ERPBench: Evaluating LLM Agents for Enterprise Decision-Making Across Competitive Market Ecologies
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly proposed for enterprise workflows, yet existing evaluations rarely test whether business-decision conclusions transfer across competitive market ecologies. We introduce ERPBench, an execution-instrumented benchmark for enterprise decision agents in a six-round Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) simulation with coupled pricing, production, procurement, inventory, finance, and shared-market competition. ERPBench evaluates the same 100 fixed problems in two matched competitive market ecologies: Solo, where each evaluated LLM agent competes against fixed rule-based opponents, and Arena, where six evaluated LLM agents compete in a shared market. Across six model families, this yields 1,200 model-level trajectories spanning 7,200 decision rounds. Under the observed service configuration, the leading model differs between ecologies: DeepSeek leads in Solo (252.29M mean valuation; mean rank 1.67), whereas Gemini leads in Arena (263.95M; 1.76). The two ecologies identify the same task-level winner on only 21 of 100 problems, and Gemini's bottom-rank rate falls from 22 % to 0 % in Arena. ERPBench supports paired evaluation of whether enterprise-agent rankings transfer across competitive market ecologies, supplemented by aggregate execution-intervention analysis. Code and benchmark resources are available in our https://github.com/GAIR-NLP/erp-bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ERPBench，一个面向企业决策智能体的执行型基准测试，在六回合ERP模拟中结合定价、生产、采购、库存、财务和共享市场竞争。通过Solo（对抗固定规则对手）和Arena（六个模型共享市场竞争）两种生态对100个固定问题进行比较评估，发现不同生态下领先模型不同：Solo中DeepSeek领先，Arena中Gemini领先，且两种生态仅在21/100个任务上识别出相同的任务级胜者。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理评估很少检验企业决策结论是否能跨竞争性市场生态迁移。企业在实际部署中面对的不是孤立的规则对手，而是与其他智能体共享市场竞争，因此需要一种能够区分不同市场生态的评估框架来检验排名可迁移性。
AI.method: 构建ERPBench基准，在六回合ERP模拟中设置耦合的定价、生产、采购、库存、财务共享市场模块。采用执行式（execution-instrumented）评测方式，设计两种匹配的竞争性市场生态：Solo（每个评估的LLM代理对抗固定规则对手）和Arena（六个评估的LLM代理在同一市场中共存竞争）。对100个固定问题进行两种生态下的配对比较，涉及六个模型家族共1,200条模型级轨迹（7,200个决策回合），并辅以聚合执行干预分析。
AI.result: 在观测的服务配置下，两种生态识别出的领先模型不同：Solo中DeepSeek表现最佳（平均估值252.29M，平均排名1.67），而Arena中Gemini占优（263.95M，排名1.76）。两种生态仅在100个问题中的21个上识别出相同的任务级胜者。Gemini的底排名率从Solo的22%降至Arena的0%。
AI.conclusion: 企业代理的排名并非跨竞争性市场生态稳定迁移——不同市场生态会改变模型间的相对优势。ERPBench支持对企业智能体排名可迁移性的配对评估，并通过执行层面的干预分析提供深入洞察。

title: Same Trajectory, Contradictory Rewards (ROBORMBENCH): Paraphrase Fragility in Vision Language Reward Models
summary: Vision-language models are increasingly used as reward functions for robotic learning, but this role requires paraphrase invariance: the same trajectory should receive the same reward under semantically equivalent goal descriptions. We show that current VLM reward models often violate this property. Paraphrasing the instruction alone can substantially change predicted progress scores, and can even flip identical robot behavior between failure and success. To measure this failure mode, we introduce ROBORMBENCH, a benchmark with 2,390 real-robot trajectories, ground-truth progress labels, and 21,673 verified paraphrases spanning lexical, syntactic, and action-goal rewrites. Across proprietary and open-source VLMs, paraphrase-induced instability is widespread and severe, grows under more divergent rewrites, and is not reliably reduced by scale or explicit reasoning. Dedicated reward models trained with trajectory-grounded supervision are substantially more stable. These results show that paraphrase robustness is a core requirement for reliable VLM-based reward modeling in robotics.

AI.tldr: 本文发现视觉语言模型（VLM）作为机器人学习奖励函数时缺乏释义不变性（paraphrase invariance）——语义等价的指令改写会导致奖励评分显著变化甚至成败翻转。作者引入ROBORMBENCH基准（2,390条真实机器人轨迹、21,673条核验释义）证明该问题普遍且严重，且不受模型规模或显式推理缓解；而经过轨迹监督训练的专用奖励模型则稳定得多。
AI.motivation: VLM被越来越多地用作机器人学习的奖励函数，但此类用法要求释义不变性：语义等价的目标描述应对同一轨迹给出相同的奖励。研究表明当前VLM奖励模型常常违反这一性质——仅改写指令就可能大幅改变预测得分，甚至使相同的机器人行为在失败与成功之间翻转。这种失效模式严重阻碍了VLM奖励模型在机器人学习中的可靠性。
AI.method: 作者提出ROBORMBENCH基准，包含2,390条真实机器人轨迹、真值进度标签以及21,673条经过人工核验的释义改写，覆盖词汇、句法和动作-目标改写三类。在专有与开源的多种VLM上进行系统评测，评估释义引发的奖励不稳定程度，并对比通用VLM与经轨迹监督训练的专用奖励模型。
AI.result: 实验发现：释义引起的奖励不稳定在各类VLM中普遍存在且严重，改写的发散程度越大不稳定性越强；模型规模扩大和显式推理并不能可靠地降低该问题；而使用轨迹标注监督训练的专用奖励模型则表现出显著更高的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 释义鲁棒性是可靠VLM奖励建模的核心要求。当前通用VLM在这方面的不足警示我们需要将释义不变性作为VLM奖励模型设计的关键准则，轨迹监督训练是提升稳定性的有效路径。

title: CLON: Cue-Calibrated Linguistic Object Onboarding for Zero-Shot 6D Pose Front-Ends
summary: Zero-shot 6D pose estimation pipelines increasingly rely on strong downstream pose solvers, but their performance is often limited by the front-end: object proposals must preserve partially visible true positives while rejecting semantically plausible distractors. We introduce Cue-Calibrated Linguistic Object Onboarding (CLON), a front-end requiring no task-specific training for new objects. Given rendered templates of the onboarded object set, CLON constructs a linguistic semantic memory for top-down proposal generation and object-set cue weights for calibrated proposal scoring. The linguistic memory guides SAM 3 toward high-recall proposals for onboarded objects, while cue weights are computed once from the onboarded object set before scene inference and kept fixed during online scoring. On seven BOP-Classic-Core datasets, CLON improves detection AP by 8.1 percentage points (pp), segmentation AP by 6.2 pp, and downstream 6D pose AR by up to 4.1 pp over CNOS and SAM-6D front-ends.

AI.tldr: CLON是一个无需针对新对象进行任务特定训练的前端模块，通过构建语言语义记忆和对象集线索权重来改进零样本6D位姿估计中的目标提议质量，在BOP-Classic-Core基准上相比CNOS和SAM-6D等前端取得了显著提升。
AI.motivation: 零样本6D位姿估计的性能受限于前端模块：对象提议需要在保留部分遮挡的真实正例的同时拒绝语义上相似的干扰项。现有前端方案（如CNOS、SAM-6D）在该环节表现不佳，缺乏有效机制来平衡召回率与精确率。
AI.method: CLON前端利用给定对象集的渲染模板，构建两类关键资源：（1）语言语义记忆，用于引导SAM 3生成高召回率的对象提议；（2）对象集线索权重（cue weights），在场景推理前从对象集一次性计算，并在在线评分阶段保持固定以校准提议得分。整个过程无需对新对象进行任务特定训练。
AI.result: 在七个BOP-Classic-Core数据集上，相比CNOS和SAM-6D前端，CLON将检测AP提高了8.1个百分点，分割AP提高了6.2个百分点，下游6D位姿AR最高提升4.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CLON验证了通过零训练的语言引导与校准评分机制可以有效改进零样本6D位姿估计的前端质量，从而提升整体下游位姿求解性能，为无需任务特定训练的对象实例化（object onboarding）提供了可行路径。

title: WEECFP-SuRGE: Wide Embedded Extended Connectivity Fingerprint with Substructure Rotary Graph-distance Encoding
summary: We introduce WEECFP, a parameter-free 1024-dimensional continuous molecular fingerprint that scatters each Morgan substructure across roughly thirty-two signed positions of a single vector, and WEECFP-SuRGE, a transformer architecture whose self-attention applies SuRGE (Substructure Rotary Graph-distance Encoding) -- a RoPE-like rotation parameterized by molecular shortest-path graph distance -- to WEECFP substructure tokens. A 7-model blend of this architecture (the WEECFP-SuRGE Blend) achieves the lowest average regression rank on the TDC ADMET leaderboard; is #2 overall on the TDC ADMET leaderboard (behind only pretrained MapLight+GNN), and is #1 overall among methods that use no external pretraining; takes leaderboard #1 finishes on Pgp, Lipophilicity, CYP2D6 Substrate, Clearance Microsome, and LD50 (with the WEECFP-NoSuRGE Blend separately reaching #1 on HIA) across the full 22-benchmark suite -- without any external pretraining. On MoleculeNet, WEECFP-SuRGE beats every classical-fingerprint baseline on 3 of 4 regression tasks (ESOL, Lipophilicity, QM9). We further show that WEECFP tokenization is near-lossless: a greedy overlap reconstruction recovers the exact canonical SMILES of 99.9% of in-distribution molecules across 9 MoleculeNet datasets and 98.93% of molecules in a cross-dataset holdout (HIV->Lipophilicity), and that a three-reference farthest-first encoding of graph distance correlates at Pearson r = 0.901 with the true pairwise distance, enabling O(S) positional memory at matching accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WEECFP——一种参数无关的1024维连续分子指纹，以及基于其之上的WEECFP-SuRGE transformer架构。该架构在TDC ADMET公开榜上取得平均回归排名第一、总排名第二（仅次于使用外部预训练的MapLight+GNN），在无外部预训练方法中排名第一；在MoleculeNet多个回归任务上超越所有经典指纹基线。同时证明WEECFP token化近乎无损，可重建99.9%的SMILES。
AI.motivation: 现有的分子指纹表示方法存在信息损失，而基于图神经网络的方法往往依赖外部预训练。作者希望构建一种参数无关、可解释且信息近乎无损的分子表示方法，同时设计一种无需外部预训练即可达到SOTA性能的架构。
AI.method: 1) WEECFP：将每个Morgan子结构散射到单个1024维向量中约32个带符号位置，实现参数无关的连续指纹表示。2) WEECFP-SuRGE：基于transformer的架构，自注意力采用Substructure Rotary Graph-distance Encoding (SuRGE)——一种以分子最短路径图距离为参数的类RoPE旋转，应用于WEECFP子结构token。3) 采用7模型集成（WEECFP-SuRGE Blend）。4) 使用三参考最远优先编码（three-reference farthest-first encoding）实现O(S)位置记忆，图距离相关度r=0.901。5) 提出贪心重叠重建算法用于验证token化无损性。
AI.result: 在TDC ADMET 22项基准测试中：7模型混合平均回归排名第一；总榜第二（仅次MapLight+GNN）；无外部预训练方法中排名第一；在Pgp、Lipophilicity、CYP2D6 Substrate、Clearance Microsome和LD50上取得第一名，WEECFP-NoSuRGE混合在HIA上取得第一。在MoleculeNet上，WEECFP-SuRGE在4个回归任务中的3个（ESOL、Lipophilicity、QM9）超越所有经典指纹基线。重建实验显示：99.9%的分布内分子可重建精确SMILES（跨9个MoleculeNet数据集），交叉数据集留出（HIV→Lipophilicity）重�建率为98.93%。
AI.conclusion: WEECFP作为参数无关的连续分子指纹具有近乎无损的表示能力，WEECFP-SuRGE证明了结合子结构token化与图距离旋转编码的transformer无需外部预训练即可在ADMET和MoleculeNet等基准上达到领先性能，为药物发现中的分子表示学习提供了新的方向。

title: Knowing What Not to Answer: Selective Non-Compliance in Vision-Language Models
comment: EMNLP 2026 Main Conference (43 pages). Code and dataset available at https://github.com/mz-kim/KoNA
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are expected to respond helpfully to appropriate requests while withholding compliance with requests that are incorrect, unsafe, infeasible, or unanswerable. However, existing benchmarks predominantly evaluate non-compliance at the level of the query as a whole, assuming that each request either warrants compliance or requires withholding compliance. In practice, real-world queries can contain a mixture of answerable content and components for which compliance should be withheld. In this paper, we introduce KoNA, a benchmark for evaluating selective non-compliance in VLMs across five categories: False Premise, Visual Inaccessibility, Universal Unknown, Task Feasibility, and Safety. Each task evaluates two capabilities: query-level non-compliance and component-level non-compliance under paired single and compound queries. Our evaluation across diverse VLMs shows that models often fail to refuse, correct, or abstain appropriately, and these failures become more pronounced when queries require selective non-compliance. To address this challenge, we fine-tune VLMs using KoNA examples that require selective non-compliance, together with a fully answerable set that should receive direct answers. Our fine-tuned models achieve substantial improvements in non-compliance accuracy while largely maintaining performance on fully answerable tasks. These results suggest that the fine-tuned models can distinguish between answerable components and those requiring non-compliance and respond in a task-appropriate manner.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KoNA基准，用于评估视觉语言模型（VLM）在混合查询中的选择性拒绝能力——即同一查询中既有可回答内容又有应拒绝的成分。通过五个类别（虚假前提、视觉不可达、普遍未知、任务可行性、安全）的成对单查询和复合查询评估，并通过对VLM进行选择性非合规数据的微调，显著提升了模型的非合规准确性同时保持可回答任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基准主要在整体查询层面评估VLM的非合规行为，假设每个请求要么全部应回答、要么全部应拒绝。然而真实世界查询往往包含可回答内容与应拒绝成分的混合，现有评估无法捕捉这种选择性非合规能力，导致VLM在此类场景下的表现不明确且不足。
AI.method: 作者引入KoNA基准，涵盖五个类别（虚假前提、视觉不可达、普遍未知、任务可行性和安全），每个类别通过成对的单一查询和复合查询来评估两种能力：查询级非合规和成分级非合规。此外，使用包含选择性非合规的KoNA示例连同完全可回答的样本对VLM进行微调。
AI.result: 对多种VLM的评估显示，模型经常无法适当地拒绝、纠正或弃权，且当查询需要选择性非合规时这些失败更为显著。经KoNA微调的模型在非合规准确性上获得大幅提升，同时基本保持了完全可回答任务的性能。
AI.conclusion: 微调后的模型能够区分可回答成分与需要非合规的成分，并以任务适当的方式回应，表明基于KoNA的微调是提升VLM选择性非合规能力的有效途径。

title: Train What You Deploy:Token-Faithful Post-Training of a Production Coding
summary: Existing post-training pipelines for coding and terminal agents suffer severe token and control fidelity errors: simplified training environments mismatch production deployments, and offline token reconstruction from agent logs distorts original prompts and conflates policy calls with background model operations. We present a fidelity-aware training coupling framework that retains trainer-side sampling over original prompts, eliminates spurious model calls via a negotiated training protocol, and restricts loss computation to verifiable token spans with closed-failure guarantees. We further propose Certified Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization (C-DPPO), which establishes tight two-sided TV certification bounds, adaptive-K rules, budget-aware sequence guarantees, and error-robust policy masking atop standard DPPO. Evaluated on matched Baize5B and Baize10B models with identical training and test protocols on TMax-100, C-DPPO yields a consistent +3.0-point performance gain over standard DPPO across model scales. Certificate audits validate the reliability and full operational coverage of our certified training pipeline.

AI.tldr: 提出一种保真度感知的训练耦合框架（fidelity-aware training coupling framework），解决编码与终端智能体后训练管线中令牌与控制保真度错误问题，并基于此提出C-DPPO（Certified Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization）算法，在TMax-100基准上相比标准DPPO稳定获得+3.0点的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有编码与终端智能体的后训练管线存在两类严重问题：(1) 训练环境过度简化，与生产部署不匹配（simplified training environments mismatch production deployments）；(2) 从智能体日志离线重建令牌时，会扭曲原始提示词，并将策略调用与后台模型操作混为一谈（offline token reconstruction distorts original prompts and conflates policy calls with background model operations）。这些问题导致严重的令牌与控制保真度错误，亟需解决。
AI.method: 本文提出两层技术方案：(1) 保真度感知训练耦合框架——保留训练端基于原始提示词的采样（retains trainer-side sampling over original prompts），通过协商式训练协议消除虚假模型调用（eliminates spurious model calls via a negotiated training protocol），并将损失计算限制在可验证的令牌跨度上，提供闭合失败保证（restricts loss computation to verifiable token spans with closed-failure guarantees）。(2) C-DPPO算法——在标准DPPO基础上建立紧的双侧TV（全变差）认证界、自适应K规则、预算感知序列保证以及误差鲁棒的策略掩码。
AI.result: 在相匹配的Baize5B和Baize10B模型上，采用完全一致的训练与测试协议在TMax-100基准上进行评估，C-DPPO相比标准DPPO在不同模型规模上稳定获得+3.0点的性能提升。证书审计（certificate audits）验证了认证训练管道的可靠性与完整的运行覆盖（full operational coverage）。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的保真度感知训练耦合框架与C-DPPO算法有效解决了编码/终端智能体后训练中的令牌与控制的保真度问题，在多个模型规模上取得了稳定且可靠的性能改进，并通过证书审计验证了训练管道的可靠性与完整性。

title: An Attention-Guided Global and Local Fusion Framework for Lesion-Focused Image Classification
summary: Lesion-focused image classification presents a core analytical challenge, as discriminative signals are often sparse, spatially dispersed, and easily obscured by background noise, while conventional convolutional neural networks (CNNs) process entire images uniformly and may dilute signal relevance. This study hypothesizes that adaptive fusion of global contextual information and lesion-focused local information can improve classification performance compared with using either representation independently. We propose a three-branch, attention-guided deep learning framework built on Densely Connected Convolutional Network-121 (DenseNet-121) to improve feature attribution, interpretability, and classification reliability. The architecture consists of a global branch that learns representations from full images, followed by Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) to generate attention maps that highlight prediction-relevant regions and produce masked inputs, and a local branch enhanced with a Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) to extract refined spatial and channel-wise features from these focused regions. An adaptive fusion branch integrates global and local representations by learning instance-specific weights, allowing dynamic prioritization between contextual and localized information. The framework is evaluated on a synthetic Spot Pattern Dataset (SSPD) and three benchmark datasets, including skin lesion, guava leaf, and grape leaf image datasets, where the fusion branch outperformed the individual global and local branches, reaching 97.75% accuracy on the skin lesion dataset and 99.64% on the guava leaf dataset. The results highlight the value of attention-guided architectures in healthcare analytics by improving model transparency, strengthening feature relevance, and supporting more reliable data-driven decision-making in medical image analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于DenseNet-121的三分支注意力引导深度学习框架，通过自适应融合全局上下文信息与病灶局部信息来提升图像分类性能，在皮肤病变、番石榴叶和葡萄叶等数据集上验证了融合策略优于单独使用任一分支。
AI.motivation: 病灶聚焦图像分类面临判别性信号稀疏、空间分散且易被背景噪声干扰的挑战，而传统CNN对整个图像均匀处理可能稀释信号相关性。现有方法单独使用全局或局部表征均有局限，因此假设自适应融合全局上下文与病灶局部信息可改善分类性能。
AI.method: 提出三分支框架：(1) 全局分支基于DenseNet-121从完整图像学习表征，并通过Grad-CAM生成注意力图以突出预测相关区域；(2) 局部分支使用CBAM从注意力图掩码后的聚焦区域提取精细化空间和通道特征；(3) 自适应融合分支通过学习实例特定权重动态整合全局与局部表征，实现上下文与局部信息的动态优先级分配。
AI.result: 在合成斑点模式数据集(SSPD)和三个基准数据集（皮肤病变、番石榴叶、葡萄叶）上评估，融合分支优于单独的全局与局部分支，皮肤病变数据集准确率达97.75%，番石榴叶数据集达99.64%。
AI.conclusion: 结果突显了注意力引导架构在医疗分析中的价值，通过提升模型透明性、强化特征相关性，支持更可靠的医学图像数据驱动决策。

title: Beneath the Surface of Chains-of-Thought: A Mechanistic Interpretation of Reasoning Operations in LLMs
comment: To appear in EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 43 pages, 14 figures, 19 tables
summary: Reasoning in large language models unfolds through diverse functional operations, such as problem formulation, goal decomposition, and deduction. Although these operations are explicitly distinguished in text, little is known about how they are geometrically organized in representation spaces. To this end, we investigate whether distinct reasoning operations exhibit corresponding geometric structure in hidden representations. We find that operations are separable in held-out representations, with separability peaking in middle layers, and verify that this structure is not explained by lexical or positional confounds. Across layers, token-wise operation-alignment becomes more distributed over spans, while identical surface tokens are represented differently depending on the operation of its surrounding chunk. Attention-masking interventions further show that operation-aligned representations at chunk onset depend on preceding reasoning context. Consequently, our work demonstrates that language models maintain representational correspondence between linguistic reasoning expressions and their internal geometric structures. Code and project materials are available at https://github.com/naver-ai/beneath-cot.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型中推理操作在隐藏表征空间中的几何组织方式，发现不同推理操作（如问题表述、目标分解、演绎）在其表征中是可分离的，且可分性在中层达到峰值。该结构不受词汇或位置混淆因素影响，跨层来看操作对齐从逐token分布逐渐扩展为片段级分布，相同的表层token会根据其所处推理片段的操作被差异化表示。注意力掩蔽干预实验进一步表明片段开头的操作对齐表征依赖前序推理上下文。
AI.motivation: 尽管文本中不同类型的推理操作（如问题表述、目标分解、演绎）已被明确区分，但它们在语言模型内部表征空间中的几何组织方式仍然未知，作者希望探究推理操作是否对应特定的几何结构。
AI.method: 在held-out表征上检验推理操作的可分性，通过控制词汇和位置因素排除混淆；分析跨层token级操作对齐如何演变为片段级分布式表征；并利用注意力掩蔽干预验证片段起始处操作对齐表征对前序推理上下文的依赖性。
AI.result: 推理操作在隐藏表征中是可分离的，可分性在中层达到峰值；结构不来自词汇或位置混淆；跨层操作对齐从token级向片段级分布演化，相同表层token因周围片段的推理操作不同而被差异化表示；注意力掩蔽显示片段起始的操作表征依赖已有推理上下文。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型在推理过程中维持了语言层面的推理表达式与内部几何结构之间的表征对应关系，表明推理操作的区分不仅体现在文本层级，也系统地编码于模型的隐藏表征空间中。

title: Predicting Spatiotemporal Mobile Sensing-Based PM2.5 Concentrations Using Low-Rank Adapted Spatially Attentive Graph Neural Network
comment: 24 Pages, 14 Figures, World Conference of Transport Research2026 Transport Research
summary: Urban air quality can vary significantly along transit corridors, necessitating high-resolution monitoring. This work introduces a novel mobile-sensing dataset from Surat, Gujarat, India, comprising PM$*{2.5}$ concentrations, meteorological variables (temperature, humidity, wind speed, wind direction), and land-use features. To represent the spatiotemporal data as a graph, two node-definition strategies were used: (i) uniform segmentation (200--400~m intervals) and (ii) DBSCAN clustering to adaptively group dense observations. For each node, rolling mean and standard deviation of meteorological variables were computed. To model this high-dimensional data, we propose a SA-GNN for fine-grained, short-term PM$*{2.5}$ forecasting and hotspot identification. We compared SA-GNN with LSTM, RNN, GRU, and ANN models. These models performed well on low-resolution data but had difficulty capturing rapidly changing patterns in urban air quality. SA-GNN employs cluster-specific GRUs to capture localized temporal dependencies and a Graph Attention Network to learn spatial heterogeneity. This hybrid architecture effectively models rapid fluctuations and complex spatial interactions. On our dataset, SA-GNN achieved $R^2 = 0.95$, RMSE $= 6.8$, and MAE $= 4.2~\si{\micro\gram\per\meter\cubed}$, outperforming all baseline models. Combining spatial clustering with adaptive attention significantly improves forecasting, enabling real-time, fine-grained monitoring and supporting personalized exposure tracking and timely alerts for healthier cities.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了印度苏拉特市沿交通走廊的移动感知PM2.5数据集，并提出SA-GNN（时空自适应图神经网络）模型，通过图注意力网络和簇特化GRU实现细粒度短时PM2.5预测与热点识别，R²达0.95，优于LSTM等基线模型。
AI.motivation: 城市空气质量沿交通走廊存在显著时空变化，需要高分辨率监测和精细预测，但传统低分辨率建模方法难以捕捉城市空气质量的快速波动形态。
AI.method: 构建移动感知数据集（PM2.5、气象变量、土地利用特征）；采用两种节点定义策略（均匀分段和DBSCAN自适应聚类）将时空数据表示为图；对每个节点计算气象变量的滚动均值和标准差；提出SA-GNN，结合簇特化GRU捕获局部时间依赖和图注意力网络学习空间异质性。
AI.result: SA-GNN在数据集上取得R²=0.95，RMSE=6.8 μg/m³，MAE=4.2 μg/m³，全面优于LSTM、RNN、GRU和ANN基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 将空间聚类与自适应注意力相结合可显著提升预测性能，支持实时细粒度监测，有助于个性化暴露追踪和及时健康预警，促进更健康的城市建设。

title: Intrinsic Temporal Adaptation of CLIP for Partially Relevant Video Retrieval
summary: Partially Relevant Video Retrieval (PRVR) aims to retrieve untrimmed videos that contain moments relevant to a text query. Since the target moment occupies only a portion of the video, PRVR requires retrieval based on fine-grained understanding beyond coarse video-level matching. However, existing methods often rely on frozen CLIP frame features, which lack temporal understanding. Even with recent progress in parameter-efficient CLIP adaptation, video-level predictions can still be supported by imprecise frame-level evidence. In this paper, we propose an Intrinsic Temporal Adaptation (ITA) framework for PRVR. First, our Backbone-Internal Temporal Adaptation allows the last few visual transformer layers to attend over groups of neighboring frames. This provides temporally aware frame embeddings while keeping CLIP frozen and training only adaptation parameters. Second, we introduce Affinity-Weighted Gradient Propagation to address the weakly supervised nature of PRVR, softly aggregating top-$k$ frames based on text-frame affinities and propagating learning signals to multiple query-relevant frames. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on PRVR benchmarks, demonstrates robust cross-dataset transfer, and retrieves substantially more accurate frame-level evidence within ground-truth query-relevant moments. Our code is available at github.com/hynnsk/ITA.

AI.tldr: 提出了Intrinsic Temporal Adaptation (ITA)框架用于部分相关视频检索（PRVR），通过骨干网络内部的时间适应和亲和力加权梯度传播，实现细粒度的帧级时间理解，达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: PRVR需要检索包含与文本查询相关时刻的未裁剪视频，而现有方法依赖冻结的CLIP帧特征，缺乏时间理解能力；即便有参数高效的CLIP适应方法，视频级预测仍可能被不精确的帧级证据所误导。
AI.method: 提出ITA框架，包含两个核心组件：(1) Backbone-Internal Temporal Adaptation——允许最后几层视觉Transformer层对相邻帧分组进行注意力计算，生成具有时间感知的帧嵌入，同时保持CLIP冻结、仅训练适应参数；(2) Affinity-Weighted Gradient Propagation——针对PRVR的弱监督特性，基于文本-帧亲和力对top-k帧进行软聚合，将学习信号传播到多个查询相关的帧。
AI.result: 在PRVR基准上取得SOTA性能，展现出鲁棒的跨数据集迁移能力，并且能在ground-truth查询相关时刻内检索到更精确的帧级证据。
AI.conclusion: ITA通过骨干网络内部的时间适应和弱监督下的亲和力加权梯度传播，有效解决了PRVR中CLIP帧特征缺乏时间理解的问题，实现了更优的检索性能。

title: Locating and Steering Refusal Beyond Attention
comment: 33 pages, 6 figures, 26 tables; 10-page main text plus technical appendix
summary: Where inside a language model does refusal live, and does that place change when the architecture does? In a transformer, refusal is governed by a single direction in the residual stream, a finding that safety and interpretability tooling now depend on. State-space models (SSMs) route information through a recurrent update instead of attention, sharing no token-mixing mechanism with a transformer. Does the same safety representation survive this shift, or must it be rediscovered per architecture? It survives. A single rigid rotation, which can only reorient a space and not reshape it, aligns one model's representation space with another's, so the two genuinely share the representation. A harm probe trained on a transformer then flags an SSM's harmful inputs, and removing the aligned direction makes a model answer attacks it would otherwise refuse, while a random direction of the same size does far less. What is architecture-specific is not where the direction is steered but where it must be read. Each layer computes a fresh output that is then added into the residual stream, and harm is cleanly readable at this output, the write site, before the addition. A control that holds the intervention's strength fixed shows that what matters is where the direction is estimated, not where it is applied. Applied through a detector-triggered gate, this direction lowers jailbreak success in all four architecture families we test (SSM, transformer, recurrent, hybrid), and on the SSM it holds against an attacker that tunes its prompt against the defense. The gate only matches a trivial rule that returns a fixed refusal whenever the same detector fires, so what transfers across architectures is the direction itself, not defense strength. Safety tooling built on refusal therefore ports to a new architecture by re-estimating the direction at that architecture's write site, not by rebuilding it.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型中的"拒答"（refusal）表征是否在不同架构间可迁移。研究发现，尽管Transformer和状态空间模型（SSM）的token混合机制完全不同，但拒答由残差流中的单一方向控制，且该方向在多种架构间共享。通过单一刚性旋转对齐表示空间后，跨架构的拒答方向可以互相读取和干预，能够有效降低四种架构家族（SSM、Transformer、循环、混合）的越狱攻击成功率。架构差异不在于方向本身，而在于其读取位置（写入站点）。
AI.motivation: 安全与可解释性工具依赖Transformer中拒答由残差流单一方向控制这一发现。然而SSM通过循环更新而非注意力路由信息，架构差异巨大，需要验证拒答的安全表征能否跨架构迁移，还是需要为每种架构重新发现，这直接关系到安全工具的可移植性。
AI.method: 他们使用一种单一的刚性旋转（仅能重定向空间而非重塑空间）来对齐两个模型的表示空间，从而证明模型间的表征真实共享。通过训练好的harm probe（在Transformer上训练的）检测SSM的有害输入，并通过移除对齐方向来测试其对攻击的反映。同时设计了一个探测器触发的门控机制，在四种架构家族（SSM、Transformer、循环、混合）上进行对抗性评估，并对比了随机方向的干预效果作为对照。
AI.result: 拒答方向在架构间真实共享，单一刚性旋转足以对齐表示空间使跨架构探测有效。在Transformer上训练的harm probe能识别SSM的有害输入；移除对齐方向使模型回答原本拒绝的攻击，而同等大小的随机方向效果远弱。在四种架构家族中，通过探测器触发的门控应用该方向均能降低越狱攻击成功率，且对针对防御进行提示微调的SSM攻击者依然有效。反映架构差异的是direction的读取位置（写站点），而非方向本身，固定干预强度下方向估计位置比应用位置更关键。
AI.conclusion: 拒答方向本身可跨架构迁移而非架构特异的，真正的架构特异性体现在方向必须从其写站点读取。这意味着基于拒答的安全工具可移植到新架构上，只需在新架构的写站点重新估计方向，而无需完全重建。

title: Vectorizing Classical Tamil: Representation Learning for Verse-Commentary Pairs
summary: We construct a corpus of 1,262 verse-commentary (urai) pairs from five Classical Tamil source sections, ranging from technical grammatical prose to modern paraphrase, and ask what information representation learning can recover. We train recurrent and Transformer encoders, a Siamese-style pair-matching network, an mBART-style encoder-decoder, and a decoder-only language model. Each analysis is interpreted against an appropriate control on the same data. TF-IDF provides a strong no-training lexical retrieval baseline, alongside representation analyses and generation controls for the learned models. A fixed string containing the 25 most frequent commentary words scores higher on generation overlap than the decoder-only model. Canonical correlation reaches 1.000 on Gaussian noise at these sample sizes, token-F1 spans only about 0.02-0.20 on this corpus, and the encoder-decoder continues to lower training loss for sixteen epochs after validation loss has begun to rise. One narrow result remains: the decoder-only model prefers authentic word order in 107 of 112 minimal-pair comparisons (95.5%), but does not reproduce held-out commentary content. We release the extraction and evaluation protocol; redistribution of the source commentaries remains subject to permission.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了1,262对泰米尔古典诗歌与注释（urai）平行语料，测试多种表示学习方法能否从注释中恢复信息。多数模型表现不佳：TF-IDF词法检索基线已很强、生成模型甚至不如高频词字符串、规范相关分析在噪声上即达1.000、编码器-解码器存在严重过拟合。唯一可靠结果为解码器-only模型在112对最小对中107对偏好真实词序（95.5%），但仍无法复现留出注释内容。
AI.motivation: 探索信息表示学习能否从古典泰米尔语的诗歌-注释（urai）平行对中恢复深层语义或结构信息，同时为低资源、跨历史语言阶段的语言理解任务建立可靠评估基准。
AI.method: 构建1,262对 verse-commentary 语料，涵盖五种古典泰米尔语源文本类型（从技术语法散文到现代改写）；训练循环编码器、Transformer编码器、Siamese式对匹配网络、mBART式编码器-解码器以及仅解码器语言模型；使用TF-IDF作为无训练词法检索基线，并配以表示分析和生成控制（如25个高频注释词固定字符串）。
AI.result: TF-IDF基线表现强劲；固定25个高频注释词字符串在生成重叠上反超仅解码器模型；在此样本量下规范相关分析在Gaussian噪声上达到1.000；token-F1仅约0.02-0.20；编码器-解码器在验证损失回升后仍持续降低训练损失达16个epoch（过拟合）。唯一稳健结果为仅解码器模型在112组最小对中107组（95.5%）偏好真实词序。
AI.conclusion: 在古典泰米尔语诗歌-注释对任务上，表示学习方法整体未能恢复出有意义的内容信息；大多数看似有效的结果可归因于词汇重叠、噪声过拟合或词序浅层信号。仅词序偏好一项可靠指标表明模型学到了表层句法约束，但语义级的注释复现仍未被任何模型实现。

title: SQL-Zero: Self-Evolving Text-to-SQL
summary: Training a competitive Text-to-SQL agent usually depends on human-annotated natural-language/SQL pairs, which are expensive, domain-specific, and a bottleneck for scaling to new databases. We show it is possible to train a competitive solver with zero annotated pairs. We introduce SQL-Zero, a proposer-solver self-play in which a challenger and a solver start from the same base LLM and the only ground truth is execution against the database itself. The challenger generates SQL pairs calibrated to the solver's current difficulty (targeting "hard but solvable"), and both roles are updated with GRPO in alternating turns, with a template-level repetition penalty on the challenger to prevent diversity collapse. Training on BIRD databases with no labels, self-play improves over the zero-shot base on BIRD dev by 6.6 points at 3B and 7.3 points at 7B. It also scores higher than a matched control trained under the same recipe on human BIRD gold over the same databases, although an exact paired test does not resolve that margin. Transfer depends on scale: at 3B every iteration outperforms the base on unseen Spider databases and under lexical perturbation (Spider-Syn), where it also degrades less than the matched BIRD-gold control, whereas at 7B only the first iteration preserves transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出SQL-Zero框架，仅依赖数据库执行反馈（无人工标注的NL/SQL对），通过"挑战者-求解者"自我对弈训练出有竞争力的Text-to-SQL求解器。实验表明在BIRD数据库上无标注训练可比零样本基线与有标注训练基线提升更高，但跨库迁移能力依赖模型规模。
AI.motivation: 传统Text-to-SQL智能体训练依赖人工标注的NL/SQL对，既昂贵又领域特定，限制了向新数据库扩展的可扩展性。作者希望验证一个关键问题：是否可以在完全没有标注对的情况下训练出有竞争力的求解器，从而消除数据标注这一规模化瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出SQL-Zero框架，核心是"proposer-solver自我对弈"：挑战者（challenger）与求解器（solver）从同一基础LLM出发，唯一ground truth是对数据库的执行结果。挑战者生成与求解器当前能力校准（"难但可解"）的SQL对，两者以GRPO交替轮换更新，并通过对挑战者施加模板级重复惩罚来防止多样性崩溃。
AI.result: 在无标注的BIRD数据库上训练，3B规模在BIRD dev上超越零样本基线6.6点，7B规模超越7.3点。在相同数据库上比同配方下用人类BIRD金标注训练的控制组得分更高（但精确配对检验未确认该差异的显著性）。迁移依赖规模：3B时每轮迭代在未见过的Spider数据库和词汇扰动（Spider-Syn）下都优于基线且退化少于BIRD金标注控制组；7B时仅第一轮迭代保持迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 无标注环境下通过执行信号驱动的自我对弈训练可以训练出竞争性Text-to-SQL求解器，为消除标注瓶颈提供了可行路径。但跨域迁移与模型规模呈非单调关系，需要在训练配方上进一步探索以维持更大模型的泛化能力。

title: Sound-based Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026, Project Page: https://oumi03.github.io/sound-mhpe/
summary: Can we recover the 3D poses of multiple people using only sound? This paper presents the first attempt to estimate multi-person 3D poses solely from acoustic signals. Estimating the poses of multiple individuals using acoustic signals is inherently challenging due to the superposition of motion-dependent signal variations. Unlike single-person scenarios, the presence of multiple subjects leads to overlapping acoustic signatures, making it difficult to attribute specific signal changes to an individual's pose. Furthermore, the complexity is compounded by inter-person reflections, which introduce intricate propagation delays that obscure the temporal motion-acoustic relationship. To address these issues, we propose SoundMHPE (Sound-based Multi-person Human Pose Estimator), a novel encoder-decoder framework consisting of two key components. First, the Acoustic Multi-scale Encoder captures diverse temporal and fine-grained frequency features to isolate subtle acoustic signatures from complex, overlapping signals. Second, the Temporal Pose Decoder employs an attention mechanism to disentangle multi-person information across successive frames. By jointly accounting for temporal dynamics and inter-person dependencies, this component precisely reconstructs frame-wise individual poses. To validate our approach, we constructed the 6-hour Acoustic Multi-person Pose (AMP) dataset consisting of 432K synchronized frames of multi-person pose and acoustic data, and demonstrated that our SoundMHPE outperforms baseline models. Project page: https://oumi03.github.io/sound-mhpe/

AI.tldr: 本文提出SoundMHPE，首次仅利用声学信号估计多人3D姿态。针对多主体信号叠加与人体间反射导致声学特征难以归属的问题，设计基于编码器-解码器框架，包含声学多尺度编码器（提取多样时间与精细频率特征）和时间姿态解码器（通过注意力机制解耦多人信息），并在含432K同步帧6小时的AMP数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 探索仅凭声音恢复多人3D姿态的可能性，这是该领域的首次尝试。多人场景下存在运动相关信号变异的叠加、多主体声学签名重叠以及人体间反射引入的复杂传播延迟，这些因素掩盖了时间-运动-声学关系，使得将特定信号变化归属到个体姿态变得极为困难。
AI.method: 提出SoundMHPE（Sound-based Multi-person Human Pose Estimator），一种新颖的编码器-解码器框架，由两个关键部分组成：1）声学多尺度编码器（Acoustic Multi-scale Encoder），用于从复杂重叠信号中捕获多样化时间与细粒度频率特征以分离细微声学签名；2）时间姿态解码器（Temporal Pose Decoder），利用注意力机制跨连续帧解耦多人信息，联合考虑时间动态与个体间依赖从而精准重建逐帧的个体姿态。
AI.result: 构建了包含432K同步帧、时长6小时的声学多人姿态（AMP）数据集，并通过实验证明SoundMHPE优于基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 声学信号可实现多人3D姿态估计，SoundMHPE通过多尺度声学特征提取与注意力驱动的时序解耦有效克服了信号叠加与反射干扰，为该新兴方向提供了可行的基准框架与数据集。

title: Linguistic Trajectory Encoding for Efficient Long-Horizon Spatial Memory in Embodied Agents
summary: Embodied agents performing long-horizon tasks require a memory representation in which the state transitions of dynamic objects remain queryable in natural language across hours-to-days observation horizons. Existing systems either drop fine-grained motion (clip-level video-language embeddings), keep it only as raw coordinates (geometric SLAM), or organise it around immediate task context (agent working memories). None of them gives the agent a per-object timeline whose state transitions are themselves queryable in language. Our key contribution is \textbf{Linguistic Trajectory Encoding} (LTE), which compresses dynamic object motion histories via a hybrid representation combining natural language descriptions, sparse spatial anchors, and visual anchors. LTE adapts compression to motion complexity by anchoring periods without reliable observations to the last seen location, while representing motion with geometric waypoints and linguistic descriptions to preserve accuracy. To evaluate these capabilities across extended time horizons, we construct the \textbf{Spatial Memory Benchmark} (SMB) from EgoLife multi-day recordings, targeting capabilities absent in existing benchmarks: semantic trajectory retrieval and long-horizon object retrieval. On SMB, the LTE-based system achieves $45.3\%$ success in semantic trajectory retrieval and $48.7\%$ in long-horizon object retrieval, outperforming structured-memory and VLM baselines (best prior: $31.9\%$ and $34.4\%$). LTE achieves trajectory compression by factors of $8.7\times$ to $26.1\times$ with sub-second query latency on $24$\,h video. On Ego4D natural-language queries, the system reaches $28.75\%$ / $55.10\%$ R@1/R@5, $+15.80$ / $+31.30$ pts over EgoVLPv2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种语言轨迹编码（LTE）混合表征方法，将动态物体的运动历史压缩为自然语言描述、稀疏空间锚点与视觉锚点的组合，使智能体在数小时到数天跨度的长时程任务中对物体状态变迁进行自然语言查询。作者构建了多天记录构成的空间记忆基准（SMB），在语义轨迹检索和长时程物体检索上大幅超越已有基线，并实现8.7×~26.1×的轨迹压缩比与亚秒级查询延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有内存系统存在结构性缺陷：剪辑级视频-语言嵌入丢失细粒度运动信息；几何SLAM仅保留原始坐标，不可语义查询；智能体工作记忆围绕即时任务组织，无法跨小时到天维持物体的可查询状态时间线。没有任何现有方法能为智能体提供"每个物体的、状态转换本身可被语言查询"的时间线，这是本工作要填补的空白。
AI.method: 核心方法为语言轨迹编码（LTE）：采用混合表征，将动态物体的运动历史用自然语言描述、稀疏空间锚点和视觉锚点联合压缩。压缩策略按运动复杂度自适应——在无可�observations的时段将物体锚定到上次观测位置，对可观测运动则用几何路径点与语言描述共同表示以保持精度。评估上构建了基于EgoLife多天记录的空间记忆基准（SMB），覆盖语义轨迹检索与长时程物体检索两项能力。
AI.result: 在SMB基准上，LTE系统语义轨迹检索成功率45.3%，长时程物体检索48.7%，优于结构化内存与VLM基线（此前最优分别为31.9%与34.4%）；轨迹压缩8.7×至26.1×，24小时视频查询延迟低于1秒。在Ego4D自然语言查询上达到R@1/R@5为28.75%/55.10%，比EgoVLPv2分别提升+15.80/+31.30个百分点。
AI.conclusion: LTE通过将语言描述与空间、视觉锚点相结合的混合表征，成功使长时程动态物体的状态转换历史变得可进行自然语言查询，在算法能力与存储效率上同时取得显著提升，为长时程具身智能体的记忆系统提供了新范式。

title: Training Large Language Models for Small-Molecule Design with Synthetic Task Scaling
summary: Designing viable drug candidates requires searching a combinatorially large and rugged chemical space for molecules that satisfy multiple, often competing, objectives. Large language models (LLMs) provide a useful generative prior for this problem because of their representational capacity, reasoning ability, and flexibility when incorporating information from the external environment. While reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) can be used to improve the capabilities of LLMs, many chemically relevant scoring functions require hours or even days per evaluation, making them prohibitively expensive to use directly during online training. Here, we investigate whether LLMs can learn molecular design strategies from cheaper synthetic tasks that generalize to expensive molecular lead optimization settings. We find that curriculum-based training recipes that gradually incorporate more challenging synthetic design tasks enable strong performance that surpasses that of much larger frontier models on structure-based lead optimization. Our results suggest that scaling post-training using synthetic tasks is an effective strategy for adapting LLMs to high-cost experimental scenarios that are too expensive to directly train on.

AI.tldr: 本文研究利用廉价合成任务训练大型语言模型（LLM），使其学习到的分子设计策略能够泛化到昂贵的分子先导化合物优化场景中，并发现基于课程学习的训练方法可使模型在结构导向的先导优化任务上超越更大的前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 设计可行的药物候选分子需要在组合爆炸且崎岖的化学空间中搜索满足多个（往往是相互竞争的）目标的分子。虽然LLM作为生成先验具有优势，且可以通过可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）进行改进，但许多化学相关评分函数每次评估需要数小时甚至数天，导致在线训练成本过高，无法直接使用。
AI.method: 采用课程式训练（curriculum-based training）策略，逐步引入难度递增的合成分子设计任务来训练LLM，使其学习通用的分子设计策略；随后将这些策略迁移/泛化到高成本的分子先导化合物优化任务上。
AI.result: 课程式训练方法使模型在结构导向的先导化合物优化任务上表现优异，超越了参数量更大的前沿模型（frontier models）的性能。
AI.conclusion: 利用合成任务进行后训练扩展（scaling post-training using synthetic tasks）是使LLM适应高成本实验场景的有效策略，这类场景因评估代价过高而无法直接在真实目标上进行训练。

title: Can Activation Steering Capture Multidimensional Authorship Style?
summary: Activation steering has shown promise for controlling LLM generation along well-defined attributes, but it remains unclear whether it can handle the multidimensional and hard-to-define nature of authorship style. We ask whether structured contrastive prompting along rhetorically-motivated dimensions can construct rich style representations directly in activation space, bypassing the need for natural language style descriptors or dedicated training. We find that the resulting directions share a common authorship backbone while conflicting on aspect-specific residuals that carry genuine stylistic signal, explaining why naive aggregation fails. We operationalize this in Aspect-Aware Activation Steering (A3S), a training-free framework that merges per-aspect contrastive directions with interference-aware aggregation and tunes steering strength per instance. A3S improves authorship style transfer where it is genuinely multi-aspect, outperforms a trained baseline in preference evaluations on out-of-domain benchmarks, and keeps target-exemplar overlap consistently low.

AI.tldr: 本文提出A3S框架，利用结构化的对比提示在激活空间中构造多维度作者风格表征，实现无需训练的零样本作者风格迁移，在跨领域基准上超越训练基线。
AI.motivation: 激活导向（activation steering）虽能在明确定义的属性上控制LLM生成，但作者风格具有多维性和难以定义的特点，现有方法难以处理。作者希望绕开自然语言风格描述符或专用训练，直接在激活空间中构建丰富的风格表征。
AI.method: 提出Aspect-Aware Activation Steering (A3S)框架，包含三个核心部分：1) 基于修辞学动机的维度进行结构化对比提示（structured contrastive prompting），在激活空间构建多方面风格方向；2) 干扰感知的聚合策略（interference-aware aggregation），合并各aspect的对比方向；3) 逐实例调整导向强度（per-instance tuning of steering strength）。
AI.result: A3S在真正多方面的作者风格迁移中取得改进，在跨领域基准上的偏好评估中超越了有训练基线，并保持目标示例重叠率持续处于低水平。
AI.conclusion: 本研究表明通过修辞驱动的结构化对比提示可以在激活空间中直接构造多层风格表征；作者发现各风格方向共享作者身份骨干但在aspect特定残差上存在冲突且携带真实风格信号，这解释了朴素聚合为何失败，而A3S通过干扰感知聚合有效解决了该问题。

title: Model Retirement Creates Reproducibility Risk in Biomedical AI Publications
summary:
Background. Large language models (LLMs) are being adopted in biomedical research at a rapid and accelerating pace, yet commercial services that host many widely used models operate under deprecation schedules that can complicate scientific reproducibility.
  Methods. We searched PubMed for original research articles from 2022 through March 2026 that applied a specific LLM to a biomedical task. An extraction agent identified model names from 61,077 article abstracts with human reviewers validating a subset for extraction accuracy. Extracted model names were normalized to canonical model identifiers. Lifecycle data (release date, retirement date, status) were compiled for the 50 most frequently used models.
  Results. We identified 8,931 paper-model mentions spanning 5,242 unique publications after restricting the analysis to the 50 most frequently used models. Among these mentions, 77.7% cited a commercial closed-weight model. Overall, 42% involved a model that was already retired by the time of official publication or is scheduled to retire within two years of publication. The median interval from publication to model retirement was 538 days.
  Conclusion. Many biomedical publications using LLMs are on a trajectory toward computational non-reproducibility after publication. Model deprecation should be treated as a core reporting and preservation issue for biomedical research.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了2022年至2026年3月间PubMed上61,077篇使用大型语言模型（LLMs）的生物医学研究摘要，发现8,931条论文-模型提及中77.7%引用商用闭源模型，42%涉及的模型在论文发表时已退役或将在两年内退役，中位退役间隔为538天，揭示了LLM模型生命周期管理对生物医学研究可重现性的严重威胁。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在生物医学研究中被迅速采用，但许多广泛使用的商业模型服务遵循弃用时间表，这可能会影响科学研究的可重现性。作者旨在量化这一问题的严重程度。
AI.method: 搜索PubMed中2022年至2026年3月间应用特定LLM到生物医学任务的原创研究文章。使用提取代理从61,077篇论文摘要中识别模型名称，人工审阅验证子集准确性。将模型名规范化到规范标识符，并为使用频率最高的50个模型编制生命周期数据（发布日期、退役日期、状态）。
AI.result: 在限制分析到50个最常用模型后，识别出8,931条论文-模型提及，涵盖5,242篇独特出版物。其中77.7%提及引用商用闭源模型。42%涉及的模型在论文正式发表时已经退役或计划在发表两年内退役。从发表到模型退役的中位间隔为538天。
AI.conclusion: 许多使用LLMs的生物医学出版物正朝着发表后计算不可重现的方向发展。模型弃用应被视为生物医学研究的核心报告和保存问题。

title: One Diffusion Model, Two Roles: Guided Trajectory Planning and Safety-Critical Scenario Generation in Closed-Loop Simulation
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026 workshop. Arka and Rajesh have equal contribution
summary: Diffusion probabilistic models can capture the multi-modal, interaction-rich distribution of joint future trajectories in driving scenes. We show that a single pretrained diffusion traffic model can serve two complementary roles in the autonomous driving development loop: as an ego motion planner, and as a controllable generator of safety-critical scenarios for stress-testing the planners. On the planning side, we introduce a Single-Stream Dual-Stream (SSDS) diffusion-transformer decoder that fuses scene context via joint attention rather than late cross-attention, improving closed-loop performance on nuPlan. We further propose Decoupled Annealing Posterior Sampling with Energy (DAPSE), a training-free guidance scheme that injects arbitrary energy functions at the clean-sample level, avoiding the first-order approximation errors while requiring no auxiliary networks. Beyond planning, we leverage the same diffusion model as a controllable scenario generator to create realistic long-tail driving interactions for closed-loop evaluation. Through inference-time guidance, selected agents are steered toward safety-critical behaviors, including aggressive cut-ins, lead-vehicle braking, and combined longitudinal-lateral interactions, while preserving realistic traffic behaviors. Evaluated in closed-loop nuPlan simulations with independent black-box planners, the generated scenarios expose failure modes that remain hidden under standard benchmarks. Although the SSDS-based planner achieves stronger nominal performance, it experiences larger degradation under these challenging scenarios, demonstrating that benchmark superiority does not necessarily translate to robustness. These results demonstrate that a single learned traffic prior can simultaneously improve motion planning and provide a realistic framework for systematic planner robustness evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了一个预训练的扩散交通模型可在自动驾驶开发中扮演双重角色：既作为自车运动规划器，又作为可控的安全关键场景生成器，用于对规划器进行压力测试。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶规划器通常在标准基准上表现良好，但在安全关键的长尾交互场景中可能暴露隐藏的失败模式。现有方法将规划与场景生成分离，缺乏统一框架来同时提升规划性能并系统评估规划器鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出两个核心组件：(1) SSDS（Single-Stream Dual-Stream）扩散Transformer解码器，通过联合注意力而非后期交叉注意力融合场景上下文，提升闭环规划性能；(2) DAPSE（Decoupled Annealing Posterior Sampling with Energy），一种免训练的引导方案，在干净样本级别注入任意能量函数，避免一阶近似误差且无需辅助网络。同时利用同一扩散模型作为可控场景生成器，通过推理时引导使选定智能体产生安全关键行为（激进切入、前车制动、纵横组合交互）。
AI.result: 在nuPlan闭环仿真中，SSDS规划器获得更强的名义性能，但在生成的挑战性场景下性能退化更大，表明基准上的优越性并不必然转化为鲁棒性。生成的场景能暴露标准基准下隐藏的规划器失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 单一学习到的交通先验可以同时改进运动规划性能，并为系统化规划器鲁棒性评估提供现实框架，揭示了基准优越性与鲁棒性之间的差距。

title: Weather-Conditioned Depth Anything
summary: Monocular depth estimation foundation models, such as the Depth Anything series, have achieved remarkable performance across diverse domains. However, they still suffer from critical failures under adverse weather conditions, such as fog, rain, snow, or at night. To address this, we present Weather-Conditioned Depth Anything (DA-W), a framework that explicitly disentangles style from content for weather-robust depth estimation. Specifically, we introduce a Style Filter trained on a curated mix of real and synthetic degradation datasets to extract content-independent, degradation-aware weather embeddings. This style embedding is then injected into the Depth Anything backbone using a parameter-efficient, zero-initialized adapter. Such a lightweight modulation allows a single unified model to robustly adapt to diverse conditions, including fog, rain, snow, and low-light, while avoiding catastrophic forgetting of its core generalization abilities in normal conditions. We train the adapter using a pseudo-label distillation and alignment strategy. Our comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed DA-W achieves state-of-the-art robust depth estimation, improving AbsRel by an average of 3.7% on our curated weather benchmarks, while matching or slightly outperforming performance on standard clean benchmarks. Our project page is available at https://zhaoming-tamu.github.io/WCDA/.

AI.tldr: DA-W (Weather-Conditioned Depth Anything) 是一个面向恶劣天气下鲁棒单目深度估计的框架，通过Style Filter提取与内容无关的天气嵌入，并将其注入Depth Anything骨干网络的轻量级适配器中，在保持干净场景性能的同时显著提升雾、雨、雪和低光条件下的深度估计精度。
AI.motivation: 单目深度估计基础模型（如Depth Anything系列）在正常条件下表现出色，但在雾、雨、雪、夜间等恶劣天气条件下仍会发生严重的失效问题。
AI.method: 1) 引入Style Filter，在真实与合成退化数据混合集上训练，提取内容无关、退化感知的天气嵌入；2) 通过参数高效、零初始化的适配器将风格嵌入注入Depth Anything骨干网络；3) 使用伪标签蒸馏与对齐策略训练适配器，实现单一统一模型对多种条件鲁棒适应，同时避免灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 在策划的天气基准上，AbsRel平均提升3.7%，达到最先进水平；在标准干净基准上性能匹配或略优。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式解耦风格与内容、以轻量调制方式注入天气信息，DA-W能够在多种恶劣天气条件下实现稳健的深度估计，且不牺牲正常条件下的泛化能力。

title: A Fairness Audit of the Duckworth-Lewis-Stern Method: Format-Specific and Gender-Differential Bias, with an Interpretable Calibration Layer for Cricket Target Revision
comment: Accepted for publication in the Journal of Quantitative Analysis in Sports (JQAS); forthcoming
summary: The Duckworth-Lewis-Stern (DLS) method has been the international standard for revising target scores in rain-interrupted limited-overs cricket since 1999. Despite over two decades of operational use, no large-scale empirical audit of its prediction bias has been published. We conduct such an audit on 8,150 international matches (3,095 ODIs, 5,055 T20Is) from Cricsheet, generating 233,550 synthetic interruption scenarios with temporal splits. We document two structured biases. First, DLS prediction error spans a 137-run range across (overs-remaining, wickets-lost) match-state buckets. Second, DLS exhibits a gender-differential bias on ODIs that has not previously been quantified: on the training split, mean over-prediction is +1.51 runs for men but +7.63 runs for women, a gap of +6.13 runs (F = 195.16, p < 10^-43). We benchmark DLS against five modern alternatives: Bi-LSTM, XGBoost, an enriched XGBoost variant, a deep context-aware model, and a stacking ensemble, and propose DLS-Cal, a lightweight interpretable calibration layer (27K parameters) outputting a state-conditioned correction added to DLS. DLS-Cal reduces absolute bias by 31% on ODI and 19% on T20I, and a gender-aware variant reduces women's ODI residual bias from +6.19 to +0.65 runs while leaving men's calibration unchanged. We release code, models, and data.

AI.tldr: 本文对DLS方法进行了迄今最大规模的经验性审计（8,150场国际比赛，233,550个合成中断场景），发现DLS预测偏差存在两个结构化问题：跨比赛状态桶的137分偏差范围，以及此前未被量化的性别差异偏差（男子+1.51分 vs. 女子+7.63分）。作者提出DLS-Cal，一个轻量级可解释校准层（27K参数），可将绝对偏差在ODI上减少31%、T20I上减少19%，性别感知变体将女子ODI残差从+6.19降至+0.65分。
AI.motivation: DLS方法自1999年起作为国际标准用于修订雨天中断的板球比赛目标分数，运营超过二十年，但从未有过大规模经验性审计其预测偏差。本文旨在填补这一空白，系统量化DLS的结构性偏差。
AI.method: 使用Cricsheet的8,150场国际比赛（3,095场ODI和5,055场T20I）数据，生成233,550个带时间分割的合成中断场景，对DLS的预测误差进行逐桶审计。将DLS与五种现代替代方法（Bi-LSTM、XGBoost、增强XGBoost、深度上下文感知模型、堆叠集成）进行基准比较。提出DLS-Cal这一轻量级可解释校准层（27K参数），输出基于比赛状态的条件修正量叠加到DLS预测上；同时提出性别感知变体。
AI.result: 审计发现DLS预测误差在(剩余回合数, 失分数)状态桶间跨越137分；在ODI上存在显著性别差异偏差：训练集上男子平均高估+1.51分，女子+7.63分，差异达+6.13分（F=195.16, p<10^-43）。DLS-Cal将ODI绝对偏差降低31%，T20I降低19%；性别感知变体将女子ODI残差偏差从+6.19降至+0.65分，且不影响男子校准结果。
AI.conclusion: DLS虽长期作为国际标准运行，但存在此前未被量化的结构性偏差与显著的性别差异。DLS-Cal以极轻量的参数和可解释的校准方式有效修正了这些偏差，且代码、模型和数据均已开源，为板球目标分数修订标准提供了可经验验证的改进路径。

title: Recurrence Is Not Enough: Causally Validating Multilingual SAE Translation Features in Gemma 2 and 3
summary:
Sparse autoencoder (SAE) features are increasingly used to explain and steer language-model behavior, but it remains unclear whether a feature found in one language context plays the same causal role when processing prompts in another language. We study this question using translation-initiation features (Wu et al., 2026). We reproduce the SAE feature discovery method from Wu et al. in Gemma 2 and extend it to multilingual settings that vary prompt language, source language, and target language. We then test whether features that recur across settings affect translation behavior by amplifying or ablating their activations during inference. We also examine whether the method can be applied to Gemma 3.
  In both models, we observe an identical finding: although we can find more than 20 features that activate frequently across all discovery settings, causal validation shows that nearly all have small or inconsistent effects. In contrast, one feature -- Gemma 2's (L10, 5717) and Gemma 3's (L20, 2456) -- consistently improves COMET scores when amplified and degrades them when ablated across 23 language settings. These results show that feature recurrence can overstate cross-lingual transfer, while identifying a language-agnostic translation-initiation direction in Gemma 2 and Gemma 3.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多语言环境中稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征的因果角色一致性，发现虽然20多个特征在多语言设置中频繁激活，但绝大多数在因果验证中效应很小或不一致，仅有一个"翻译启动"特征在两个模型中跨23种语言设置一致地影响翻译行为。
AI.motivation: SAE特征被广泛用于解释和控制语言模型行为，但跨语言上下文中特征是否扮演相同的因果角色尚不清楚。该问题对多语言模型的可解释性和可控性至关重要。
AI.method: 在Gemma 2中复现Wu等人的SAE特征发现方法，并扩展到多语言设置（变化提示语言、源语言和目标语言）。通过增强或消融特征激活来验证特征对翻译行为的因果影响，并将方法应用于Gemma 3。
AI.result: 两个模型中均发现20多个特征频繁激活，但因果验证显示几乎全部效应较小或不一致。唯一例外是Gemma 2的(L10, 5717)和Gemma 3的(L20, 2456)特征：增强时一致提高COMET分数，消融时一致降低，覆盖23种语言设置。
AI.conclusion: 特征跨语言出现的频繁性可能高估了跨语言转移的真实因果作用；同时发现了一个语言无关的翻译启动（translation-initiation）方向，在Gemma 2和Gemma 3中均存在。

title: FinalityBench: An Effect-Level Benchmark for Agent Decisions Under Delayed and Conflicting Financial Finality
comment: 9 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Code, corpus generator and all result files: https://github.com/abhisheksharma2411/finalitybench Archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22262591
summary: A merchant's payment processor, ledger, ERP and bank feed are updated by messages that get delayed, duplicated, dropped and reordered, so for minutes at a time the four hold contradictory beliefs about the same order. An agent resolving the exception must decide whether to ship goods, re-submit a capture, refund or wait, knowing some of those cannot be undone. We present FinalityBench, an executable benchmark for that decision. It keeps a hidden canonical event log and derives each system's view from a separately faulted delivery stream, so disagreement follows from specified fault semantics rather than being authored. Grading is on executed monetary effects: an episode is scored by the merchant's terminal economic position, relative to a privileged reference told when the pending capture resolves. The corpus of 321 tasks includes 45 twin pairs (90 tasks): tasks whose four system views are identical at the decision instant, whose authoritative probes both return unknown, and whose eventual correct dispositions differ. That snapshot indistinguishability is checked under every evaluation seed rather than assumed; equivalence over all interaction traces is not claimed. Over 14,445 graded episodes from nine programmatic policies, ranking by single-task accuracy and by paired loss disagree in 7 places: a ship-on-first-sign policy is second-best by accuracy at 65.7% and worst in the suite by paired loss, because it cannot tell the two members apart. A runtime gating irreversible actions on an authoritative finality probe reaches 85.4% and, unlike every polling policy, loses nothing to pass^5; its residual loss is almost entirely one archetype, which prices finality information directly. Language models reach the same exact rate as the hand-written gate on a stratified subset, lose about twice as much money, and discover the finality-gating strategy without being told it.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 FinalityBench——一个可执行的基准测试，用于评估在支付处理系统中因消息延迟、重复、丢失和乱序导致四个系统视图不一致时，代理解决异常（发货、重新提交捕获、退款或等待）的决策能力。基准测试基于隐藏的规范事件日志和独立故障传递流，以终端经济收益评分，包含 321 个任务（含 45 对孪生对），并发现按单任务准确率与按配对损失排序不一致的 7 处情况。
AI.motivation: 支付处理系统中，商家的支付处理器、分类账、ERP 和银行信息流因消息故障（延迟、重复、丢失、乱序）而经常对同一订单持矛盾信念。代理需在不完全信息且某些操作不可撤销的情况下，决定是否发货、重新提交捕获、退款或等待。现有的决策基准缺乏能反映这种消息故障语义和快照不可区分性的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建 FinalityBench：维护一个隐藏的规范事件日志，从每个系统的视角分别派生出带有独立故障语义（延迟、重复、丢失、乱序）的传递流。评分依据执行的货币效果——根据商家的终端经济地位与一个知晓待定捕获解析的参照物进行对比。语料库包含 321 个任务，其中包括 45 对孪生对（90 个任务），其四个系统视图在决策时刻相同、权威探针均返回未知、但最终正确处置不同。每个评估种子下都验证快照不可区分性，而非假定。对 9 个程序化策略跨 14,445 个评分片段进行评估。
AI.result: 按单任务准确率与按配对损失排序在 7 处不一致。ship-on-first-sign 策略在准确率上排名第二（65.7%），但在配对损失上最差，因为它无法区分孪生任务。一种对权威终结性探针上不可逆操作进行运行时门控的策略达到 85.4%，且与轮询策略不同，它对 pass^5 没有任何损失；其残余损失几乎全部来自一个直接对终结性信息定价的原型。语言模型在分层子集上达到与手写门控相同的准确率，但资金损失约为其两倍，并能自主发现终结性门控策略。
AI.conclusion: FinalityBench 展示了任务级分类度量指标如何掩盖在需要区分看似相同但实际不同的快照场景中的系统性能差异。仅靠准确率评估的策略在实际决策中可能产生显著的经济损失，而结合终结性探针的运行时门控策略能有效减少不可逆操作的风险。该基准为评估代理在消息故障下的不可逆经济决策提供了可执行的测试平台。

title: MINT: A Unified Model for World-Space Camera and Hand Motion Estimation from Scalable Egocentric Pipeline Supervision
summary: Recovering camera and hand motion in world coordinates from egocentric video is a key capability for activity understanding, robot learning, and augmented reality. Existing systems typically decompose this problem into separate stages for camera motion, depth, hand reconstruction, and trajectory refinement, resulting in substantial computational overhead and preventing the joint modeling of camera and hand motion. We introduce MINT (Minting IN-the-Wild Trajectories), the first foundation model that directly produces complete world-space two-hand trajectories from ego-centric RGB video. From a single shared spatiotemporal video representation, MINT jointly predicts the camera trajectory, camera-frame hand states, and per-frame hand presence, and then produces world-space hand motion via explicit coordinate transformations. Training such a model at scale is challenging, since paired world-space camera and hand annotations are scarce. We therefore develop an open-source labeling EGOPIPELINE that converts large collections of public egocentric videos into structured camera-and-hand trajectory supervision. MINT is first pretrained on these large-scale pseudo-labels and then fine-tuned on a small set of high-quality joint annotations. Across public benchmarks, MINT achieves [xxx] improvement in world-space hand trajectory accuracy, [xxx] improvement in camera trajectory estimation, and [xxx] faster end-to-end trajectory generation than the labeling pipeline, while generalizing zero-shot to unseen egocentric datasets. We release the model, training and inference code, labeling pipeline, and a curated 1,021-hour egocentric trajectory dataset.

AI.tldr: MINT是首个直接从第一人称RGB视频中生成完整世界坐标系双手轨迹的基础模型，通过统一的时空视频表征联合预测相机轨迹、相机帧手部状态和手部存在性，并利用大规模伪标签预训练加小规模高质量标注微调的策略，在公开基准上显著提升了轨迹精度与推理速度，同时实现了零点泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有系统将相机运动、深度、手部重建和轨迹细化分解为独立阶段，导致计算开销大且无法对相机与手部运动进行联合建模。同时，配对的世界坐标系相机和手部标注数据稀缺，阻碍了端到端模型的规模化训练。
AI.method: MINT采用单一共享的时空视频表征，联合预测相机轨迹、相机坐标系下的手部状态以及逐帧手部存在性，再通过显式坐标变换得到世界空间的手部运动。训练上开发了开源的EGOPIPELINE标注流程，将大规模公开第一人称视频转换为结构化的相机-手部轨迹监督信号，先用伪标签进行预训练，再在小规模高质量联合标注上进行微调。
AI.result: 在公开基准上，MINT在世界空间手部轨迹精度、相机轨迹估计精度上均获得显著提升（以[xxx]表示具体数值），端到端轨迹生成速度比标注流程快[xxx]倍，且能零样本泛化到未见过的第一人称数据集。同时发布了模型、代码、标注流程及1,021小时的精校本位轨迹数据集。
AI.conclusion: MINT通过联合建模和两阶段训练策略，证明了从第一人称视频直接生成世界中完全双手机迹的可行性，标志着该方向首个基础模型的落地，并提供了完整开源生态以支持后续研究。

title: PAPT++: Risk-Aware Adversarial Tuning and Generation for Single Domain Generalization
summary: Single domain generalization (SDG) aims to learn a model from one labeled source domain that generalizes to unseen target domains. A common strategy is to enrich the source distribution with augmented or generated samples, and recent text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models provide a strong generative prior for this purpose. However, diversity alone is insufficient for robust generalization, because useful generated samples should also capture variations that the current classifier finds difficult. Motivated by distributionally robust optimization (DRO), we define a semantic ambiguity set in the class-conditional generative space of a pretrained T2I model and search it for samples with high classification loss under the current classifier. To this end, we introduce PAPT++, a risk-aware adversarial generation-training framework for SDG. PAPT++ first learns diverse semantic reference images for each class through image-text alignment and intra-class diversity regularization. These references then serve as denoising targets during classifier-guided diffusion synthesis, reducing semantic drift while guiding generation toward challenging variations. The generated samples are combined with the source data to update the classifier, and the updated classifier guides the next synthesis round in return. In this way, PAPT++ progressively exposes the classifier to challenging yet semantically consistent variations. Extensive experiments on standard SDG benchmarks demonstrate the superiority of the proposed PAPT++ method and the effectiveness of its main components.

AI.tldr: 提出PAPT++，一种面向单域泛化的风险感知对抗生成-训练框架，利用预训练T2I扩散模型在类条件生成空间中搜索分类器难以处理的困难样本，实现分类器与生成器交替优化的渐进式训练。
AI.motivation: 现有基于T2I扩散模型的SDG方法仅关注生成样本的多样性，但多样性本身不足以保证鲁棒泛化——有效生成样本还应捕获当前分类器难以处理的语义变化。作者受分布鲁棒优化启发，希望在语义模糊集内搜索高分类损失的困难样本。
AI.method: PAPT++包含两个关键组件：(1) 通过图像-文本对齐和类内多样性正则化，为每个类别学习多样化的语义参考图像；(2) 这些参考图像在分类器引导的扩散合成过程中作为去噪目标，减少语义漂移并引导生成趋向困难变化。生成样本与源数据联合训练更新分类器，更新后的分类器再引导下一轮合成，形成对抗式交替优化。
AI.result: 在标准SDG基准上的大量实验表明，PAPT++优于现有方法，消融实验验证了各主要组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过在类条件生成空间中定义语义模糊集并迭代搜索困难样本，PAPT++能渐进地将分类器暴露于具有挑战性但语义一致的变化中，从而提升单域泛化能力。

title: A Systematic Comparison of Multilingual Interpretability Methods Reveals Anisotropy-Driven Failures
summary: Multilingual language models develop shared cross-lingual representations, and various interpretability methods claim to quantify this sharing. These methods have been developed largely in isolation, and when they disagree, it is unclear whether the disagreement reflects a property of the model or an artifact of the measurement. We compare four sharing metrics (CKA, ANC, GMM dominance per token, and ILO) across 21 base models from five families (125M-14B parameters) and correlate each with cross-lingual transfer on five downstream tasks. We find that the metrics differ in their quantification of cross-lingual sharing in these models and suggest that the disagreement traces to anisotropy, the tendency of representations to cluster in a narrow cone of the embedding space. Only ILO's correlation with cross-lingual transfer (Spearman's $ρ= 0.90$) survives controls for model size, family, and per-task variation. We therefore recommend ILO as the primary sharing metric, to be reported alongside anisotropy diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了四种衡量多语言模型中跨语言表征共享的指标（CKA、ANC、GMM dominance per token和ILO），在五个系列21个基础模型（125M-14B参数）上评估其与五个下游任务跨语言迁移的相关性。研究发现这些指标对跨语言共享的量化存在分歧，分歧源于表征的各向异性（anisotropy）。仅ILO与跨语言迁移的相关性（Spearman's ρ=0.90）在控制模型大小、系列和任务变异后依然稳健。作者推荐将ILO作为主要共享指标，并与各向异性诊断一起报告。
AI.motivation: 多语言语言模型会发展出共享的跨语言表征，但现有多种可解释性方法对共享程度的量化往往不一致。当方法之间产生分歧时，无法判断该分歧反映的是模型本身的属性还是测量工具的伪影，因此需要系统性比较这些指标并探究分歧根源。
AI.method: 在21个来自五个模型系列（参数量125M-14B）的基础多语言模型上，比较四种共享度量指标（CKA、ANC、GMM dominance per token和ILO），并将每种指标与五个下游任务的跨语言迁移表现进行相关性分析，同时控制模型大小、模型系列和任务变异等混淆因素。
AI.result: 四种指标对跨语言共享的量化存在差异，且分歧可追溯到表征的各向异性（表征趋向于在嵌入空间的窄锥形区域内聚集）。只有ILO与跨语言迁移的Spearman相关系数（ρ=0.90）在控制模型大小、系列及任务间变异后仍然保持显著。
AI.conclusion: 建议将ILO作为衡量跨语言共享的主要指标，并在报告该指标时同时提供各向异性诊断，以便更可靠地解释跨语言表征共享程度。

title: PLUME: Parameter-Efficient Personalization of Large Language Models via Low-Rank User Modulation in Shared Subspaces
summary: Personalizing large language models (LLMs) is essential for delivering AI assistance that aligns with individual users' styles, intents, and preferences. While per-user fine-tuning can substantially enhance personalization quality, it introduces significant parameter and storage overhead, limiting scalability to large user populations. We propose PLUME (Personalized Low-Rank Adaptation through User Modulation and Shared Subspace), a lightweight framework that achieves efficient and expressive per-user adaptation by leveraging a shared task-specific subspace. Specifically, PLUME first learns a global task subspace from aggregated user data. Personalization is then achieved by training only a lightweight small square matrix within this subspace, enabling each user to obtain a tailored model while keeping shared components fixed. Cross-layer shared parameters and rank-1 residual terms are further introduced to significantly reduce redundancy while maintaining expressiveness. Experiments on multiple personalized text generation benchmarks demonstrate that PLUME achieves comparable or superior performance to strong baselines, while reducing per-user parameters by over 95%. These results establish shared-subspace modulation with minimal residuals as a scalable and semantically grounded approach to LLM personalization.

AI.tldr: PLUME提出了一种轻量级LLM个性化框架，通过共享任务子空间和用户调制（仅训练一个小型方阵）实现高效个性化，将每用户参数减少超过95%，同时保持或超越强基线的生成性能。
AI.motivation: LLM个性化对提升AI助手的用户体验至关重要，但每用户微调虽效果显著，却带来巨大的参数和存储开销，难以扩展到大规模用户群体。
AI.method: PLUME首先从聚合的用户数据中学习一个全局任务子空间，然后仅在该子空间内训练一个轻量级的小型方阵矩阵来实现个性化，固定共享组件不变。此外还引入了跨层共享参数和秩1残差项来减少冗余并保持表达能力。
AI.result: 在多个个性化文本生成基准上，PLUME取得与强基线相当或更优的性能，同时每用户参数减少超过95%。
AI.conclusion: 共享子空间调制配合最小残差是一种可扩展且语义上有依据的LLM个性化方法，为实现大规模高效的个性化部署提供了新路径。

title: LetOccVote: Learning Weakly Supervised 3D Occupancy through Consensus
summary: Weakly supervised 3D occupancy prediction reduces the reliance on costly 3D annotations by learning from 2D pseudo-labels generated by vision foundation models. However, existing methods typically use these imperfect pseudo-labels directly as supervision, making occupancy learning vulnerable to erroneous geometric and semantic targets. We observe that agreement across repeated observations provides an inexpensive and reliable cue for assessing pseudo-label reliability. Based on this observation, we propose \textbf{LetOccVote}, a weakly supervised Gaussian-based occupancy framework that leverages cross-frame voting to improve both geometric and semantic supervision. For geometry, Depth Vote exploits cross-frame geometric agreement to refine supported pseudo depth and reject contradictory estimates before volumetric lifting and depth supervision. For semantics, Semantic Vote aggregates pseudo-semantic observations in a shared 3D space to identify reliable and contested evidence, strengthening reliable semantic supervision while filtering unreliable pseudo-label segments. The entire framework is trained solely with 2D pseudo-label supervision without requiring 3D occupancy annotations. On Occ3D-nuScenes, LetOccVote achieves 53.27 IoU and 20.39 mIoU, establishing state-of-the-art performance among methods with 2D pseudo-label supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出了LetOccVote，一种基于高斯表示的弱监督3D占据预测框架，通过跨帧投票同时提升几何和语义伪标签质量，仅使用2D伪标签监督即在Occ3D-nuScenes上达到SOTA性能（53.27 IoU，20.39 mIoU）。
AI.motivation: 现有弱监督3D占据预测方法直接使用视觉基础模型生成的有缺陷的2D伪标签作为监督信号，导致占据学习易受错误几何和语义目标的影响。作者发现跨多次观测的一致性是一个廉价且可靠的伪标签可信度评估线索，基于此设计投票机制来改善监督质量。
AI.method: 提出LetOccVote框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) Depth Vote：利用跨帧几何一致性来优化受支撑的伪深度并剔除矛盾的深度估计，在体积升采样和深度监督之前进行；(2) Semantic Vote：在共享3D空间中聚合伪语义观测，区分可靠与存疑的证据，强化可靠语义监督并过滤不可靠的伪标签片段。整个框架仅使用2D伪标签监督训练，无需3D占据标注。
AI.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes数据集上，LetOccVote达到53.27 IoU和20.39 mIoU，在仅使用2D伪标签监督的方法中建立了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 跨帧投票机制能够有效地从不可靠的2D伪标签中提取高质量监督信号，验证了观测一致性作为伪标签可靠性线索的有效性，为弱监督3D占据预测提供了新的思路。

title: A Robust Watermark-based Fingerprint Framework for GNNs Ownership Verification
summary: The high training cost of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) has raised growing concerns regarding model ownership infringement, such as model stealing and unauthorized misuse. To verify model ownership and prevent significant economic losses, two groups of GNN Ownership Verification (OV) methods have been proposed: watermark-based methods and fingerprint-based methods. However, these methods typically face three limitations: (1) the performance degradation of protected models caused by out-of-distribution (OOD) watermark graphs with respect to the training set; (2) the unrealistic assumption that surrogate models have been trained on a watermark-containing training set; and (3) over-reliance on specific output levels for fingerprint extraction. In this paper, we propose a Robust watErMArk-based fingeRprint frameworK for GNNs, named REMARK. REMARK first generates carefully crafted in-distribution watermark graphs that maximize output differences between GNN models, thus mitigating OOD-induced performance degradation. REMARK then extracts robust fingerprints from these output differences to verify GNN ownership, thereby removing the assumptions that surrogate models must be trained on a watermark-containing dataset or expose specific output levels. Extensive experiments across widely used real-world datasets and GNN architectures demonstrate that REMARK achieves state-of-the-art OV accuracy and robustness while preserving the utility of protected models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REMARK框架，一种结合水印与指纹的图神经网络（GNN）所有权验证方法。通过生成分布内（in-distribution）水印图以最大化模型间输出差异，并从中提取鲁棒指纹进行所有权验证，解决了现有GNN所有权验证方法中OOD水印导致模型性能下降、代理模型需在水印数据集上训练的假设不现实、以及过度依赖特定输出层等三大局限。
AI.motivation: GNN的高昂训练成本引发了对模型所有权侵权的担忧（如模型窃取和未授权使用）。现有的水印和指纹两类GNN所有权验证方法存在三个关键局限：水印图相对于训练集为分布外（OOD）导致受保护模型性能退化；假设代理模型已在含水流印的训练集上训练，这在实际中不可实现；指纹提取过度依赖特定输出级别。
AI.method: REMARK首先精心生成分布内（in-distribution）水印图，这些图被设计为能够最大化不同GNN模型间的输出差异，从而避免OOD引起的性能退化。随后，REMARK从这些输出差异中提取鲁棒指纹用于GNN所有权验证，该过程消除了代理模型必须在含水流印数据集上训练或暴露特定输出级别的假设。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的真实世界数据集和多种GNN架构上进行的大量实验表明，REMARK在所有权验证（OV）准确率和鲁棒性方面达到了最先进的水平，同时保持了受保护模型的效用（utility）。
AI.conclusion: REMARK通过分布内水印图的设计与基于输出差异的鲁棒指纹提取，有效解决了现有GNN所有权验证方法的三大局限，在保持模型性能的同时实现了高准确率和鲁棒性的所有权验证。

title: Reinforcement Learning for improving Large Language Models' Catalan text simplification capabilities
comment: Accepted at CLEAR-TEXT 2026: Readability and text simplification workshop at the International Conference Computational Linguistics in Bulgaria (CLIB 2026)
summary: Although automatic text simplification (ATS) is critical for accessibility, its progress has not matched the rapid evolution of broader natural language processing techniques. This paper investigates the application of reinforcement learning (RL) to improve the quality of ATS for low-resource languages using Large Language Models (LLMs). The paper introduces a novel reward function, designed to guide LLMs toward a targeted simplification style with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), that combines the SARI metric with specific penalty components. The effectiveness of GRPO with this reward function is motivated and demonstrated by post-training IberianLLM-7B-Instruct on the ASSET dataset. After post-training on the English ASSET, the model's ATS performance improves on two curated Catalan benchmarks while also successfully suppressing previously observed negative behaviors. Cross-lingual transfer learning is explored by translating ASSET into Catalan and Spanish and post-training the model on each version, but these fail to show a significant improvement on the out-of-domain benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了使用强化学习（RL）提升低资源语言自动文本简化（ATS）质量的方法，提出了一种结合SARI指标与惩罚项的新型奖励函数，并采用GRPO策略对IberianLLM-7B-Instruct进行后训练。在ASSET数据集上训练后，模型在加泰罗尼亚语基准上性能提升并抑制了不良行为；跨语言迁移学习（翻译ASSET为加泰罗尼亚语和西班牙语）在域外基准上未表现出显著改善。
AI.motivation: 自动文本简化（ATS）对于无障碍访问至关重要，但其发展速度未能跟上更广泛自然语言处理技术的快速演进。低资源语言的ATS尤其缺乏深入研究，因此作者希望探索利用强化学习和大语言模型来提升低资源语言的ATS性能。
AI.method: 提出一种新型奖励函数，将SARI评估指标与特定的惩罚组件相结合，用于指导大语言模型朝向目标简化风格进行优化。采用Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）作为强化学习算法，在ASSET数据集上对IberianLLM-7B-Instruct进行后训练。同时探索跨语言迁移学习，将ASSET数据集翻译为加泰罗尼亚语和西班牙语版本分别进行后训练。
AI.result: 在英文ASSET数据集上后训练后，模型在两个精选加泰罗尼亚语基准上的ATS性能得到提升，同时有效抑制了先前观察到的负面行为。然而，跨语言迁移学习实验（翻译ASSET后分别用加泰罗尼亚语和西班牙语后训练）未能在域外基准上表现出显著的改进效果。
AI.conclusion: GRPO配合所提出的奖励函数能够有效提升模型在目标语言上的ATS质量，其能力可跨语言迁移至低资源的加泰罗尼亚语场景。但纯粹依赖翻译数据的跨语言迁移学习策略效果有限，说明域外数据的翻译并不能简单替代目标语言的原生训练数据。

title: Aplaud: Adaptive Personalized Low-Rank Decomposition for User-Specific LLM
summary: In this paper, we study the problem of personalized survey response prediction using fine-tuned large language models (LLMs). This task poses unique challenges: limited per-user training data, scalability of model storage, and the need to exploit shared structure across survey questions. To address these issues, we propose Aplaud (Adaptive Personalized Low-rank and User-specific Nested Decomposition), a lightweight and scalable framework for LLM personalization. Aplaud extends the LoRA paradigm by separating adaptation into a frozen, shared low-rank basis and a compact user-specific correction, augmented with a rank-one residual for finer personalization. To further reduce per-user parameter cost and mitigate overfitting, the correction matrix can be factorized into an even lower-rank form. Empirical results demonstrate that Aplaud achieves efficient, scalable personalization across users while outperforming state-of-the-art LoRA-based personalized LLM approaches in both generalization and inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Aplaud框架，通过将LoRA分解为共享低秩基与用户特定校正（可进一步低秩分解）的方法，实现面向个性化调查问卷回答预测的轻量可扩展大语言模型个性化。
AI.motivation: 个性化调查问卷回答预测任务面临三大挑战：每个用户的训练数据有限、模型存储的可扩展性、以及需要利用不同调查问题之间的共享结构。现有基于LoRA的个性化方法在这三方面表现不足。
AI.method: Aplaud扩展了LoRA范式，将自适应过程分解为两部分：一个冻结的共享低秩基（shared low-rank basis）和一个紧凑的用户特定校正（user-specific correction），并加入秩为1的残差（rank-one residual）以实现更精细的个性化。用户特定校正矩阵可进一步分解为更低秩形式，以减少每用户参数开销并缓解过拟合。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Aplaud在跨用户个性化方面实现了高效且可扩展的性能，在泛化能力和推理效率上均优于最先进的基于LoRA的个性化大语言模型方法。
AI.conclusion: Aplaud通过共享结构与用户特定信息的巧妙分离，在实现轻量级存储的同时有效提升了个性化预测的泛化性能与推理效率，为大规模用户个性化场景提供了可行方案。

title: CrossDepth: Geometry-Constrained Attention for Generalizable Multi-View Surround Depth Estimation
summary: Reliable 3D understanding of the surrounding environment is a core requirement for autonomous driving. Multi-view surround camera rigs provide broad scene coverage, but the spatially adjacent images typically overlap only minimally. Consequently, the depth of most pixels must be inferred from monocular appearance cues. These cues can appear differently across images and may therefore be interpreted differently by the depth estimation model. We target two main sources of cross-image inconsistency: differences in camera intrinsics and the limited receptive field of each image. We address the former by conditioning the features on per-pixel camera-aware ray embeddings, enabling the network to account for camera-dependent variations in monocular cues. We address the latter by extending each pixel's context beyond its own image through cross-image attention constrained to geometrically plausible regions, derived from the calibrated rig setup. The model is trained in a fully self-supervised manner based on photometric consistency. Evaluations on DDAD and nuScenes show improved overall depth accuracy and cross-image depth consistency over state-of-the-art self-supervised methods under in-domain and cross-domain evaluation. Code is available at https://abualhanud.github.io/CrossDepthPage/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向多视图环视相机的自监督深度估计方法，通过像素级相机感知射线嵌入处理不同相机内参差异，并通过几何约束的跨图像注意力扩展感受野，从而提升深度精度与跨图像一致性。在DDAD和nuScenes数据集上优于现有自监督方法。
AI.motivation: 多视图环视相机是自动驾驶的核心感知设备，但相邻图像之间重叠区域极小，多数像素深度需依赖单目外观线索推断。这些单目线索在不同图像间可能表现不一致并被模型不同解读，导致跨图像深度不一致。作者识别两大不一致来源：相机内参差异（不同相机成像特性不同）和有限感受野（单图上下文不足）。
AI.method: 针对相机内参差异，在特征提取时引入逐像素的相机感知射线嵌入，使网络能感知并适配相机相关的单目线索变化；针对感受野限制，通过基于标定装置推导的几何可行区域约束的跨图像注意力机制，将每个像素的上下文扩展到其他视图图像。模型以光度一致性损失进行全自监督训练。
AI.result: 在DDAD和nuScenes数据集上的域内与跨域评估中，该方法在整体深度精度和跨图像深度一致性方面均优于现有最先进的自监督方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模相机内参差异并利用几何约束扩展跨图上下文，可以有效缓解多视图自监督深度估计中的跨图像不一致问题，且无需额外标注即可提升深度质量。

title: Mitigating Performance Discrepancy in Cross-Domain 3D Class-Incremental Learning
summary: 3D perception plays a crucial role in real-world applications such as autonomous driving, robotics, and AR/VR. In practical scenarios, 3D perception models need to continually adapt to newly emerging 3D object categories, making class-incremental learning (CIL) particularly important. However, unlike 2D images, 3D point clouds are inherently heterogeneous: objects from the same class may not only come from the clean CAD domain, but also from RGB-D camera scans of varying quality, video reconstructions, or even corrupted observations. We discover that such heterogeneity introduces a new challenge beyond catastrophic forgetting: the degree of performance degradation can vary substantially across domains, a phenomenon we term performance discrepancy. To investigate this problem, we establish the Domain3D-CIL training and evaluation protocol, which contains point cloud categories from heterogeneous domains. We further adapt a wide range of mainstream CIL methods to the 3D modality. The results demonstrate that this performance discrepancy consistently appears across these baselines. To mitigate this issue, we introduce PolyMem, an exemplar-free approach that implicitly models rich high-order statistics of the feature distribution to enhance cross-domain robustness. Experiments demonstrate that our method effectively alleviates the performance discrepancy while improving the model's performance across domains. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了3D类增量学习中一个超出灾难性遗忘的新挑战——跨域性能差异（performance discrepancy），即不同域（CAD、RGB-D扫描、视频重建等）上的性能退化程度不一致。作者构建了Domain3D-CIL协议来系统研究该问题，并提出PolyMem方法，通过隐式建模特征分布的高阶统计量来增强跨域鲁棒性，有效缓解性能差异并提升跨域性能。
AI.motivation: 3D感知模型在实际应用中需持续适应新类别（类增量学习），但3D点云数据本质上是异质的（来自CAD、RGB-D扫描、视频重建、损坏观测等不同域）。现有CIL研究主要聚焦于灾难性遗忘，未注意到数据域异质性会导致跨域性能退化程度不一致的"性能差异"问题。作者旨在建立系统研究框架并提出有效解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 建立Domain3D-CIL训练与评估协议，包含来自异构域的3D点云类别；2) 将多种主流CIL方法适配到3D模态进行基线评估；3) 提出PolyMem（exemplar-free方法），通过隐式建模特征分布的丰富高阶统计量来增强跨域鲁棒性，从而缓解性能差异。
AI.result: 实验表明：性能差异现象在多种主流CIL基线上一致出现，证明了该问题的普遍性；PolyMem方法能有效缓解性能差异，同时提升模型在各域上的整体性能。
AI.conclusion: 3D类增量学习中的跨域性能差异是一个值得关注的新挑战；PolyMem通过高阶特征统计建模为缓解该问题提供了有效方案，代码将开源以促进后续研究。

title: Persistent Teacher Anchoring for Tool-Using Agents
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 8 tables. Accepted at EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference)
summary: Distillation is common in LLM post-training, where on-policy knowledge distillation (OPKD) uses student-generated trajectories to prepare the student for downstream RL. At each state, the student matches a next-token distribution supplied by the teacher. As the rollout enters states the teacher would not visit, the teacher-student distribution gap can accumulate. In tool use, this gap becomes consequential because student-written calls execute before supervision and their observations shape later prefixes. Proposer-verifier generation addresses this drift by letting the teacher decide which student-proposed text is retained during generation. Existing formulations govern text but leave tool execution outside their scope. We propose Persistent Teacher Anchoring (PTA), a student-induced but teacher-committed rollout construction. PTA retains chunk-level verification and adds turn-level commitment, allowing a call to reach the environment only after the teacher has verified the entire turn. Treating verified chunks as atomic generation units, we introduce persistent lookahead, which fills idle rollout capacity by advancing future samples and carrying unfinished ones across student updates under the fixed verifier. Across Search-R1-style retrieval and DeepEyes-style perception RL, applying PTA before downstream RL improves macro best@4 by 2.5 and 2.8 points over OPKD under the same downstream RL budget, while lookahead improves throughput by 24%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动态教师锚定（PTA）方法，通过回合级教师验证后放行工具调用，并引入持久前瞻机制利用空闲生成容量，在检索与感知强化学习任务中显著优于现有同策略知识蒸馏方法。
AI.motivation: 在LLM后训练的同策略知识蒸馏（OPKD）中，学生生成的轨迹可能进入教师不会访问的状态，导致师生分布差距累积。尤其在工具使用场景中，学生编写的工具调用会在监督前执行，其观察结果会塑造后续前缀，使这一差距产生严重后果。现有proposer-verifier生成方案虽能缓解文本漂移，却未将工具执行纳入其验证范围。
AI.method: 提出动态教师锚定（PTA）框架：1）保留块级验证并增加回合级承诺（turn-level commitment），工具调用只有在教师验证整个回合后才能到达环境；2）将已验证的块视为原子生成单元，引入持久前瞻（persistent lookahead），通过推进未来样本并跨学生更新携带未完成样本，在固定验证器下填充空闲的rollout容量。
AI.result: 在Search-R1式检索和DeepEyes式感知RL任务中，在同等下游RL预算下，PTA相比OPKD将macro best@4分别提升2.5和2.8个点；前瞻机制将吞吐量提升24%。
AI.conclusion: PTA通过学生诱导但教师承诺的rollout构建，在工具使用场景中有效锚定学生生成过程，减少分布漂移，同时以持久前瞻提升训练吞吐效率，为LLM蒸馏后训练提供了一种更稳健的工具执行感知方案。

title: Generating Constructive Feedback on Stories via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Constructive feedback is crucial for creative writers to refine their storytelling abilities. Since receiving feedback from human experts is often costly and time-intensive, large language models (LLMs) offer a scalable and efficient alternative as automatic writing assistants. Despite their potential, research indicates that LLM-generated feedback is often generic, lacks actionability, and fails to identify which writing issue is most critical.
